title: [Articles] CT-based AI risk support for cystic renal masses: multicenter validation, reader study, and a randomized implementation study

abstract: KITE-CRM improved assisted interpretation and reporting efficiency. Management findings do not establish long-term oncologic safety or CRM-specific clinical superiority. title: RETBind: a patient-level multimodal foundation model for unified cross-modal retinal representation learning
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: RETBind：患者级多模态视网膜基础模型
summary: 提出RETBind，利用患者级配对的OCT与超广角眼底影像预训练统一编码器，学习跨模态对应关系，面向眼科多模态临床工作流。
key_points: 统一编码器学习OCT与UWF眼底的跨模态对应
采用患者级配对预训练，减少人工标注依赖
针对现有眼科基础模型多为单模态的不足
reason: 眼科多模态基础模型，方向契合；摘要未见外部验证与规模细节，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical artificial intelligence (AI) holds considerable promise across a wide range of ophthalmic tasks, offering a practical path to patient-level diagnostic support. Foundation models further extend this potential by learning generalizable representations from large-scale unlabeled data, alleviating the burden of extensive manual annotation. However, existing ophthalmic foundation models largely rely on single-modality or modality-specific encoders, failing to capture patient-level cross-modal correspondence in real-world multimodal clinical workflows. To address these gaps, we propose RETBind, a patient-level multimodal foundation model with a unified encoder that explicitly learns cross-modal correspondence from paired clinical imaging using patient-level paired optical coherence tomography (OCT) and ultra-widefield (UWF) fundus imaging. This patient-level paired pretraining strategy enables the model to learn unified cross-modal representations of complementary information, improv-ing performance and robustness beyond single-modality approaches. Across nine benchmark datasets spanning ocular disease classification and segmentation tasks, RETBind achieved consistent improvements, particularly enhancing AUPR in clinically relevant imbalanced settings. Exploratory analyses further examined the potential of RETBind for systemic disease prediction from retinal imaging, collectively highlighting its ability to learn unified cross-modal representations within a single shared encoder, enabling direct interaction between modalities and supporting transfer across diverse retinal imaging tasks.
zh_abstract: 医学人工智能（AI）在多种眼科任务中前景广阔，为患者层面的诊断支持提供了切实可行的途径。基础模型（foundation models）能够从大规模未标注数据中学习可泛化的表征，从而减轻大量人工标注的负担，进一步拓展了这一潜力。然而，现有的眼科基础模型大多依赖单模态或特定模态的编码器，难以捕捉真实世界多模态临床工作流程中患者层面的跨模态对应关系。针对上述不足，我们提出了 RETBind，这是一种患者层面的多模态基础模型，采用统一编码器，利用患者层面配对的光学相干断层扫描（OCT）与超广角（UWF）眼底成像，从配对的临床影像中显式学习跨模态对应关系。这种患者层面配对的预训练策略使模型能够学习互补信息的统一跨模态表征，在性能和稳健性方面优于单模态方法。在涵盖眼部疾病分类和分割任务的九个基准数据集上，RETBind 取得了一致的提升，尤其是在临床相关的不平衡场景中提高了 AUPR。探索性分析进一步考察了 RETBind 利用视网膜成像预测全身性疾病的潜力。这些结果共同表明，该模型能够在单一共享编码器中学习统一的跨模态表征，实现模态间的直接交互，并支持在多种视网膜成像任务之间的迁移。

title: Visual LLM-guided consensus spatial domain detection with L-STAR
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: L-STAR：视觉大模型引导的空间域检测共识框架
summary: 提出L-STAR，利用视觉大模型的推理能力，对空间转录组中多种空间域检测方法自适应排序并整合，在多数据集上优于单一方法。
key_points: 针对空间转录组域检测方法跨数据集表现不稳的问题
以视觉LLM自适应排序并整合多种方法形成共识
在多个数据集上稳定优于单一方法
reason: Nature Commun同行评审，视觉LLM用于空间组学，有新意但信息有限
abstract: ABSTRACT Spatial domain detection is a central task in spatial transcriptomics, yet existing methods exhibit highly variable performance across datasets. We introduce L-STAR, a visual LLM-guided, consensus-based framework that leverages the visual reasoning capacity of large language models to adaptively rank and integrate spatial domain detection methods. L-STAR achieves robust and consistently improved performance, outperforming single spatial domain detection methods across diverse datasets.
zh_abstract: 摘要 空间域检测是空间转录组学中的核心任务，但现有方法在不同数据集上的表现差异很大。我们提出 L-STAR，这是一种由视觉大语言模型（LLM）引导、基于共识的框架，利用大语言模型的视觉推理能力，自适应地对空间域检测方法进行排序和整合。L-STAR 取得了稳健且持续改进的性能，在多种数据集上优于单一的空间域检测方法。

abstract: The high burden of traditional FDA clearance drives many novel, AI-enabled mental health devices into unregulated consumer markets. The new FDA-CMS TEMPO pilot program establishes a vital regulatory middle ground, allowing companies to commercialize using a Quality Management System without immediate premarket authorization. This commentary explores how TEMPO serves as a sandbox for real-world data, offering a blueprint to reshape the future of US digital health regulation.
zh_abstract: 传统 FDA 审批的高负担促使许多新型的、基于人工智能的心理健康器械进入不受监管的消费市场。FDA 与 CMS 新推出的 TEMPO 试点项目建立了一个重要的监管中间地带，允许企业在无需立即获得上市前授权的情况下，通过质量管理体系（Quality Management System）实现商业化。本评论探讨 TEMPO 如何作为真实世界数据的“沙盒”，并为重塑美国数字健康监管的未来提供蓝图。

title: CellPlex: Benchmarking Single-Cell Spatial Proteomics Prediction from H&E
zh_title: CellPlex：从H&E预测单细胞空间蛋白组的基准
summary: 提出细胞层面的基准，包含7个队列、717个样本、4480万细胞、149种蛋白，评估从H&E推断单细胞空间蛋白组的方法。
key_points: 覆盖结直肠癌、乳腺癌、淋巴结转移、骨髓和胶质瘤
统一流程处理同切片H&E与多重免疫荧光
现有虚拟染色模型跨队列迁移较差
reason: 大规模多队列公开基准、病理方向，预印本，命中病理偏好
abstract: Spatial proteomics measures tens of proteins in every cell of a tissue section, but its cost confines it to small research cohorts, whereas hematoxylin and eosin (H\&E) slides exist for nearly every patient. Inferring single-cell spatial proteomics from H\&E would bring its analyses to routine pathology, and a growing number of virtual staining models pursue this goal. Each is evaluated on its own cohort, panel and pixel-level metric, and released models transfer poorly to new cohorts, leaving open which approach to build on and which proteins H\&E can reveal. We introduce CellPlex, a benchmark that poses the task at the level of the cell: seven cohorts with same-section H\&E and multiplexed immunofluorescence, from colorectal and breast cancer to lymph-node metastases, bone marrow and glioma, with 717 samples, 44.8 million cells and 149 proteins, processed by one pipeline into per-cell targets. Pathology foundation models (PFMs) are adapted with one cell-level protocol, specialist models are fine-tuned under a matched budget, and all are scored on the same cells. Adapted PFMs are the most accurate models on every cohort, ahead of the specialists even after fine-tuning, but keep less than half of their accuracy on cohorts they were not trained on. Which proteins can be predicted depends on the tissue, not on how many cells were measured for them. By fixing the cells, targets and splits on which predictions are judged, CellPlex sets a common standard for inferring costly molecular measurements from routine H\&E and shows how far H\&E can stand in for spatial proteomics. We will release the data, splits, evaluation code and baselines as a testbed for developing and comparing future pathology foundation models and virtual staining methods.
zh_abstract: 空间蛋白质组学可在组织切片的每个细胞中测量数十种蛋白质，但其成本使其局限于小型研究队列，而几乎每位患者都有苏木精-伊红（H&E）切片。从H&E推断单细胞空间蛋白质组学，可将其分析带入常规病理学，越来越多的虚拟染色模型正在追求这一目标。各模型均在各自的队列、检测panel和像素级指标上进行评估，已发布的模型迁移到新队列时表现较差，因此应基于哪种方法构建、H&E能揭示哪些蛋白质仍不明确。我们提出了CellPlex，一个在细胞层面提出该任务的基准：包含七个具有同一切片H&E和多重免疫荧光的队列，涵盖结直肠癌和乳腺癌，以及淋巴结转移、骨髓和胶质瘤，共717个样本、4480万个细胞和149种蛋白质，由同一流程处理为逐细胞目标。病理学基础模型（PFM）采用同一细胞层面方案进行适配，专家模型在匹配的预算下进行微调，所有模型均在相同细胞上评分。适配后的PFM在每个队列上都是最准确的模型，即使在微调后也领先于专家模型，但在未经训练的队列上其准确度保留不到一半。哪些蛋白质可被预测取决于组织，而不取决于为其测量的细胞数量。通过固定用于评判预测的细胞、目标和数据划分，CellPlex为从常规H&E推断昂贵的分子测量设立了通用标准，并展示了H&E可在多大程度上替代空间蛋白质组学。我们将发布数据、数据划分、评估代码和基线，作为开发和比较未来病理学基础模型及虚拟染色方法的测试平台。

title: A generative foundation model for computational brain imaging
zh_title: BrainGFM：面向计算脑影像的生成式基础模型
summary: BrainGFM在约130万张MRI和CT切片上预训练，支持低数据任务的数据合成与图像重建后训练，在48个下游任务中提升分割与分类，并报告多中心临床验证。
key_points: 预训练语料约130万张MRI/CT切片
48个下游任务中改善有限监督下分割与分类
跨异质成像条件实现高保真图像增强
reason: 医学影像基础模型，任务广、有多中心验证；预印本且细节有限
abstract: Computational brain imaging is constrained by a mismatch between increasingly diverse tasks and scarce, heterogeneous clinical data. Although existing brain foundation models transfer pretrained representations, their knowledge remains entangled within model-specific features and fixed architectures. This paper proposes BrainGFM, a generative foundation model that extends knowledge transfer beyond representation reuse through a reusable and reconfigurable brain-imaging prior. By pretraining on a corpus of about 1.3 million MRI and CT slices, BrainGFM supported task-aligned data synthesis for low-data predictive learning and task-adapted post-training for image reconstruction. Across 48 downstream tasks, BrainGFM improved segmentation and classification under limited supervision and achieved high-fidelity image enhancement across heterogeneous imaging conditions. Multicenter clinical validation involving 4,796 stroke patients across two internal and four external centers demonstrated its applicability to three clinically relevant tasks around stroke cohorts. Blinded reader assessments showed that BrainGFM-generated FLAIR images approached acquired FLAIR in overall diagnostic quality. In a human-AI collaboration study, BrainGFM assistance yielded a 14% relative improvement in mean radiologist stroke-subtyping accuracy. These findings support generative priors as a reusable foundation for heterogeneous computational brain-imaging applications.
zh_abstract: 计算脑成像受到日益多样化的任务与稀缺且异质的临床数据之间不匹配的制约。尽管现有的脑基础模型可迁移预训练表征，但其知识仍与特定模型的特征和固定架构纠缠在一起。本文提出 BrainGFM，一种生成式基础模型，通过可复用、可重构的脑成像先验，将知识迁移扩展到表征复用之外。BrainGFM 在约 130 万张 MRI 和 CT 切片的语料上进行预训练，支持面向低数据预测学习的任务对齐数据合成，以及面向图像重建的任务适配后训练。在 48 项下游任务中，BrainGFM 在有限监督下改善了分割和分类，并在异质成像条件下实现了高保真的图像增强。涉及两个内部中心和四个外部中心共 4,796 例卒中患者的多中心临床验证表明，其适用于围绕卒中队列的三项临床相关任务。盲法读片者评估显示，BrainGFM 生成的 FLAIR 图像在整体诊断质量上接近实际采集的 FLAIR。在一项人机协作研究中，BrainGFM 辅助使放射科医师卒中分型的平均准确率相对提高了 14%。这些发现支持将生成式先验作为异质计算脑成像应用的可复用基础。

title: A Scoping Review of Deep Learning Methods for Photoplethysmography Data.
zh_title: 光电容积描记（PPG）深度学习方法的范围综述
summary: 系统检索2017至2025年文献，纳入460篇将深度学习用于PPG信号分析的论文，从任务、模型和数据三个角度归纳。
key_points: 纳入460篇PPG深度学习论文
从任务、模型、数据三角度分析
覆盖临床监测与可穿戴设备应用
reason: 纳入文献量大的范围综述，可穿戴方向略加分
abstract: [Health data science] Background: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is a noninvasive optical sensing technique widely used to capture hemodynamic information, with broad deployment in both clinical monitoring systems and wearable devices. In recent years, the integration of deep learning has substantially advanced PPG signal analysis and expanded its applications across healthcare and nonhealthcare domains. Methods: We conducted a comprehensive literature search for studies applying deep learning to PPG data published between 2017 January 1 and 2025 December 31, using Google Scholar, PubMed, and Dimensions. The included studies were analyzed from 3 key perspectives: tasks, models, and data. Results: A total of 460 papers applying deep learning techniques to PPG signal analysis were included. These studies span a wide range of application domains, from traditional physiological monitoring tasks such as cardiovascular assessment to emerging applications including sleep analysis, cross-modality signal reconstruction, and biometric identification. Conclusions: Deep learning has substantially advanced PPG signal analysis by enabling more effective extraction of physiological information. Compared with traditional machine learning approaches reliant on handcrafted features, deep learning methods generally achieve improved performance and offer greater flexibility in model development. Nevertheless, several challenges remain, including limited availability of large-scale high-quality datasets, insufficient validation in real-world environments, and concerns over model interpretability, scalability, and computational efficiency. Addressing these challenges and exploring emerging research directions will be essential for further progress in deep learning-based PPG analysis.
zh_abstract: [健康数据科学]【背景】光电容积脉搏波描记法（photoplethysmography，PPG）是一种无创光学传感技术，广泛用于获取血流动力学信息，在临床监测系统和可穿戴设备中均有广泛应用。近年来，深度学习的引入显著推动了PPG信号分析的发展，并拓展了其在医疗健康及非医疗领域的应用。【方法】我们使用Google Scholar、PubMed和Dimensions，对2017年1月1日至2025年12月31日期间发表的将深度学习应用于PPG数据的研究进行了全面的文献检索。从任务、模型和数据3个关键角度对纳入的研究进行了分析。【结果】共纳入460篇将深度学习技术应用于PPG信号分析的论文。这些研究涵盖广泛的应用领域，既包括心血管评估等传统生理监测任务，也包括睡眠分析、跨模态信号重建和生物特征识别等新兴应用。【结论】深度学习通过更有效地提取生理信息，显著推动了PPG信号分析的发展。与依赖手工特征的传统机器学习方法相比，深度学习方法总体上取得了更好的性能，并在模型开发方面具有更大的灵活性。然而，仍存在若干挑战，包括大规模高质量数据集的可获得性有限、在真实环境中的验证不足，以及对模型可解释性、可扩展性和计算效率的担忧。应对这些挑战并探索新兴研究方向，对于基于深度学习的PPG分析取得进一步进展至关重要。

title: Silent Manipulation of Mental Health Treatment Recommendations From a Large Language Model.
zh_title: 大语言模型心理健康治疗建议可被悄然操纵
summary: 研究对开源权重LLM（DeepSeek V4 Flash）施加推理时激活引导，考察其抑郁症建议在12个情景中能否被不经提示地改变。
key_points: 使用方向性激活引导，不改权重与提示
12个抑郁建议情景，30档幅度加基线
指向LLM心理健康建议被隐蔽操纵的安全风险
reason: 心理健康LLM安全议题新颖，但为非人类受试的单模型小规模研究
abstract: Importance: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly inform mental health decisions by patients and clinicians. Inference-time activation steering can shift model behavior on a target dimension without altering weights or prompts and without disclosure to users, allowing treatment recommendations to be silently changed for commercial or ideological reasons. Objective: To determine whether directional activation steering can shift an open-weights LLM's depression treatment recommendations. Design Setting and Participants: This non-human subjects study applied directional activation steering to an open-weights LLM (DeepSeek V4 Flash) responding to 12 depression-advice scenarios (4 favoring medication, 4 favoring avoidance, 4 neutral), generated at 30 amplitudes from -1.5 to +1.5 in 0.1 increments plus an unsteered baseline. Exposures: A single steering direction contrasting antidepressant medication with self-directed approaches (diet, exercise, meditation, dietary supplements), constructed from 16 paired training prompts and applied at the attention output of every transformer block; weights and system prompt were held constant. Main Outcomes and Measures: The extent to which medication and four self-care categories were addressed, scored 0 to 3 by a human-validated LLM rater (Claude Opus 4.7), the medication-versus-self-care balance, and clinician referral, estimated per unit of amplitude using mixed-effects models with a scenario random intercept. Results: Across 372 generations, steering produced a graded, dose-dependent shift in the medication-versus-self-care balance, which declined by 0.32 per unit of amplitude (β = -0.32; 95% CI, -0.39 to -0.25; P < .001); medication extent fell and self-care extent rose. The shift was largest for scenarios with no stated treatment preference (β = -0.44; 95% CI, -0.54 to -0.34; P < .001). A clinician referral appeared in 322 of 372 responses (87%) and did not vary with steering amplitude (P = .63). Conclusions and Relevance: In this open-weights LLM providing depression treatment information, inference-time activation steering shifted treatment recommendations without altering weights, prompt structure, or safety outputs, with the largest effect among users expressing no treatment preference. These findings suggest a need for LLM disclosure standards and independent auditing as such models inform clinical decisions.
zh_abstract: 【重要性】大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地为患者和临床医生的心理健康决策提供参考。推理时激活转向（activation steering）可以在不改变模型权重或提示词、且不向用户披露的情况下，改变模型在目标维度上的行为，从而可能出于商业或意识形态原因悄然改变治疗建议。【目的】确定定向激活转向是否能改变开放权重 LLM 的抑郁症治疗建议。【设计、设置和参与者】这项非人类受试者研究将定向激活转向应用于一个开放权重 LLM（DeepSeek V4 Flash），使其回应 12 个抑郁症建议情景（4 个倾向药物治疗、4 个倾向回避、4 个中性），在 -1.5 至 +1.5 之间以 0.1 为增量的 30 个幅度下生成，另加一个未转向的基线。【暴露】单一转向方向，对比抗抑郁药物与自我导向方法（饮食、运动、冥想、膳食补充剂），由 16 对配对训练提示构建，并应用于每个 transformer 块的注意力输出；权重和系统提示保持不变。【主要结局和指标】药物治疗及四类自我护理被论及的程度，由经人工验证的 LLM 评分者（Claude Opus 4.7）按 0 至 3 分评分；药物与自我护理的平衡；以及临床医生转诊。采用带情景随机截距的混合效应模型，估计每单位幅度的变化。【结果】在 372 次生成中，转向使药物与自我护理的平衡产生分级的、剂量依赖的变化，每单位幅度下降 0.32（β = -0.32；95% CI，-0.39 至 -0.25；P < .001）；药物论及程度下降，自我护理论及程度上升。在未表明治疗偏好的情景中变化最大（β = -0.44；95% CI，-0.54 至 -0.34；P < .001）。372 条回复中有 322 条（87%）出现临床医生转诊建议，且不随转向幅度变化（P = .63）。【结论与意义】在这一提供抑郁症治疗信息的开放权重 LLM 中，推理时激活转向在不改变权重、提示结构或安全性输出的情况下改变了治疗建议，且在未表达治疗偏好的用户中效应最大。这些发现提示，随着此类模型为临床决策提供参考，需要制定 LLM 披露标准并进行独立审计。

title: DiabAgent: Toward Agentic Physiological Control
zh_title: DiabAgent：面向生理控制的智能体框架
summary: 提出含APC框架、DiabetSim模拟器和SweetBench基准的研究套件，评估语言模型智能体通过医疗设备工具持续调控1型糖尿病血糖的能力。
key_points: APC通过设备工具推断个体状态并选择治疗动作
DiabetSim模拟不同患者、事件与设备条件
SweetBench用于系统量化评估
reason: 预印本，新颖智能体与基准，仅模拟环境验证
abstract: As pretraining scales, medical language models have advanced rapidly in clinical question answering. Their ability to achieve effective physiological control through sustained intervention still lacks systematic quantitative evaluation. Type 1 diabetes provides a concrete setting: impaired insulin secretion creates dependence on exogenous insulin, with dosing continually adjusted using information about meals, exercise, illness, and glucose measurements. We introduce DiabAgent, a research suite for agentic physiological control comprising the Agentic Physiological Control (APC) framework, the DiabetSim simulator, and the SweetBench benchmark. APC controls glucose through medical-device tools, using ongoing observations to infer individual states, accumulate personal experience, and choose treatment actions. We build DiabetSim to simulate different patients, events, and device conditions for scalable virtual testing and training. Using DiabetSim, we construct SweetBench by instantiating 32 scenario designs as 212 glucose-control tasks. With Claude Opus 5.5 and a fixed decision interval of one hour, APC achieves a COGI of 73.5, compared with 71.2 for the open-source closed-loop baseline OpenAPS. Ablations further show that individual adaptation and contextual information improve glucose control. Combining high-frequency rule-based control with lower-frequency agent decisions shows potential for balancing control performance and computational cost. Our work provides a framework, simulator, and evaluation foundation for agents to participate in human physiological control.
zh_abstract: 随着预训练规模的扩大，医学语言模型在临床问答方面进展迅速。然而，它们通过持续干预实现有效生理控制的能力仍缺乏系统的定量评估。1型糖尿病提供了一个具体场景：胰岛素分泌受损导致对外源性胰岛素的依赖，剂量需根据进餐、运动、疾病和血糖测量等信息持续调整。我们提出 DiabAgent，这是一个面向智能体生理控制的研究套件，包括智能体生理控制（Agentic Physiological Control，APC）框架、DiabetSim 模拟器和 SweetBench 基准。APC 通过医疗设备工具控制血糖，利用持续观察来推断个体状态、积累个人经验并选择治疗措施。我们构建了 DiabetSim，以模拟不同的患者、事件和设备条件，用于可扩展的虚拟测试和训练。利用 DiabetSim，我们将32种场景设计实例化为212个血糖控制任务，构建了 SweetBench。在使用 Claude Opus 5.5 且决策间隔固定为一小时的条件下，APC 的 COGI 为73.5，而开源闭环基线 OpenAPS 为71.2。消融实验进一步表明，个体适应和情境信息可改善血糖控制。将高频基于规则的控制与低频智能体决策相结合，显示出在控制性能与计算成本之间取得平衡的潜力。我们的工作为智能体参与人体生理控制提供了框架、模拟器和评估基础。

title: Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry
zh_title: Every Pixel Is an Option：用于医学超声生物测量的System One模型
summary: 提出视觉-语言模型Kev-Bio，通过临床测量问题引导超声标志点检测，并建模空间似然分布以表达定位不确定性。
key_points: 以文本指令统一不同超声测量任务
生成空间似然而非直接预测坐标
旨在减少人工卡尺放置的操作者间差异，预印本
reason: 视觉-语言模型用于超声，有新意，摘要无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: **Purpose:** Ultrasound biometry is widely used across various clinical applications, including prenatal and cardiac examinations, to obtain quantitative measurements by placing calipers at anatomical landmarks. However, these measurements remain subject to interoperator variability as they rely largely on manual caliper placement. Conventional methods often use specialized prediction heads for different ultrasound tasks, whereas vision-language models offer flexibility through text instructions. However, direct coordinate prediction does not explicitly model spatial likelihood distributions, limiting the representation of localization ambiguity. **Methods:** We propose Kev-Bio, a vision-language model that uses clinical measurement questions to guide ultrasound landmark detection. Inspired by System One decision models, Kev-Bio uses decision representations of the language model to generate queries for each caliper endpoint. These queries are matched against shared dense ultrasound features to produce spatial probability maps, from which landmark coordinates and clinical measurements are derived. The model is trained end-to-end using both landmark localization and clinical measurement losses. **Results:** On the nine-view FU/GU Biometry 2026 dataset, Kev-Bio achieves a mean radial error (MRE) of 22.50 pixels and a clinical measurement mean absolute error (MAE) of 15.38, outperforming the compared baselines in overall performance. **Conclusion:** These results demonstrate the effectiveness of Kev-Bio for ultrasound landmark detection and clinical measurement across different anatomical views. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/Kev-Bio.

title: Tracing the Scientific Discovery Capacity of LLMs to Their Training Data
zh_title: 将LLM科学发现能力溯源至训练数据
summary: 提出以单次出现事实（monofact）解释LLM科学发现能力，在材料科学与调控基因组学中操控其比例，发现比例越高发现越多。
key_points: 在材料科学与调控基因组学中验证
操控训练集monofact率，两类开源模型均一致
无法仅由训练集多样性解释
reason: AI科学发现方向，有受控实验，但属预印本
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show growing promise for scientific discovery, yet basic questions remain about what enables reliable discovery. How can we trace the scientific discovery capacity of LLMs to their training data? We study this question as one of missing probability mass and develop a theoretical account in which monofacts-the facts observed once during training-set the discovery capacity. In materials science and regulatory genomics, we directly manipulate monofact rates in training sets and find that more monofacts consistently yield more discoveries across two open-weight model families, sampling strategies, and reasoning budgets. Further experiments show the relationship cannot be explained by training-set diversity alone and can transfer across scientific domains when paired with in-domain data. Together, our results identify monofact rate in training data as a key factor governing discoveries in language models.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在科学发现方面展现出越来越大的前景，但关于是什么使可靠的发现成为可能，仍有一些基本问题尚未解决。我们如何将LLM的科学发现能力追溯到其训练数据？我们将这一问题作为缺失概率质量的问题来研究，并提出一个理论解释：单事实（monofacts，即训练中仅出现一次的事实）决定发现能力。在材料科学和调控基因组学中，我们直接操控训练集中的单事实比率，发现在两个开放权重模型家族、不同采样策略和推理预算下，单事实越多，发现持续越多。进一步实验表明，这一关系不能仅由训练集多样性来解释，并且在与领域内数据配合时可以跨科学领域迁移。总之，我们的结果表明，训练数据中的单事实比率是决定语言模型发现能力的关键因素。

title: MIMIC-Note-Extract: A Large-Scale Structured Dataset Extracted from MIMIC-IV-Note Discharge Summaries
zh_title: MIMIC-Note-Extract：从MIMIC-IV出院小结提取的大规模结构化数据集
summary: 该数据集用确定性解析结合模式引导的LLM生成，将30万余份出院小结的16个章节转为结构化表格，补充MIMIC缺失的病史等信息。
key_points: 处理300,720份出院小结、16个章节
混合提取流程：确定性解析加LLM生成
病史条目数量较原有增加约10倍
reason: 大规模公开数据集，惠及EHR研究；预印本，摘要未见质量验证
abstract: MIMIC is one of the most widely used public hospital datasets for machine learning on electronic health records, yet clinically important information, such as past medical history, allergies, and diagnostic findings, remains confined to free-text discharge summaries. Studies requiring this information must therefore build their own extraction pipelines, duplicating substantial effort across projects. We release MIMIC-Note-Extract (MNE), a large-scale dataset that uses a hybrid extraction pipeline combining deterministic parsing with schema-guided large language model generation to transform 16 sections from 300,720 discharge summaries into structured tables. MNE adds information that has no structured MIMIC counterpart and enriches related tables with broader coverage and greater clinical detail, including 10 times more patient-history entries and medication histories for more than twice as many admissions. Validation by medical doctors confirms extraction accuracy above 92% across sections. Using MNE, we construct a clinical decision-making benchmark for LLM agents, demonstrating how reusable structured representations of clinical narratives reduce data curation effort.
zh_abstract: MIMIC是用于电子健康记录机器学习的使用最广泛的公开医院数据集之一，但诸如既往病史、过敏史和诊断发现等临床重要信息仍局限于自由文本的出院小结中。因此，需要这些信息的研究必须自行构建提取流程，造成各项目间大量重复劳动。我们发布了MIMIC-Note-Extract（MNE），这是一个大规模数据集，采用将确定性解析与基于模式（schema）引导的大语言模型生成相结合的混合提取流程，将300,720份出院小结中的16个章节转换为结构化表格。MNE补充了MIMIC中没有对应结构化数据的信息，并以更广的覆盖范围和更丰富的临床细节充实了相关表格，包括患者病史条目增加10倍，以及用药史所涵盖的入院次数增加一倍以上。医生验证证实各章节的提取准确率均高于92%。利用MNE，我们构建了一个面向大语言模型智能体的临床决策基准，展示了临床叙述的可复用结构化表示如何减少数据整理工作量。

title: El Agente Fármaco: A Scalable AI Scientist for Drug Discovery
zh_title: El Agente Fármaco：可扩展的药物发现AI科学家
summary: 提出基于LLM的智能体，将自然语言目标转为可扩展计算筛选流程，并以共享科学记忆Fármaco Atlas记录分子、结构与结果溯源。
key_points: 智能体自主选择工具、审阅结果并调整步骤
Fármaco Atlas存储数据及其来源
单次请求可对整批分子启动计算
reason: 药物发现AI科学家智能体命中偏好，但为预印本且摘要无验证细节
abstract: Computational drug discovery offers a growing range of tools for proposing and evaluating molecules, but combining them and deciding what to do next still requires substantial expert effort. Here, we introduce El Agente Fármaco, an AI scientist that uses modern large language model (LLM) technology to turn discovery goals expressed in everyday language into complex, scalable computational screening workflows. The agentic harness selects scientific tools, reviews their results, and adjusts subsequent steps to the target and the user's objectives. Our approach centers on a shared scientific memory: Fármaco Atlas, which stores molecules, structures, and results together with their provenance -- a record of how they were obtained. The agent uses targeted database queries to retrieve the evidence needed for each decision. A single request can launch calculations for an entire collection of molecules, without requiring a separate LLM decision for every compound. This design limits the information the model must process as screening collections grow, while keeping the underlying results available for inspection and further analysis. The integrated tools support molecule generation, prediction of binding and molecular properties, and searches for compounds available for purchase. In a retrospective comparison with an expert-led campaign, the agent proposed chemically distinct candidates with competitive docking scores and higher calculated drug-likeness under explicitly imposed selection criteria. In a 22-task benchmark against plain tool calls and Codex, the agent achieved the highest observed mean model-judged score, with lower median cumulative token use and peak context. Fármaco provides a foundation for flexible, scalable drug discovery workflows that connect scientific reasoning with an enduring, traceable record of computational work.
zh_abstract: 计算药物发现提供了越来越多用于提出和评估分子的工具，但将它们组合起来并决定下一步该做什么，仍需要大量专家投入。在此，我们介绍 El Agente Fármaco，这是一种 AI 科学家，利用现代大语言模型（LLM）技术，将以日常语言表达的发现目标转化为复杂、可扩展的计算筛选工作流。该智能体框架会选择科学工具、审查其结果，并根据靶点和用户目标调整后续步骤。我们的方法以共享的科学记忆为核心：Fármaco Atlas，它存储分子、结构和结果及其来源（即它们是如何获得的记录）。智能体使用有针对性的数据库查询来检索每个决策所需的证据。单个请求即可对整个分子集合启动计算，而无需对每个化合物单独进行一次 LLM 决策。这一设计限制了随着筛选集合增大模型必须处理的信息量，同时使底层结果可供检查和进一步分析。所集成的工具支持分子生成、结合及分子性质预测，以及可购买化合物的检索。在与专家主导的研究项目的回顾性比较中，在明确施加的筛选标准下，该智能体提出了化学结构不同的候选物，其对接评分具有竞争力，且计算得到的类药性更高。在针对单纯工具调用和 Codex 的 22 项任务基准测试中，该智能体取得了观察到的最高平均模型评判得分，同时累计 token 使用量中位数和峰值上下文更低。Fármaco 为灵活、可扩展的药物发现工作流奠定了基础，将科学推理与持久、可追溯的计算工作记录联系起来。

title: CardioVascBench:Prioritized Diagnosis Generation from Real-World Chinese Cardiovascular Records
zh_title: CardioVascBench：中文心血管病历的优先级诊断生成基准
summary: 发布含3,262例真实中文心血管住院病历的诊断生成基准，含ECG文本报告与ICD-10有序出院诊断，并评测36个系统。
key_points: 3,262例脱敏病例，1,088例用于评测
提供英文翻译评测集，支持跨语言比较
主诊断准确率高不代表列表精确率高
reason: 新的真实病历基准，评测36个系统，但规模中等且为预印本
abstract: Identifying the primary diagnosis alone does not fully characterize a model's diagnosis-generation performance. We introduce CardioVascBench, a retrospective benchmark for prioritized diagnosis generation from real-world Chinese cardiovascular inpatient records. It contains 3,262 de-identified cases, with 2,174 for training and 1,088 for evaluation, linking clinical narratives and textual ECG reports to expert-verified, ordered discharge diagnoses standardized to ICD-10. An English translation of the evaluation set supports aligned cross-lingual comparison. Our evaluation protocol combines terminology normalization and rank-aware scoring to separately assess primary-diagnosis identification, reference-diagnosis coverage, and list precision. Evaluation across 36 systems shows that higher primary-diagnosis accuracy does not necessarily imply higher list precision against discharge references. We also provide CardioKG-Agent, a knowledge-enhanced baseline combining entity normalization, constrained graph retrieval, and guideline evidence. In a staged comparison of three baseline models, supervised fine-tuning plus the agent achieves a 73.5% higher mean composite score than fine-tuning alone, representing a system-level gain. These results measure retrospective agreement with recorded diagnoses; agreement between metric rankings and physician judgments remains to be validated. CardioVascBench supports research on diagnosis prioritization and knowledge-enhanced generation.
zh_abstract: 仅识别主要诊断并不能全面刻画模型的诊断生成性能。我们提出了CardioVascBench，这是一个基于真实世界中文心血管住院病历、用于优先排序诊断生成的回顾性基准。该基准包含3,262例去标识化病例，其中2,174例用于训练，1,088例用于评估，将临床叙述和文本形式的心电图报告与经专家核实、按顺序排列且标准化为ICD-10的出院诊断相关联。评估集的英文翻译支持对齐的跨语言比较。我们的评估方案结合术语规范化和考虑排名的评分，分别评估主要诊断识别、参考诊断覆盖率和列表精确度。对36个系统的评估表明，较高的主要诊断准确率并不一定意味着相对于出院参考诊断具有更高的列表精确度。我们还提供了CardioKG-Agent，这是一个知识增强的基线，结合了实体规范化、受约束的图检索和指南证据。在对三个基线模型的分阶段比较中，监督微调加该智能体的平均综合得分比单独微调高73.5%，体现了系统层面的提升。这些结果衡量的是与已记录诊断之间的回顾性一致性；指标排名与医师判断之间的一致性仍有待验证。CardioVascBench支持诊断优先排序和知识增强生成方面的研究。

title: Measuring Model-Specific Alignment Drift in LLM-Based Opinion Dynamics
zh_title: 基于LLM的观点动力学中的模型特异性对齐漂移
summary: 研究LLM智能体在多轮政策讨论中的立场变化，发现人设在无同伴时稳定，讨论引发的对齐漂移因模型而异，涉及六个LLM。
key_points: 无同伴输入时人设20轮保持稳定
漂移由交互引起且具模型特异性
不同模型保持观点分群的程度不同
reason: 智能体社会模拟方向，质疑合成参与者假设有方法学意义，预印本
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as synthetic participants in opinion-dynamics experiments, often assuming that an agent's behaviour is fully determined by its prompt. We test this assumption with a framework in which LLM agents discuss a contested policy issue over repeated rounds while their stance is quantified by a fixed psychometric instrument independent of any dynamics model. Across six LLMs, committed personas are intrinsically stable: in each of the five models tested without peer input, every agent keeps its assigned side for 20 rounds. The observed loss of alignment under discussion is therefore interaction-induced, we call it alignment drift, and model-specific: gpt-4.1 keeps opinion clusters apart, claude-sonnet-5 holds them partially, and gpt-5.6-sol and claude-opus-5 abandon them. Under selective attention, one LLM maintains separated opinion clusters under stance-homophilous attention. Qualitative profiles persist at doubled population and horizon and on a second issue. Such heterogeneity makes the LLM choice a first-class validity variable for social simulation.

title: A Novel Conditional Adversarial Diffusion Model for High-Fidelity OCT-to-OCT Image Translation and Precise Anti-VEGF Therapy Response Prediction in Diabetic Macular Edema
zh_title: 条件对抗扩散模型用于OCT图像转换与DME抗VEGF疗效预测
summary: 提出条件对抗扩散框架，由基线OCT合成治疗后OCT，用于预测糖尿病黄斑水肿抗VEGF治疗反应；在美国队列(n=127)交叉验证并做外部验证。
key_points: 由基线OCT生成治疗后OCT图像
美国队列127例，受试者级5折交叉验证
包含外部队列验证
reason: 眼科治疗反应预测，有外部验证，但样本小、预印本
abstract: Diabetic macular edema (DME) is a leading cause of severe vision loss among working-age adults. Although intravitreal anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (anti-VEGF) injections currently serve as the first-line therapy for DME, a notable subset of patients fails to respond despite the substantial cost and clinical burden, suggesting they may benefit more from alternative interventions. Automated, noninvasive pre-treatment response assessment could therefore spare non-responders from the current trial-and-error treatment paradigm. In this study, we propose a novel conditional adversarial diffusion framework that synthesizes post-treatment optical coherence tomography (OCT) images from baseline scans, enabling the derivation of each patient's initial response to anti-VEGF therapy. The model was developed with subject-level 5-fold cross-validation on a US cohort (n = 127) and externally validated on an independent Iranian cohort (n = 44). Benchmarked against fourteen baseline and state-of-the-art translation models, the proposed model achieved the best treatment-response prediction performance among the methods evaluated for that task on both cohorts, with balanced accuracies of 85.7% and 93.0% on the US cohort and 85.2% and 95.3% on the external Iranian cohort at the 10% and 20% central subfield thickness reduction thresholds, respectively. Ultimately, this framework offers a decision-support tool to help ophthalmologists anticipate initial anti-VEGF outcomes in DME prior to treatment initiation, toward personalized therapy selection. The source code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
zh_abstract: 糖尿病性黄斑水肿（DME）是导致工作年龄成年人严重视力丧失的主要原因。尽管玻璃体腔内注射抗血管内皮生长因子（anti-VEGF）目前是DME的一线治疗方法，但仍有相当一部分患者尽管付出了高昂的费用和临床负担却对治疗无应答，提示这些患者可能更适合接受其他干预措施。因此，自动化、无创的治疗前应答评估可使无应答者免于当前反复试错的治疗模式。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新型条件对抗扩散框架，可根据基线扫描合成治疗后的光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像，从而推导出每位患者对anti-VEGF治疗的初始应答。该模型在美国队列（n = 127）上通过受试者水平的5折交叉验证进行开发，并在独立的伊朗队列（n = 44）上进行外部验证。与十四种基线模型和最先进的转换模型相比，所提出的模型在两个队列上均取得了在为该任务评估的方法中最佳的治疗应答预测性能：在中心子区厚度降低10%和20%的阈值下，美国队列的平衡准确率分别为85.7%和93.0%，外部伊朗队列的平衡准确率分别为85.2%和95.3%。最终，该框架提供了一种决策支持工具，可帮助眼科医生在开始治疗前预判DME患者对anti-VEGF的初始疗效，以实现个体化治疗选择。源代码将在论文被接受后公开。

title: Learning from Unlabeled Photographs for General Oral Image Analysis
zh_title: 从无标注照片学习通用口腔图像分析（DOVE）
summary: 预印本用约53万张无标注口腔照片自监督预训练DOVE编码器，在5个分类和4个分割数据集上优于3个基线。
key_points: 约53万张公开来源口腔照片自监督预训练
覆盖冻结骨干与端到端微调评估
少样本迁移与标签效率多数基准最佳
reason: 专科影像基础模型预印本，多基准对比，缺外部临床验证
abstract: Oral photographs contain rich clinical information and hold significant potential for artificial intelligence applications; however, most models are trained for individual tasks and rely on costly expert annotations. We hypothesized that self-supervised training on unlabeled oral photographs could produce transferable visual representations for heterogeneous vision tasks. To test this hypothesis, we developed DOVE (Dental Optical Visual Encoder) by domain-adaptive self-supervised pretraining on approximately 530,000 unlabeled oral photographs collected from publicly accessible sources. DOVE was benchmarked against 3 established baselines across 5 classification datasets and 4 segmentation datasets, covering both frozen backbone evaluation and end-to-end finetuning. DOVE achieved the strongest overall performance, ranking best in few-shot transfer and label efficiency on most benchmarks. Under the 20-shot frozen-backbone protocol, DOVE outperformed the second best DINOv3 by 4.37 percentage points in mean macro-F1 across classification datasets and by 4.49 percentage points in mean macro-Dice across segmentation tasks. Under end-to-end finetuning, DOVE achieved at least 80% of the strongest full-data baseline's performance across most evaluation datasets using only 10% of the labeled training data. Qualitative retrieval and feature analyses further indicated better organization of image-level and spatial representations. These findings support DOVE as a generalizable and label-efficient backbone for oral vision research.

title: Mitigating Spatial Blindness in Multiple Instance Learning for Whole-Slide Image Analysis
zh_title: 缓解全切片图像多示例学习中的空间盲区
summary: 提出ResTopoMIL，先冻结组成预测器再训练图残差并加坐标重分配分离损失，以解决WSI多示例学习对空间组织利用不足的问题。
key_points: 指出训练后的预测器未必真正利用组织邻域
受控空间任务AUC 0.987，联合训练仅0.684
分阶段训练在纯组成任务上性能保持较高
reason: 病理WSI新方法，有机制分析与对比；预印本，病理方向加分
abstract: Whole-slide multiple instance learning can predict diagnostic and prognostic labels from tissue composition while making limited use of spatial organization. Providing coordinates or a graph does not establish that a trained predictor uses tissue neighborhoods. We examine this gap as spatial blindness and hypothesize that early composition learning can weaken supervision of a spatial pathway. We introduce ResTopoMIL, which freezes a learned composition predictor before training a graph residual with a coordinate-reassignment separation loss. Permutation and information analyses distinguish architectural symmetry, available spatial information and the proposed optimization mechanism. On a controlled spatial task, staged training achieved an AUC of 0.987, compared with 0.684 for the same jointly trained architecture. Performance remained high on a composition-only task. Across four WSI classification and five survival benchmarks, ResTopoMIL improved mean primary performance on eight tasks; four improvements remained significant after Holm-adjusted patient-cluster tests. Coordinate-free residual controls recovered some of the gains, while neighborhood destruction reduced performance close to the composition anchor. Neighborhood-preserving transformations and anatomy-stratified perturbations further characterized this dependence. These results support fixing a composition reference as a practical intervention for learning spatial corrections, while retaining additional appearance capacity as a contributing explanation.

title: Intraoperative artificial intelligence for brain tumor surgery: from tissue diagnosis to real-time surgical guidance.
zh_title: 脑肿瘤手术中的术中AI：从组织诊断到实时导航
summary: 综述术中AI模型如何在手术现场实时提取脑胶质瘤分子与组织学信息，以弥补分子结果延迟到术后的缺口。

综述术中实时AI模型的现状

abstract: [Neurosurgical focus] The 2021 WHO CNS tumor classification marked a fundamental shift in neuro-oncology: molecular markers rather than histological appearance now define glioma diagnosis and guide treatment. Yet, in clinical practice the molecular information that matters most to a surgeon-IDH status, 1p/19q codeletion, and methylation class-typically arrives days to weeks after the operation it was meant to inform. Artificial intelligence (AI) is beginning to close that gap. Over the past several years, a growing body of work has demonstrated that AI models can extract diagnostically relevant molecular and histological information from data sources available in the operating room, in real time, at the point of surgical decision-making. In this review, the authors provide a comprehensive overview of state-of-the-art intraoperative AI models available to neurosurgeons during brain tumor resections. They examine AI-augmented approaches to established intraoperative techniques, such as cryosection and fluorescence-guided surgery, before turning to novel technologies including nanopore sequencing and stimulated Raman histology (SRH). The authors conclude by discussing barriers to widespread clinical adoption and what lies ahead for this field. For cryosection, models such as LGNet and the Cryosection Histopathology Assessment and Review Machine (CHARM) have demonstrated strong performance on intraoperative discrimination of primary CNS lymphoma and molecular subtyping of glioma, respectively, with CHARM achieving areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.88-0.93 across glioma subtypes. In fluorescence-guided surgery, hyperspectral imaging combined with machine learning has enabled classification of tumor type, grade, and IDH mutation based on the 5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA) signal with up to 93% accuracy, extracting molecular information from a modality already present in the operating room. For nanopore-based methylation classification, ensemble models such as Rapid Nanopore Brain Intraoperative Classification (ROBIN) have achieved 90% concordance with the final diagnosis prospectively in under 2 hours. In SRH, foundation models for infiltration detection now outperform FLAIR, contrast enhancement, and 5-ALA fluorescence in identifying tumor margins, while molecular classification models have achieved over 90% glioma subtype accuracy in multi-institutional cohorts. zh_abstract: [神经外科视角] 2021年WHO中枢神经系统肿瘤分类标志着神经肿瘤学的根本转变：目前是分子标志物而非组织学表现来定义胶质瘤诊断并指导治疗。然而在临床实践中，对外科医生最重要的分子信息——IDH状态、1p/19q共缺失和甲基化分类——通常在本应受其指导的手术之后数天至数周才获得。人工智能（AI）正开始弥合这一差距。过去几年中，越来越多的研究表明，AI模型可以从手术室中可获得的数据源中，在手术决策点实时提取具有诊断相关性的分子和组织学信息。在本综述中，作者全面概述了神经外科医生在脑肿瘤切除术中可用的最先进术中AI模型。他们先考察了AI增强的既有术中技术，如冰冻切片和荧光引导手术，随后转向纳米孔测序和受激拉曼组织学（SRH）等新技术。最后讨论了广泛临床应用的障碍以及该领域的未来。在冰冻切片方面，LGNet和冰冻切片组织病理学评估与审阅机器（CHARM）等模型分别在术中鉴别原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤和胶质瘤分子分型方面表现出色，其中CHARM在各胶质瘤亚型中的受试者工作特征曲线下面积为0.88-0.93。在荧光引导手术中，高光谱成像结合机器学习可基于5-氨基酮戊酸（5-ALA）信号对肿瘤类型、级别和IDH突变进行分类，准确率最高达93%，从手术室中已有的一种模态中提取了分子信息。在基于纳米孔的甲基化分类方面，快速纳米孔脑术中分类（ROBIN）等集成模型已在前瞻性研究中于2小时内达到与最终诊断90%的一致性。在SRH中，用于浸润检测的基础模型在识别肿瘤边缘方面现已优于FLAIR、对比增强和5-ALA荧光，而分子分类模型在多机构队列中的胶质瘤亚型准确率已超过90%。在单细胞水平，SRH图像的形态计量分析揭示了核特征 di（原文此处截断）

title: Findings-aware Language-Image Pretraining for CT Volume Interpretation
zh_title: 面向CT体积解读的发现感知语言-图像预训练
summary: 预印本提出监督式表示学习框架，借助语言基础模型的临床知识，改进CT与放射报告的CLIP式对比预训练中将不同病例一律视为负样本的做法。
key_points: 指出CLIP式预训练把不同病例都当负样本不适合临床相似情形
提出基于语言基础模型临床知识的监督表示学习
面向CT体积与放射报告的视觉-语言基础模型
reason: CT视觉-语言基础模型新方法预印本，摘要中证据有限；命中偏好上调
abstract: Computed tomography (CT) provides diverse patient information and various clinical tasks, for which numerous deep learning models have been investigated. Recent years have seen the development of vision-language foundation models that can comprehensively extract clinical features, driven by representation learning that combines CT volumes with radiology reports. Existing approaches typically adopt Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)-based representation learning, where pairs from different cases are, in principle, treated as negative pairs such that the volume and report embeddings are pushed apart. In the biomedical imaging, however, treating different cases as negative pairs is not always appropriate, particularly when clinical similarity exists. In this study, we propose a supervised representation learning framework grounded in clinical knowledge from language foundation models, rather than the weak supervision used in CLIP. Specifically, we utilized a large language model to extract abnormal finding phrases from reports. We then explicitly constructed the target features that the image encoder should output, as the semantic representation of the extracted findings using a biomedical text embedding model. Our Findings-aware Language-Image Pre-training (FiLIP) outperformed weakly supervised approaches in multi-label zero-shot finding classification in both in-domain and external-domain evaluations, and also proved effective when fine-tuned for the downstream task of radiology report generation.
zh_abstract: 计算机断层扫描（CT）可提供多样的患者信息并支持多种临床任务，为此已有大量深度学习模型被研究。近年来，在将CT容积与放射学报告相结合的表征学习推动下，能够全面提取临床特征的视觉-语言基础模型不断发展。现有方法通常采用基于对比语言-图像预训练（Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training，CLIP）的表征学习，其中来自不同病例的配对原则上被视为负样本对，从而使容积嵌入与报告嵌入相互远离。然而，在生物医学影像中，将不同病例视为负样本对并不总是合适，尤其是在存在临床相似性时。在本研究中，我们提出一种监督式表征学习框架，其依据来自语言基础模型的临床知识，而非CLIP所采用的弱监督。具体而言，我们利用大语言模型从报告中提取异常发现短语，随后使用生物医学文本嵌入模型，将所提取发现的语义表示明确构建为图像编码器应当输出的目标特征。我们提出的发现感知语言-图像预训练（Findings-aware Language-Image Pre-training，FiLIP）在域内和外部域评估的多标签零样本发现分类中均优于弱监督方法，并且在针对放射学报告生成这一下游任务进行微调时同样有效。

title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
zh_title: HistoTx：H&E图像与空间转录组的早期融合自监督学习
summary: 提出早期融合ViT，将任意分辨率的转录本token与图像patch token在共享Transformer中联合处理，基于预训练病理模型。
key_points: 转录组作为真正输入模态而非仅训练信号
转录本token可在任意空间分辨率构建
从预训练纯视觉病理模型出发
reason: 病理多模态新方法预印本，有基础模型相关性，证据有限
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.

title: MedHEB: Benchmarking Medical Embeddings Across Heterogeneous Clinical Evidence
zh_title: MedHEB：跨异构临床证据的医学嵌入基准
summary: 提出含107个检索任务、54个数据集的基准，覆盖2D/3D图像与文本，评估基础模型嵌入在模态、外观与粒度变化下的证据检索。
key_points: 涵盖证据形式、配对类型、相关粒度三轴
包含分布内与留出来源评估
面向医学基础模型的嵌入检索
reason: 大规模多模态医学嵌入基准，预印本，契合基础模型偏好
abstract: Clinical evidence is inherently relational: medical images are interpreted with prior studies, cross-modal examinations, reports, and localized findings, and retrieving relevant evidence is therefore central to clinical interpretation. Recent foundation models increasingly encode these heterogeneous sources into shared embedding spaces, yet existing embedding evaluation often focuses on isolated matches, leaving unclear whether current models retrieve relevant evidence across changes in modality, appearance, and granularity. We introduce MedHEB, a unified benchmark with 107 retrieval tasks from 54 datasets, including both in-distribution and held-out-source evaluation, across three axes: evidence form (2D images, 3D volumes, text), pairing type (image--image, image--text, text--text, and modality-bridging visual matching), and relevance granularity (global, question-conditioned, region-level). Under a single ranking protocol, MedHEB varies clinically relevant evidence definitions to test whether embedding proximity remains meaningful across heterogeneous evidence, including modality-bridging visual retrieval and region-level text-to-region retrieval. Across representative models, performance is uneven across retrieval families: models strong on conventional image--text or text--text retrieval are less reliable on modality-bridging and region-level tasks. Current embedding spaces capture some clinical relationships well but do not yet provide balanced retrieval across heterogeneous evidence. We further provide MedEmb, an MLLM-based reference embedding model trained on the MedHEB ID split, as a reproducible baseline for unified 2D--3D--text medical retrieval. We release MedHEB with preprocessing scripts, evaluation code, access manifests, and MedEmb to support research on clinically meaningful medical embeddings.
zh_abstract: 临床证据本质上是关联性的：医学影像需结合既往检查、跨模态检查、报告及局部发现来解读，因此检索相关证据对临床判读至关重要。近期的基础模型越来越多地将这些异质来源编码到共享嵌入空间中，但现有的嵌入评估往往聚焦于孤立的匹配，因此尚不清楚当前模型能否在模态、外观和粒度变化的情况下检索到相关证据。我们提出了MedHEB，这是一个统一基准，包含来自54个数据集的107个检索任务，涵盖分布内和留出来源评估，沿三个维度展开：证据形式（2D图像、3D体数据、文本）、配对类型（图像—图像、图像—文本、文本—文本以及跨模态桥接的视觉匹配）和相关性粒度（全局、问题条件化、区域级）。在统一的排序协议下，MedHEB改变临床相关的证据定义，以检验嵌入邻近性在异质证据中是否仍然有意义，包括跨模态桥接的视觉检索和区域级的文本到区域检索。在代表性模型中，各检索类别的表现不均衡：在传统图像—文本或文本—文本检索上表现强劲的模型，在跨模态桥接和区域级任务上可靠性较低。当前的嵌入空间能很好地捕捉某些临床关系，但尚未在异质证据之间提供均衡的检索。我们进一步提供了MedEmb，这是一个基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）、在MedHEB ID划分上训练的参考嵌入模型，作为统一2D—3D—文本医学检索的可复现基线。我们发布了MedHEB及其预处理脚本、评估代码、访问清单和MedEmb，以支持对具有临床意义的医学嵌入的研究。

title: Cost-effectiveness analysis of digital medicine support models for alcohol use disorder
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: 酒精使用障碍数字医学支持模式的成本效果分析
summary: 基于558人RCT比较三种数字医学支持模式的成本效果。
key_points: 主题为酒精使用障碍
评估数字医学支持模式
采用成本效益分析
reason: 数字干预经济学分析，与AI/算法关系弱
abstract: Alcohol use disorder (AUD) is a major public health issue yet often under-addressed in primary care. Digital health interventions offer scalable support, but health systems require economic data to guide implementation decision-making. In a randomized clinical trial involving 558 participants registered at clinicaltrials.gov (NCT04011644; July 3, 2019), we compared three support models built on a shared digital medicine platform: self-monitored use (SM), peer-supported use (PS), and clinically integrated use (CI). We estimated delivery costs and effectiveness based on reductions in heavy drinking days. Annualized reductions in heavy drinking days were 42.4, 40.2, and 48.3 days per patient for SM, PS, and CI models, with per-patient costs of $162, $524, and $802, respectively. Average cost-effectiveness was $3.8 (SM), $13.0 (PS), and $16.6 (CI); PS was dominated, and the ICER for CI versus SM was $107.9. When downstream healthcare utilization was included, results suggested that more intensive support may be economically advantageous. Modeling implementation at scale showed that PS becomes cost-efficient for large patient populations. These findings highlight that no single model is universally optimal: health systems may benefit from offering multiple support levels to match patient preferences and organizational capacity.
zh_abstract: 酒精使用障碍（AUD）是一个重大的公共卫生问题，但在基层医疗中往往未得到充分处理。数字健康干预可提供可扩展的支持，但卫生系统需要经济学数据来指导实施决策。在一项纳入 558 名参与者、已在 clinicaltrials.gov 注册（NCT04011644；2019 年 7 月 3 日）的随机临床试验中，我们比较了建立在同一数字医学平台上的三种支持模式：自我监测使用（SM）、同伴支持使用（PS）和临床整合使用（CI）。我们基于重度饮酒日数的减少来估算提供成本和效果。SM、PS 和 CI 模式下每位患者每年重度饮酒日数的减少分别为 42.4、40.2 和 48.3 天，每位患者成本分别为 162 美元、524 美元和 802 美元。平均成本效果分别为 3.8 美元（SM）、13.0 美元（PS）和 16.6 美元（CI）；PS 属于被占优策略，CI 相对于 SM 的增量成本效果比（ICER）为 107.9 美元。当纳入下游医疗服务利用时，结果提示更强化的支持在经济上可能更具优势。大规模实施的建模显示，对于大量患者人群，PS 具有成本效率。这些发现表明不存在普遍最优的单一模式：卫生系统可通过提供多种支持层级，以匹配患者偏好和机构能力。

title: AI-based structural modelling and pathogenic variant mapping across the human protein interactome
zh_title: 人类蛋白互作组的AI结构建模与致病变异定位
summary: 对109,282个人类蛋白互作结构进行AI建模，系统表征界面特征，并将致病变异映射到结构上，覆盖4000多种疾病类别。
key_points: 建模109,282个蛋白互作结构
分析界面残基、埋藏表面积与能量特性
以AML、阿尔茨海默病、心肌病为例
reason: 大规模结构资源预印本，但摘要未见实验验证
abstract: Spanning the complex landscape of the human proteome, physical interactions between proteins coordinate cellular organization, signaling, regulation, and homeostasis. Yet the three-dimensional structures of most of these interactions remain unresolved. Here, we performed AI-based modelling of 109,282 human protein interaction structures, generating a structural resource for large-scale analysis. The predicted structures were systematically characterized through analysis of interface residue involvement, buried surface area, intermolecular bonding, and energetic properties. Additionally, we mapped pathogenic variant data onto the predicted structures, identifying interface-localized mutations for over 4,000 annotated disease categories. Acute myeloid leukemia, Alzheimer's disease, and cardiomyopathy were examined as representative disease contexts for exploring the distribution of interface mutations within disease-associated protein interaction networks. Strengths and limitations of predictive capabilities were also assessed, including through experimental structure comparisons. Collectively, this structural resource and accompanying analyses offer a basis for developing novel hypotheses and informing experimental studies involving human protein interactions in physiological and disease contexts.
zh_abstract: 在人类蛋白质组的复杂图景中，蛋白质之间的物理相互作用协调着细胞组织、信号传导、调控和稳态。然而，其中大多数相互作用的三维结构仍未解析。在此，我们基于AI对109,282个人类蛋白质相互作用结构进行了建模，生成了可用于大规模分析的结构资源。我们通过分析界面残基参与情况、埋藏表面积、分子间键合和能量特性，对预测结构进行了系统表征。此外，我们将致病变异数据映射到预测结构上，识别出涉及4,000多个已注释疾病类别的界面定位突变。我们以急性髓系白血病、阿尔茨海默病和心肌病作为代表性疾病背景，探讨了界面突变在疾病相关蛋白质相互作用网络中的分布。我们还评估了预测能力的优势与局限，包括通过与实验结构的比较。总体而言，该结构资源及配套分析为提出新假设以及指导涉及生理和疾病背景下人类蛋白质相互作用的实验研究提供了基础。

title: BioResearchBench: 50 Long Horizon Biological Research Tasks
zh_title: BioResearchBench：50个长程生物学研究任务基准
summary: 预印本提出由博士生物学家设计的50个跨10个子领域的长程研究任务基准，并对多款前沿模型进行比较评估。

含测序、蛋白质组、显微图像和临床数据
比较多个前沿模型的结果与响应

abstract: AI models are used in biology research to study disease mechanisms, discover potential treatments, analyze experimental data, troubleshoot problems, and plan next steps. Useful assistance depends on working with data in various scientific formats, interpreting results, and deciding what to test next. We present BioResearchBench, a benchmark of 50 research questions developed by PhD biologists drawing on their deep research expertise to reflect realistic problems encountered in their fields. Questions were refined through expert review and iterative model testing. The collection spans 10 diverse biology subdomains and includes sequencing data, proteomic measurements, microscopy images, assay readouts, and clinical datasets. We compared recorded outcomes and examined model responses in depth across the 50 tasks on OpenAI GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, Meta Muse Wonder, and SpaceXSI Grok 4.7. Success across our benchmark was 18% for Claude Opus 5.5, 13% for Gemini 4 Argon, 11% for Meta Muse Wonder, 4% for GPT-6 Astra, and 4% for Grok 4.7. These results describe a deliberately challenging collection selected through expert review and model testing. Despite low whole task success, the selected responses met most rubric requirements on average: the average fraction of criteria missed ranged from 18% to 32% across models. Across models, the proportion of eligible tasks with at least one category failure was highest in computation and data handling (66.9% failure), followed by uncertainty and identification (55.3% failure), reporting and completeness (54.7% failure), biological interpretation (39.0% failure), controls and causal claims (37.2% failure), and choosing the next experiment or decision (31.0% failure). Gemini 4 Argon had the highest proportion of reviewed tasks without a recorded category failure in computation and data handling (45% success) and biological interpretation (69% success). Claude Opus 5.5 led in controls and causal claims (72% success) and choosing the next experiment or decision (75% success). GPT-6 Astra led in uncertainty and identification (56% success) which included judging the precision of estimates and recognizing when measurements could not distinguish between biological explanations. GPT-6 Astra and Meta Muse Wonder tied for the highest proportion of answers with no recorded omissions or reporting failures (51% success). Five case studies presented here show how top AI models can perform many analytical steps corre
zh_abstract: 人工智能模型被用于生物学研究，以研究疾病机制、发现潜在治疗方法、分析实验数据、排查问题并规划后续步骤。有效的辅助取决于处理各种科学格式的数据、解释结果以及决定下一步要检验什么。我们提出BioResearchBench，这是一个由生物学博士依据其深厚的研究专长、为反映其领域中遇到的真实问题而设计的包含50个研究问题的基准。这些问题经过专家评审和迭代式模型测试后得到完善。该集合涵盖10个不同的生物学子领域，包括测序数据、蛋白质组测量、显微镜图像、检测读数和临床数据集。我们比较了记录的结果，并对OpenAI GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5、Gemini 4 Argon、Meta Muse Wonder和SpaceXSI Grok 4.7在50项任务上的模型回答进行了深入考察。在我们的基准中，成功率分别为：Claude Opus 5.5为18%，Gemini 4 Argon为13%，Meta Muse Wonder为11%，GPT-6 Astra为4%，Grok 4.7为4%。这些结果描述的是一个经专家评审和模型测试而刻意选取的高难度集合。尽管整体任务成功率较低，所选回答平均仍满足大部分评分标准要求：各模型未满足标准的平均比例介于18%至32%之间。在各模型中，至少存在一个类别失败的合格任务所占比例，在计算与数据处理方面最高（66.9%失败），其次为不确定性与识别（55.3%失败）、报告与完整性（54.7%失败）、生物学解释（39.0%失败）、对照与因果论断（37.2%失败），以及选择下一步实验或决策（31.0%失败）。Gemini 4 Argon在计算与数据处理（45%成功）和生物学解释（69%成功）方面，无类别失败记录的已评审任务比例最高。Claude Opus 5.5在对照与因果论断（72%成功）和选择下一步实验或决策（75%成功）方面领先。GPT-6 Astra在不确定性与识别方面领先（56%成功），该类别包括判断估计的精确度，以及识别测量何时无法区分不同的生物学解释。GPT-6 Astra与Meta Muse Wonder并列，在无遗漏或报告失败记录的回答比例上最高（51%成功）。此处呈现的五个案例研究显示了顶级人工智能模型如何能够执行许多分析步骤并得出正确的corre
