title: Assessment, intervention, and ethical considerations of artificial intelligence for depression and suicide risk: A scoping review.
zh_title: AI用于抑郁与自杀风险：评估、干预与伦理的范围综述
summary: 按JBI与PRISMA-ScR方法检索2020年至2026年3月六个数据库，筛选5079条记录，纳入2844项研究，围绕评估诊断、对话式干预及伦理监管三条主线，并用新框架评估转化成熟度。
key_points: 筛选5079条记录，纳入2844项研究
覆盖评估诊断、对话式AI干预、伦理监管
提出评估转化成熟度的新框架
reason: 纳入研究量大的范围综述，综述类上限，心理健康方向略加分
abstract: [Psychiatry research] Depression and suicidal behavior constitute leading causes of global disease burden. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers promise for improving detection, intervention, and prevention, yet no comprehensive review has simultaneously mapped AI-driven assessment, intervention, and ethical considerations across both conditions. To systematically map AI applications for depression and suicide risk across three thematic axes: (1) assessment and diagnosis, (2) conversational AI and AI-driven interventions, and (3) ethical, equity, and regulatory considerations, and to evaluate translational maturity using a novel framework. Following JBI scoping review methodology and PRISMA-ScR guidelines, six databases were searched from January 2020 through March 2026. Two independent reviewers screened 5079 records using a two-stage process, yielding 2844 included studies (Cohen's kappa = 0.66). Data were extracted using a standardized charting form with AI-assisted full-text analysis. Assessment/diagnosis dominated (n = 1785), with fewer intervention studies (n = 318). Large language model-related studies rose from <1% (2020-2022) to 11.1% (2025) of included studies annually. Translational Readiness Framework classification revealed 44.8% Laboratory, 49.2% Bridge, and 6.0% Clinical stage, with intervention studies showing the highest Clinical-stage proportion (16.7% vs. 5.9% for assessment). Five cross-cutting observations emerged, including an inverted evidence pyramid and persistent cross-axis integration gap (4.4%). Despite technical advances, the evidence base remains concentrated at early translational stages. The proposed Translational Readiness Framework provides a structured lens for evaluating progress and guiding research prioritization. Closing the gap between laboratory promise and clinical impact requires a shift from model-centric to patient-centric research and from benchmark performance to real-world validation.
zh_abstract: [精神病学研究] 抑郁症和自杀行为是全球疾病负担的主要原因。人工智能（AI）有望改善其检测、干预和预防，但目前尚无综述同时梳理针对这两种情况的AI驱动评估、干预及伦理考量。目的：围绕三个主题轴系统梳理AI在抑郁症和自杀风险方面的应用：（1）评估与诊断，（2）对话式AI和AI驱动的干预，（3）伦理、公平和监管考量；并使用一种新的框架评估转化成熟度。遵循JBI范围综述方法和PRISMA-ScR指南，检索了2020年1月至2026年3月的六个数据库。两名独立评审员采用两阶段流程筛选了5079条记录，最终纳入2844项研究（Cohen's kappa = 0.66）。使用标准化图表提取表并借助AI辅助的全文分析提取数据。评估/诊断类研究占主导（n = 1785），干预类研究较少（n = 318）。与大语言模型相关的研究在每年纳入研究中的占比从<1%（2020-2022年）上升至11.1%（2025年）。转化就绪框架（Translational Readiness Framework）分类显示，44.8%为实验室阶段，49.2%为过渡阶段，6.0%为临床阶段；其中干预类研究的临床阶段占比最高（16.7%，而评估类为5.9%）。归纳出五项贯穿性观察，包括证据金字塔倒置和持续存在的跨轴整合缺口（4.4%）。尽管技术不断进步，证据基础仍集中在早期转化阶段。所提出的转化就绪框架为评价进展和指导研究优先级提供了结构化视角。要弥合实验室前景与临床影响之间的差距，需要从以模型为中心转向以患者为中心的研究，并从基准性能转向真实世界验证。

title: MedPsy: State-of-the-Art Small Medical Language Models for Efficient Edge Deployment
zh_title: MedPsy：面向边缘部署的先进小型医学语言模型
summary: 提出1.7B和4B纯文本医学小模型，通过合成数据、教师CoT蒸馏及SFT+RL四阶段训练，兼顾精度与生成效率以适配边缘设备。
key_points: 合成医学数据与235B医学教师模型CoT目标
两阶段SFT加两阶段RL并挖掘困难样本
面向边缘部署，降低延迟与KV缓存压力
reason: 领域专用小型医学LLM，方法清晰有基线对比，但为预印本
abstract: Medical language models promise expert clinical support, but the strongest open-source LLMs remain too large for private edge-device deployment, while compact medical models still trail substantially on knowledge-intensive and real-world healthcare tasks. Reasoning models that fit edge memory budgets can produce long reasoning traces, increasing sequential decoding, end-to-end latency, energy consumption, and KV-cache memory pressure. We present MedPsy, a family of text-only 1.7B and 4B medical language models designed for edge deployment, targeting this accuracy-generation-efficiency trade-off. Our recipe combines a synthetic medical data pipeline over biology, medicine, and health seeds with chain-of-thought targets from a 235B medical-focused LLM teacher; a four-stage post-training curriculum comprising two SFT stages followed by two RL stages with hard-sample mining; and an edge deployment evaluation spanning multiple GGUF quantization variants and real-device inference on laptop and smartphone hardware. On seven closed-ended medical benchmarks, MedPsy-4B surpasses MedGemma-1.5-4B by 19.34 points and matches MedGemma-27B while being 6.75x smaller; MedPsy-1.7B outperforms MedGemma-1.5-4B by 11.42 points despite being less than half its size. On HealthBench-Hard, MedPsy-4B surpasses MedGemma-27B by 15.33 points, while MedPsy-1.7B surpasses it by 11.66 points despite being ~16x smaller. Beyond accuracy, MedPsy reduces average response length by 1.7x (1.7B) and 3.2x (4B) versus its Qwen3 backbones, while Q4_K_M quantization preserves the aggregate score within 1 point of BF16 with ~69% lower disk footprint. In real-device inference, MedPsy-4B's shorter generations translate into 75% lower median end-to-end latency and estimated energy per answer than its Qwen3 backbone at matched quantization, while peak RAM remains below 5 GB across our tested laptop and smartphone configurations.
zh_abstract: 医学语言模型有望提供专家级临床支持，但最强的开源大语言模型（LLM）仍然过于庞大，无法部署在私有边缘设备上，而紧凑的医学模型在知识密集型和真实世界医疗任务上仍明显落后。能够满足边缘设备内存预算的推理模型可能产生很长的推理轨迹，从而增加串行解码、端到端延迟、能耗和 KV 缓存的内存压力。我们提出了 MedPsy，这是一个专为边缘部署设计的纯文本 1.7B 和 4B 医学语言模型系列，旨在应对这种准确性与生成效率之间的权衡。我们的方案结合了：基于生物学、医学和健康种子的合成医学数据流水线，其思维链目标来自一个 235B 的医学专用 LLM 教师模型；一个四阶段的后训练课程，包括两个监督微调（SFT）阶段，随后是两个带有困难样本挖掘的强化学习（RL）阶段；以及一项边缘部署评估，涵盖多种 GGUF 量化变体以及在笔记本电脑和智能手机硬件上的真实设备推理。在七个封闭式医学基准上，MedPsy-4B 比 MedGemma-1.5-4B 高 19.34 分，与 MedGemma-27B 相当，而体积小 6.75 倍；MedPsy-1.7B 比 MedGemma-1.5-4B 高 11.42 分，而其大小不足后者的一半。在 HealthBench-Hard 上，MedPsy-4B 比 MedGemma-27B 高 15.33 分，MedPsy-1.7B 比其高 11.66 分，而体积小约 16 倍。除准确性外，与其 Qwen3 骨干模型相比，MedPsy 将平均回答长度缩短了 1.7 倍（1.7B）和 3.2 倍（4B），而 Q4_K_M 量化使综合得分与 BF16 相差不超过 1 分，同时磁盘占用减少约 69%。在真实设备推理中，在相同量化条件下，MedPsy-4B 更短的生成使其每个回答的端到端延迟中位数和估算能耗比其 Qwen3 骨干模型低 75%，同时在我们测试的笔记本电脑和智能手机配置中峰值内存保持在 5 GB 以下。

title: GaitFM: A Cross-Modal Foundation Model for Wearable Gait Assessment
zh_title: GaitFM：可穿戴步态评估的跨模态基础模型
summary: 提出基于IMU的步态评估跨模态基础模型，借助大型视觉模型知识迁移并在无标注IMU数据上预训练，以提升跨个体、部位和设备的泛化性。
key_points: 面向IMU可穿戴步态评估
迁移大视觉模型知识并做无标注预训练
旨在提高跨设备与人群的泛化性
reason: 可穿戴基础模型方向，预印本，细节有限
abstract: Gait assessment supports the diagnosis, monitoring, and prognosis of diverse movement-related conditions, such as neurological and musculoskeletal disorders. Recent advances in deep learning using everyday wearable inertial measurement units (IMUs) offer an accessible and low-cost approach to automated gait assessment. However, IMU measurements vary substantially across individuals, body locations, and device configurations, while existing deep learning models are typically developed using small, homogeneous datasets for specific clinical tasks, limiting their robustness and generalizability in diverse real-world contexts. Here we present GaitFM, a cross-modal foundation model for gait assessment using IMU sensors. GaitFM improves the generalizability of gait assessment by transferring knowledge from large vision models and pretraining on unlabeled IMU sensor data. We pretrain GaitFM on a large curated dataset comprising about 4,000 participants and 1.23 million gait windows across diverse clinical and daily conditions, sensor modalities, and body locations. GaitFM demonstrates strong performance across 18 gait-related tasks, including 3 gait parameter estimation tasks, 14 disease and gait abnormality detection tasks, and 1 clinical outcome prediction task. Furthermore, GaitFM generalizes across different sensor configurations and body locations, including those commonly used in clinical settings and everyday wearable devices. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of transferring visual knowledge in improving sensor-based gait assessment performance, offering a new promising pathway for addressing data scarcity in the sensor and medical domains.
zh_abstract: 步态评估有助于多种与运动相关疾病（如神经系统和肌肉骨骼疾病）的诊断、监测和预后判断。近期利用日常可穿戴惯性测量单元（IMU）的深度学习进展，为自动化步态评估提供了一种可及且低成本的途径。然而，IMU测量值在个体、身体部位和设备配置之间差异很大，而现有深度学习模型通常是基于小规模、同质化的数据集针对特定临床任务开发的，限制了其在多样化真实场景中的稳健性和泛化能力。在此，我们提出GaitFM，一种使用IMU传感器进行步态评估的跨模态基础模型。GaitFM通过迁移大型视觉模型的知识并在无标签IMU传感器数据上进行预训练，提高了步态评估的泛化能力。我们在一个大型精选数据集上对GaitFM进行预训练，该数据集包含约4,000名参与者和123万个步态窗口，涵盖多样的临床和日常情境、传感器模态及身体部位。GaitFM在18项步态相关任务中表现出色，包括3项步态参数估计任务、14项疾病和步态异常检测任务以及1项临床结局预测任务。此外，GaitFM可在不同传感器配置和身体部位之间泛化，包括临床环境和日常可穿戴设备中常用的那些。这些发现表明，迁移视觉知识能有效提升基于传感器的步态评估性能，为解决传感器和医学领域的数据稀缺问题提供了一条有前景的新途径。

title: GESTALT: Fast, Generalizable Histopathology Image Synthesis from Gene Expression with Pretrained Pathology Foundation Models
zh_title: GESTALT：基于病理基础模型从基因表达快速合成组织病理图像
summary: 将基因表达到图像合成重构为预测病理基础模型的图像嵌入，由轻量基因token Transformer与扩散解码器（PixCell）生成图像，对比当前最优GeneFlow。
key_points: 预测病理基础模型图像嵌入
轻量Transformer配合冻结或LoRA扩散解码器
避免对每个新数据集从头训练
reason: 预印本新方法，病理基础模型方向有基线对比，细节有限
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics measures gene expression while preserving where each cell sits in the tissue. The inverse, what a given transcriptomic state looks like, is less explored but equally useful: it lets researchers visualize the morphological consequence of a molecular state and interpret a spatial assay's molecular calls against real tissue structure. GeneFlow, the current state of the art on the Xenium gene expression-to-image benchmark, trains a model from scratch, incurring a high cost on every new target dataset it is applied to. We instead propose GESTALT, which reformulates gene expression-to-image synthesis as predicting a pathology foundation model's image embedding. A lightweight gene-token transformer predicts this embedding from multi-cell gene expression, and a frozen or LoRA-adapted diffusion decoder (PixCell) renders it as an image. Because this visual knowledge is reused rather than relearned, GESTALT trains in a fraction of the time. In both multi-cell and single-cell settings, our method outperforms the SoTA on perceptual metrics across all three Xenium datasets. Beyond improved image quality, GESTALT natively synthesizes at 1024 x 1024, and is evaluated in three generalization settings: zero-shot transfer across gene panels and datasets, held-out patients and disease states, and transfer across studies and tissue sources. Coupled with a statistical model of spatial expression, GESTALT also provides, to our knowledge, the first paired synthesis of cell-resolved transcriptomic fields and tissue images with explicit control over cell type, density, and composition. Code is available at https://github.com/trongnhandev1011/Gestalt.
zh_abstract: 空间转录组学在测量基因表达的同时保留了每个细胞在组织中的位置。其逆向问题，即特定转录组状态在形态上是什么样子，则较少被探索，但同样有用：它使研究者能够将分子状态的形态学后果可视化，并对照真实组织结构解读空间检测的分子判读结果。目前在Xenium基因表达到图像基准上处于最先进水平的GeneFlow从头训练模型，在应用于每个新的目标数据集时都会产生高昂成本。我们则提出GESTALT，将基因表达到图像的合成重新表述为预测病理基础模型的图像嵌入。一个轻量级的基因token Transformer根据多细胞基因表达预测该嵌入，再由冻结或经LoRA适配的扩散解码器（PixCell）将其渲染为图像。由于这种视觉知识是被复用而非重新学习，GESTALT的训练时间仅为很小一部分。在多细胞和单细胞设置下，我们的方法在全部三个Xenium数据集上的感知指标均优于当前最先进方法。除图像质量提升外，GESTALT原生支持1024 x 1024分辨率的合成，并在三种泛化设置中进行了评估：跨基因panel和数据集的零样本迁移、留出的患者和疾病状态，以及跨研究和组织来源的迁移。结合空间表达统计模型，据我们所知，GESTALT还首次实现了细胞分辨率转录组场与组织图像的成对合成，并可对细胞类型、密度和组成进行显式控制。代码见 https://github.com/trongnhandev1011/Gestalt。

title: ERIA: An Instruction-Optimized Agent for Clinical EEG Reporting
zh_title: ERIA：用于临床脑电报告的指令优化智能体
summary: ERIA以本地部署的27B语言模型为控制器，调用学习型与确定性信号处理工具分析整段脑电，并用GEPA仅优化自然语言分析策略。
key_points: 调用背景异常、睡眠、癫痫样活动等工具
控制器权重、工具与安全约束固定
仅用GEPA优化分析策略
reason: 预印本，临床智能体新颖，摘要无外部验证细节
abstract: Clinical EEG interpretation requires integrating technical quality, background and behavioral states, interictal and ictal abnormalities, and overall clinical context across long recordings. We introduce ERIA (EEG Reporting and Instruction-Optimized Agent), a locally deployable framework in which a single 27B language-model controller analyzes whole-recording EEGs by orchestrating specialized parametric and signal-processing tools. ERIA combines learned tools for background abnormality, sleep-wake state, seizure-like activity, and interictal epileptiform discharges with deterministic spectral, amplitude, symmetry, montage, and signal-quality analyses. Rather than fine-tuning the controller or using multi-agent orchestration, ERIA keeps the controller weights, specialist tools, and safety constraints fixed and optimizes only its natural-language analysis policy with GEPA (Genetic-Pareto), using feedback from expert-written EEG reports. GEPA improves physician-aligned whole-recording report quality over the raw policy, and the optimized policy transfers to external EEG benchmarks. On CerebraGloss-Bench and BrainBench Foundational Analysis, ERIA remains competitive with the models evaluated in the original benchmarks. These results show that specialist tools and language-level policy optimization can extend the clinical and general EEG capabilities of a single locally executable model while preserving local inference and traceable tool use.
zh_abstract: 临床脑电图（EEG）判读需要在长时程记录中整合技术质量、背景活动与行为状态、发作间期和发作期异常以及整体临床背景。我们提出 ERIA（EEG Reporting and Instruction-Optimized Agent，EEG 报告与指令优化智能体），这是一个可本地部署的框架，其中单个 270 亿参数（27B）的语言模型控制器通过调度专门的参数化工具和信号处理工具来分析完整记录的 EEG。ERIA 将针对背景异常、睡眠-觉醒状态、类发作活动和发作间期癫痫样放电的学习型工具，与确定性的频谱、波幅、对称性、导联组合（montage）及信号质量分析相结合。ERIA 既不对控制器进行微调，也不采用多智能体编排，而是保持控制器权重、专用工具和安全约束固定不变，仅利用专家撰写的 EEG 报告所提供的反馈，通过 GEPA（Genetic-Pareto）优化其自然语言分析策略。与原始策略相比，GEPA 提升了与医师判断一致的全记录报告质量，且优化后的策略可迁移至外部 EEG 基准。在 CerebraGloss-Bench 和 BrainBench Foundational Analysis 上，ERIA 与原始基准中所评估的模型相比仍具竞争力。这些结果表明，专用工具与语言层面的策略优化能够扩展单个可本地运行模型在临床及通用 EEG 方面的能力，同时保持本地推理和可追溯的工具使用。

title: Artificial intelligence-driven pharmacovigilance: transforming signal detection, real-world drug safety monitoring, and regulatory decision-making.
source: PubMed · Expert opinion on drug safety
zh_title: AI驱动的药物警戒：信号检测、真实世界安全监测与监管决策
summary: 综述评估机器学习、深度学习与NLP在药物警戒中的应用，涵盖不良事件检测、文献挖掘、信号优先排序及EHR与社交媒体数据分析。
key_points: 传统方法存在漏报、信号识别延迟、数据碎片化问题
AI用于不良事件检测与信号优先排序
讨论监管科学中的应用与新兴技术
reason: 专家意见式综述，泛泛，无新证据
abstract: [Expert opinion on drug safety] Pharmacovigilance is undergoing rapid transformation due to the expansion of digital healthcare systems, biomedical data generation, and pharmaceutical innovation. Conventional drug-safety monitoring methods remain limited by underreporting, delayed signal identification, fragmented datasets, and restricted predictive capability. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising approach for improving signal detection, real-world drug-safety surveillance, and regulatory decision-making. This review evaluates application of AI technologies in modern pharmacovigilance and regulatory science. It discusses use of machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, and natural language processing for adverse-event detection, literature mining, signal prioritization, and analysis of electronic health records (EHR) and social-media data. Emerging technologies, including large language models, federated learning, blockchain, digital twins, and Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled monitoring systems, are also explored. Literature was identified through structured searches of MEDLINE/PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Embase, and Google Scholar, covering publications from January 2000 to February 2026. AI-driven pharmacovigilance has potential to improve real-time safety surveillance, predictive risk assessment, and automated regulatory workflows. However, broader implementation remains challenged by concerns related to interpretability, data quality, cybersecurity, algorithmic bias, and regulatory validation. Future progress will depend on transparent, explainable, and human-supervised AI systems integrated within globally interoperable healthcare infrastructures.
zh_abstract: [药物安全专家意见] 随着数字医疗系统的扩展、生物医学数据的生成和药物创新，药物警戒正经历快速变革。传统的药物安全监测方法仍受限于漏报、信号识别延迟、数据集碎片化以及预测能力有限。人工智能（AI）已成为改进信号检测、真实世界药物安全监测和监管决策的一种有前景的方法。本综述评估了AI技术在现代药物警戒和监管科学中的应用，讨论了机器学习、深度学习、神经网络和自然语言处理在不良事件检测、文献挖掘、信号优先级排序，以及电子健康记录（EHR）和社交媒体数据分析中的应用，并探讨了包括大语言模型、联邦学习、区块链、数字孪生和物联网（IoT）监测系统在内的新兴技术。文献通过对MEDLINE/PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、Embase和Google Scholar的结构化检索获得，涵盖2000年1月至2026年2月发表的文献。AI驱动的药物警戒有望改善实时安全监测、预测性风险评估和自动化监管工作流程。然而，更广泛的实施仍面临可解释性、数据质量、网络安全、算法偏倚和监管验证等方面问题的挑战。未来的进展将取决于在全球可互操作的医疗基础设施中整合透明、可解释且有人类监督的AI系统。

title: Performance of Deep Learning Algorithms for Segmentation of Shoulder Anatomy on MRI: A Systematic Review.
source: PubMed · Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
zh_title: 肩关节MRI解剖分割深度学习算法性能：系统综述
summary: 按PRISMA 2020检索多个数据库，系统综述全自动深度学习肩关节MRI分割算法的性能与方法学特征。
key_points: 遵循PRISMA 2020，检索六个数据库
共识别354条记录，去重后筛选185条
关注全自动像素级分割与专家参考标准
reason: 单一解剖部位系统综述，信息有限，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] To synthesize the performance and methodological characteristics of fully automated deep learning algorithms for shoulder magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) segmentation. This systematic review followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 statement. CENTRAL, PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Embase, Web of Science, and IEEE Xplore were searched from inception through July 17, 2026. The protocol specified fully automated deep learning-based pixel-wise segmentation of shoulder MRI, an expert-derived MRI-space reference standard, and quantitative segmentation metrics. Two reviewers independently screened records; unresolved disagreements were adjudicated by a senior reviewer. Overlapping datasets were linked during synthesis. Of 354 identified records, 169 duplicates were removed, 185 records were screened, and 53 full-text reports were assessed. Thirty-five reports were included (31 journal articles and 4 full conference papers; 2018-2026). U-Net-based encoder-decoder architectures predominated, with additional region-based, transformer, adversarial, and autoencoder approaches. Dice similarity coefficients ranged from approximately 0.81-0.99 for osseous targets, 0.71-0.99 for shoulder muscles, and 0.58-0.94 for tendon or tear regions; intersection-over-union values for tear or surgical-planning regions ranged from 0.45-0.83. MRI protocols and validation designs were heterogeneous, and most reports described retrospective single-center investigations. Five reports used independent external test sets; several others included multicenter images. Overlapping cohorts precluded a valid pooled participant count. Deep learning achieved high accuracy for shoulder bones and rotator-cuff muscles in selected datasets, whereas tear-region performance was more variable. Multicenter patient-level validation and standardized annotation and reporting are needed before routine clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 综合全自动深度学习算法用于肩关节磁共振成像（MRI）分割的性能和方法学特征。本系统综述遵循2020年系统评价和荟萃分析优先报告条目（PRISMA）声明。检索了CENTRAL、PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Embase、Web of Science和IEEE Xplore，检索时间自建库至2026年7月17日。研究方案规定纳入：基于全自动深度学习的肩关节MRI逐像素分割、由专家制定的MRI空间参考标准，以及定量分割指标。两名评审员独立筛选文献；未解决的分歧由一名资深评审员裁决。在综合分析时对重叠数据集进行了关联。在354条检索记录中，去除169条重复记录，筛选185条记录，评估53篇全文报告。共纳入35篇报告（31篇期刊文章和4篇完整会议论文；2018-2026年）。以U-Net为基础的编码器-解码器架构占主导，另有基于区域、Transformer、对抗和自编码器的方法。骨性目标的Dice相似系数范围约为0.81-0.99，肩部肌肉为0.71-0.99，肌腱或撕裂区域为0.58-0.94；撕裂或手术规划区域的交并比（IoU）范围为0.45-0.83。MRI方案和验证设计存在异质性，大多数报告为回顾性单中心研究。5篇报告使用了独立的外部测试集；另有数篇纳入了多中心图像。由于队列重叠，无法得出有效的合并参与者人数。在选定的数据集中，深度学习对肩部骨骼和肩袖肌肉达到了较高的准确性，而撕裂区域的表现则差异较大。在常规临床应用之前，需要开展多中心患者水平的验证，并实现标注和报告的标准化。

title: Reducing radiographic retake rates with ultra-low dose pre-shots using deep learning-based noise reduction: A prospective clinical study.
zh_title: 深度学习降噪使超低剂量预拍降低X线重拍率：前瞻性临床研究
summary: 评估基于深度学习降噪（AiCE）的超低剂量预拍在腕部X线摄影中降低重拍率的作用，包含体模实验与前瞻性临床部分。
key_points: 预拍管电流时间积由2.8降至0.5 mAs
15名放射技师用五分量表评估
旨在降低重拍而不增加辐射暴露
reason: 前瞻性但规模小、单一场景，属增量档
abstract: [Radiography (London, England : 1995)] The pre-shot technique is an effective approach to lower retake radiography rates; however, it is limited by increased patient radiation exposure. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of an ultra-low-dose pre-shot enabled by deep learning-based noise reduction (Advanced Intelligent Clear-IQ Engine: AiCE) on reducing retake rates in wrist radiography. A CXDI-810C (Canon Medical Systems) was used as the X-ray detector. Phantom images simulating lateral wrist pre-shots with and without AiCE were acquired under fixed imaging conditions using an additional 1.0 mm copper filter. The tube current-time product was reduced from 2.8 mAs to 0.5 mAs. Fifteen radiological technologists determined the optimal imaging condition using a five-point confidence scale, with scores below three considered insufficient for retake decision-making. A prospective clinical evaluation was then conducted, comparing retake rates between a non-pre-shot group (n = 542) and a pre-shot group (n = 325). The entrance surface air kerma (Ka,e) was estimated from phantom measurements. Without AiCE, no imaging condition met the threshold required for retake decision-making. Conversely, with AiCE, a tube current-time product of 1.6 mAs achieved acceptable image quality (3.29 ± 0.47), with all evaluators assigning scores ≥3; therefore, it was selected as the optimal condition. In the clinical evaluation, the retake rate markedly decreased from 14.38% to 0.61%. The pre-shot Ka,e was 0.11 ± 0.03 μGy, corresponding to only 0.15% of the standard lateral wrist radiography dose. AiCE-enabled ultra-low-dose pre-shot imaging dramatically reduced retake rates while requiring minimal additional radiation dose. The ultra-low-dose pre-shot using AiCE represents a highly effective strategy to minimize retake imaging with negligible dose penalty, offering substantial potential for dose optimization and improved workflow efficiency in clinical radiography.
zh_abstract: [放射摄影（Radiography，伦敦，1995）] 预曝光（pre-shot）技术是降低重拍率的有效方法，但受限于患者辐射暴露增加。本研究旨在评估基于深度学习降噪（Advanced Intelligent Clear-IQ Engine：AiCE）的超低剂量预曝光对降低腕部X线摄影重拍率的影响。使用CXDI-810C（佳能医疗系统）作为X线探测器。在固定成像条件下，使用额外1.0 mm铜滤过，采集模拟腕部侧位预曝光的模体图像（有/无AiCE）。管电流时间积由2.8 mAs降至0.5 mAs。15名放射技师采用五分制信心量表确定最佳成像条件，评分低于3分视为不足以做出重拍决策。随后进行前瞻性临床评估，比较非预曝光组（n = 542）与预曝光组（n = 325）的重拍率。入射表面空气比释动能（Ka,e）根据模体测量估算。无AiCE时，没有任何成像条件达到重拍决策所需的阈值。相反，使用AiCE时，1.6 mAs的管电流时间积获得了可接受的图像质量（3.29 ± 0.47），所有评估者评分均≥3，因此被选为最佳条件。在临床评估中，重拍率由14.38%显著降至0.61%。预曝光的Ka,e为0.11 ± 0.03 μGy，仅相当于标准腕部侧位X线摄影剂量的0.15%。AiCE支持的超低剂量预曝光成像在仅需极少额外辐射剂量的情况下显著降低了重拍率。使用AiCE的超低剂量预曝光是在剂量代价可忽略的情况下尽量减少重拍的高效策略，对临床放射摄影中的剂量优化和工作流程效率提升具有重要潜力。

title: Beyond Classification Accuracy: Building Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence for Clinical Electroencephalography.
zh_title: 超越分类准确率：构建可信的临床脑电AI
summary: 文章讨论临床脑电AI不能仅凭研究数据集的高准确率判断临床就绪，需考虑信号、标注与采集差异等因素。
key_points: 覆盖癫痫、睡眠、ICU等应用
EEG受状态、伪迹、设备和预处理影响
强调可信性而非单一准确率
reason: 综述/观点类，泛论可信AI，无新数据
abstract: [Brain research bulletin] Electroencephalography (EEG) remains important in clinical neuroscience because it records brain activity as a time-resolved physiological process. It offers millisecond temporal resolution, can be used at the bedside and supports prolonged monitoring. Artificial intelligence (AI) has expanded EEG analysis through automated pattern recognition, representation learning, large-scale screening and decision support in epilepsy, sleep medicine, cognitive disorders, psychiatric conditions, intensive care, disorders of consciousness and anaesthesia monitoring. High classification accuracy in a research dataset, however, is not clinical readiness. EEG signals are shaped by physiological state, artefacts, acquisition systems, preprocessing choices and clinical context. Labels may come from expert annotations, diagnostic categories, behavioural scales, treatment responses or long-term outcomes, and these sources do not always define the same biological target. This review argues that EEG-AI translation should be judged by the strength of its evidence, not by technical performance alone. We examine why EEG is valuable yet hard to standardize, how EEG features can serve as candidate biomarkers, and why translational maturity differs across clinical scenarios. We then discuss the evidence gaps behind high-performing models, focusing on target validity, data leakage, confounding, external validation and clinically aligned metrics. Finally, we argue for clinical understandability rather than model interpretability alone, and for human-machine workflows rather than isolated classifiers. Future EEG-AI systems should be assessed by whether their outputs are biologically plausible, externally generalizable, understandable to clinicians and safe in real-world care.
zh_abstract: [Brain research bulletin] 脑电图（EEG）因其将脑活动记录为时间分辨的生理过程，在临床神经科学中仍然十分重要。它具有毫秒级时间分辨率，可在床旁使用，并支持长时间监测。人工智能（AI）通过自动模式识别、表征学习、大规模筛查和决策支持，拓展了 EEG 分析在癫痫、睡眠医学、认知障碍、精神疾病、重症监护、意识障碍及麻醉监测中的应用。然而，在研究数据集中取得高分类准确率并不等于具备临床应用条件。EEG 信号受生理状态、伪迹、采集系统、预处理选择和临床背景的影响。标签可能来自专家标注、诊断类别、行为量表、治疗反应或长期结局，而这些来源并不总是界定相同的生物学目标。本综述主张，EEG-AI 的转化应以证据强度而非仅以技术性能来评判。我们探讨了 EEG 为何有价值却难以标准化、EEG 特征如何可作为候选生物标志物，以及不同临床场景下转化成熟度为何存在差异。随后，我们讨论了高性能模型背后的证据缺口，重点关注目标效度、数据泄漏、混杂、外部验证以及与临床相符的评价指标。最后，我们主张追求临床可理解性而不仅仅是模型可解释性，并主张采用人机协作的工作流程而非孤立的分类器。未来的 EEG-AI 系统应当根据其输出是否具有生物学合理性、能否在外部泛化、是否为临床医生所理解以及在真实医疗环境中是否安全来加以评估。

title: Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Clinical Time-Series Models
zh_title: 用于解释临床时间序列模型的时间岛稀疏自编码器
summary: 提出TI-SAE，从冻结的预测模型表示中学习患者共享的临床概念字典，每个概念由时间高斯岛和稀疏变量组合定义，并在多种骨干模型上评估。
key_points: 概念由激活时间与涉及变量共同定义
选择器将表示学习与个体归因解耦
在五种骨干网络上进行评估
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，摘要所示证据有限
abstract: Deep learning models for electronic health records achieve strong predictive performance but provide little insight into what clinical concepts they represent internally. Post-hoc attribution methods produce per-cell importance scores that lack temporal coherence, cross-variable structure, and reusability across patients. We introduce the Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoder (TI-SAE), which learns a backbone-specific, patient-shared clinical concept dictionary from a frozen predictive model's representations. Each dictionary entry (latent) is defined by learned temporal Gaussian islands (specifying when the concept is active) and a sparse variable-composition vector (specifying which variables are involved). A decoupled selector then identifies which dictionary entries drive each patient's prediction, separating representation learning from attribution. We evaluate TI-SAE across five backbone architectures spanning different representation strategies on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV (three prediction tasks each). TI-SAE produces structured clinical concepts that go beyond transient attribution heatmaps while achieving strong performance on standard faithfulness benchmarks.
zh_abstract: 用于电子健康记录的深度学习模型预测性能很强，但对其内部表征了哪些临床概念几乎无法提供见解。事后归因方法产生的逐单元格重要性评分缺乏时间连贯性、跨变量结构以及跨患者的可复用性。我们提出了时间岛稀疏自编码器（Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoder，TI-SAE），它从冻结的预测模型表征中学习一个特定于骨干网络、由患者共享的临床概念词典。词典中的每个条目（潜变量）由习得的时间高斯“岛”（指明该概念何时活跃）和稀疏的变量组成向量（指明涉及哪些变量）定义。随后，一个解耦的选择器确定哪些词典条目驱动每位患者的预测，从而将表征学习与归因分离。我们在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV（各三项预测任务）上，对涵盖不同表征策略的五种骨干网络架构评估了TI-SAE。TI-SAE产生了超越瞬时归因热图的结构化临床概念，同时在标准忠实性基准上取得了良好表现。

title: FedReady: Bounded Agents for Federation Formation
zh_title: FedReady：用于联邦组建的有界智能体
summary: 提出用有界LLM智能体完成联邦学习的联邦组建，包括站点筛选及本地数据与任务代码适配，并在模拟的视网膜多站点场景中评估。
key_points: 智能体提出共享契约、本地适配器与任务代码
运行时仅在通过校验后接受产物
在39个模拟视网膜站点上评估，预印本
reason: 新颖的智能体联邦流程，仅模拟评估，属值得一看档
abstract: Federated learning (FL) runtimes standardize aggregation and deployment, but each new study still requires federation formation: selecting task-eligible sites and preparing their local data and task code for federated training or analysis. This preparation recurs when the target changes, while raw records and site-private mappings are excluded from cross-site FL messages. We present FedReady, a system that performs federation formation with bounded LLM agents. Agents propose shared contracts, local adapters, and task code; the runtime owns workflow state and accepts artifacts only after checks tied to their digests. Candidate site discovery prioritizes recall; local eligibility verification checks task support before site admission. Once participating sites and artifacts are fixed, conventional federated training or analysis proceeds without readiness agents. Across 39 simulated retinal sites and four tasks, discovery reaches recall 1.00 at precision 0.65; local eligibility verification removes all 17 false positives without losing an eligible site-task pair. The participating sites supply 45,575 task-record instances and complete four 100-round jobs, including one with a runtime-generated contract. Across ten patient cohorts, preparation supports seven patient populations and holds endpoints at three sources as unsupported. Comparison with manually prepared reference populations and analysis (the manual reference) gives a maximum survival-curve difference of 0.001133. We also analyze 19 development failures, targeted classification ablations, and standalone and heterogeneous agent configurations. These results establish the feasibility of task-specific data preparation before ordinary FL training or analysis.
zh_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）运行时对聚合与部署进行了标准化，但每开展一项新研究，仍需进行联邦组建：选择符合任务要求的站点，并为联邦训练或分析准备其本地数据和任务代码。当目标改变时，这一准备工作会反复出现，而原始记录和站点私有的映射关系被排除在跨站点 FL 消息之外。我们提出 FedReady，一个利用有界 LLM 智能体执行联邦组建的系统。智能体提出共享契约、本地适配器和任务代码；运行时掌管工作流状态，仅在通过与产物摘要（digest）绑定的检查之后才接受产物。候选站点发现以召回率为优先；本地资格验证则在站点准入前检查其对任务的支持情况。一旦参与站点和产物确定，常规的联邦训练或分析即在无需就绪智能体的情况下进行。在 39 个模拟视网膜站点和四项任务中，站点发现在精确率为 0.65 时召回率达到 1.00；本地资格验证剔除了全部 17 个假阳性，且未丢失任何符合条件的站点-任务对。参与站点提供了 45,575 个任务记录实例，并完成了四项 100 轮的作业，其中一项使用了运行时生成的契约。在十个患者队列中，数据准备支持七个患者人群，并将三个数据源的终点指标判定为不受支持。与人工准备的参考人群和分析（人工参考）相比，生存曲线的最大差异为 0.001133。我们还分析了 19 个开发阶段的失败案例、针对性的分类消融实验，以及独立和异构的智能体配置。这些结果证明了在常规 FL 训练或分析之前开展面向特定任务的数据准备是可行的。

title: Contrastive Adapter Training and Consensus Knowledge Distillation for Multi-Source-Free Domain Adaptation in Skin Cancer Diagnosis
zh_title: 面向皮肤癌诊断的多源无源域适应：对比适配器训练与共识知识蒸馏
summary: 针对黑色素瘤与良性痣鉴别，提出基于适配器与共识蒸馏的多源无源域适应方法，避免全骨干微调并无需访问源数据。
key_points: 解决异质临床来源的域偏移
对比适配器训练缓解灾难性遗忘与过拟合
数据隐私友好，预印本
reason: 皮肤影像新方法预印本，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Skin cancer diagnosis, particularly differentiating melanoma from benign nevi, is challenging due to the visual similarity between lesions. Although convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers (ViTs) have shown promising performance, their effectiveness often deteriorates on data from heterogeneous clinical sources. Conventional domain adaptation methods address domain shift but require access to source data during adaptation, which is often infeasible due to privacy regulations. Multi-source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (MSFDA) addresses this limitation by leveraging multiple labeled source domains to generalize to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to source data. However, existing MSFDA methods rely on full backbone fine-tuning, leading to catastrophic forgetting and overfitting on small clinical datasets, and address domain shift at the aggregation stage without establishing a shared domain-invariant feature space. Furthermore, their reliance on hard pseudo-labels or confidence-weighted aggregation introduces noisy supervision signals under domain shift. To address these limitations, we propose CAT-CKD, consisting of two components: (1) contrastive adapter training (CAT), which trains lightweight ConvPass adapters within a frozen ViT backbone using supervised contrastive learning (SCL) to establish a shared domain-invariant feature space before source-specific model training, and (2) consensus knowledge distillation (CKD), which aggregates logits from multiple source models into a consensus supervisory signal and adapts a student model on unlabeled target data using KL divergence. Experiments on five publicly available skin lesion datasets show that CAT-CKD achieves an average AUROC of 86.1%, outperforming existing MSFDA methods while requiring only 4.3M trainable parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/A-Abedi/CAT_CKD.

title: NormMoX: A Normative Mixture of Experts for Explainable Autism Classification from Structural and Functional MRI
zh_title: NormMoX：基于结构与功能MRI的可解释自闭症分类常模专家混合模型
summary: 提出以常模模型为共同参照的专家混合方法，学习个体脑指标相对年龄性别预期值的偏离，用于sMRI与fMRI融合及可解释自闭症分类。
key_points: 常模模型在大型健康队列上训练
以偏离预期值作为输入并统一融合与解释
针对年龄、性别、站点混杂，预印本
reason: 神经影像新方法预印本，摘要无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: While structural and functional magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI, fMRI) offer profound potential for researching autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and understanding individual neurodivergence, current classifiers lack the explanatory power needed for scientific study, clinical use and personal-level insights. Most models learn from imaging features that also vary with age, sex, scanner site and head motion. They fuse the two modalities without a common reference and explain decisions against arbitrary reference inputs rather than a typical brain. We present NormMoX, a normative mixture of experts that makes the typical brain the shared reference for prediction, fusion and explanation. Normative models trained on large healthy cohorts give the value each brain measure is expected to take for a person's age and sex. NormMoX learns from each person's deviations from these expected values. For each modality, a neural network expert turns the deviations into a score of evidence for ASD. A fusion head, MoX, compares each score with those of typical controls before combining them. It therefore needs no imputation when a modality is missing and shows in which modality each person is atypical. On 1,035 participants of ABIDE I, NormMoX reached an AUROC of $0.728 \pm 0.004$ in repeated cross-validation, above linear, single-modality and deep fusion baselines. NormMoX thus shows not only whether a person is likely to have ASD, but where, and in which modality, their brain departs from typical. The implementation is available at https://github.com/Novelex/NormMox.

title: Rethinking Next-Visit Diagnosis Prediction Beyond Aggregate Metrics: Retrieval--Memory Multi-Agent Adjudication
zh_title: 超越聚合指标的下次就诊诊断预测：检索-记忆多智能体裁决
summary: 提出沿分布与时间维度评估下次就诊诊断预测的框架，发现重复上次就诊的诊断优于多数基于LLM的方法。
key_points: 评估框架覆盖标签分布与时间转移
重复上次就诊整体优于多数LLM方法
检索与记忆方法在不同时间转移上各有优势
reason: 预印本，有新评估视角与多方法对比，但证据有限
abstract: Next-visit diagnosis prediction forecasts the diagnoses documented at a patient's next encounter, turning retrospective electronic health records into prospective clinical prediction. However, conventional aggregate evaluation obscures its multifaceted nature: distributionally, models must handle variable-size diagnosis sets and long-tailed labels; temporally, they must distinguish persistent, newly recorded, and recurrent diagnoses; and both vary with observed history depth. We introduce an evaluation framework along these dimensions and apply it to rule-based heuristics, LLM-based prompting, retrieval, memory, and multi-agent approaches. This reveals that repeating the last visit outperforms most LLM-based approaches overall despite predicting no new or recurrent diagnoses, and that retrieval and memory exhibit distinct profiles whose relative strengths vary across temporal transitions and backbones. Motivated by this, we propose LONGINUS, a retrieval-memory multi-agent adjudication framework combining evidence retrieved from patient records with structured memory of the patient trajectory. Using cross-view agreement as a reliability heuristic, it preserves shared predictions and adjudicates disagreements without revealing their source. Across MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV with four LLM backbones, LONGINUS achieves the best transition-specific performance among LLM-based methods in nearly all settings while remaining competitive with them on aggregate metrics.
zh_abstract: 下一次就诊诊断预测是对患者下一次就诊时所记录的诊断进行预测，将回顾性电子健康记录转化为前瞻性临床预测。然而，传统的整体评估掩盖了该任务的多面性：在分布层面，模型必须处理大小可变的诊断集合以及长尾标签；在时间层面，模型必须区分持续性诊断、新记录的诊断和复发性诊断；并且二者都随已观察到的病史深度而变化。我们提出了一个沿这些维度展开的评估框架，并将其应用于基于规则的启发式方法、基于大语言模型（LLM）的提示方法、检索、记忆以及多智能体方法。结果显示，尽管不预测任何新发或复发诊断，直接重复上一次就诊的诊断在总体上仍优于大多数基于 LLM 的方法；并且检索与记忆表现出不同的特征，其相对优势随时间转变类型和骨干模型而变化。受此启发，我们提出了 LONGINUS，一个检索-记忆多智能体裁决框架，将从患者记录中检索到的证据与患者病程的结构化记忆相结合。该框架以跨视角一致性作为可靠性启发式，保留共同的预测，并在不披露来源的情况下对分歧进行裁决。在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 上，使用四种 LLM 骨干模型，LONGINUS 在几乎所有设置中都取得了基于 LLM 的方法中最佳的转变类型特异性表现，同时在总体指标上与这些方法保持竞争力。

title: DUNEDepth: Bronchoscopic Depth and Pose Estimation via Hybrid Adaptation of a 3D-Vision Foundation Model
zh_title: DUNEDepth：基于3D视觉基础模型的支气管镜深度与位姿估计
summary: 基于3D视觉基础模型，结合DUNE ViT编码器与MASt3R解码器，并用合成监督加自监督策略微调，用于支气管镜深度和相机位姿估计。
key_points: 混合架构：DUNE编码器加MASt3R风格解码器
合成监督与自监督混合训练策略
目标是将支气管镜视频与术前CT关联
reason: 预印本新方法，基础模型适配内镜，证据有限
abstract: State-of-the-art bronchoscopy guidance systems and computer-aided diagnosis methods have emerged as important tools for early lung cancer detection. Effective use of these tools depends on being able to accurately link a patient's bronchoscopic airway exam video to their pre-operative 3D chest CT scan. Unfortunately, the derivation of such links, which include bronchoscope depth and camera motion, from the exam video remains an open problem. Building on recently proposed 3D-vision foundation models, we propose DUNEDepth, a hybrid architecture that combines a shared DUNE ViT encoder, a twin MASt3R cross-attention decoder structure, and a prediction head that includes elements of the MASt3R and Reloc3r models. To fine-tune the architecture to our application, we utilize an integrated hybrid synthetic-supervised/self-supervised training strategy that draws on both bronchoscopic video and CT-derived virtual bronchoscopic views. Experiments drawing on bronchoscopic video sequences demonstrate that DUNEDepth more accurately derives depth information and camera motion trajectories than previously proposed self-supervised methods.

title: Measure Before You Repair: An Explainable Agent for Blind Restoration of Multi-Artifact 3-D MRI
zh_title: 先测后修：用于多伪影3D MRI盲修复的可解释智能体
summary: 提出Dx-Rx智能体，由多模态大模型调用诊断与修复工具，对整幅3D脑MRI进行盲修复并生成放射学风格报告，在模拟伪影数据上评估。
key_points: MLLM循环调用5个诊断和4个修复工具
首个修复完整3D MRI体数据的智能体
在148个T1体数据上模拟最多5种伪影
reason: 新颖的影像智能体方法，但仅模拟伪影、预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: A brain MRI scan can carry an unknown mix of artifacts, so restoration has to be blind, yet most deep-learning methods are built to correct one known artifact. We present Dx-Rx, an agent in which a multimodal large language model (MLLM) measures suspected artifacts before it repairs them. To our knowledge, it is the first agent to restore whole 3-D MRI volumes, whereas earlier MRI agents restore 2-D slices. In a loop, it looks at slices of the 3-D volume, calls five diagnostic tools (noise, spike, ghosting, bias field, motion) and four restoration tools in any order it chooses, checks each repair, can return to any earlier version to change the order, and ends with a radiology-style report of its diagnostic reasons, the repairs it applied and their results. We simulated up to five artifacts on 148 whole 3-D T1-weighted volumes, at levels calibrated to radiologists' grades of real scans. An MLLM that only looked at the image, as earlier MRI agents do, removed at most 19.7 % of the artifact error. With the best of five MLLMs, Dx-Rx removed a mean 64.5 %, nearly matching the 64.6 % of the same tools given the ground-truth artifacts, which are never known for a clinical scan. With all five models, it made no volume worse and was on par with or better than an expert rule-based pipeline built from the same tools (62.3 %). Code and demo are public at https://itu-biai.github.io/measure-before-you-repair.

title: A Guideline-Grounded Multi-Agent Framework for Personalized Exercise Prescription from Clinical and Wearable Data
zh_title: FITTER：基于指南的多智能体个性化运动处方框架
summary: FITTER整合临床与可穿戴数据生成FITT-VP运动处方，并做确定性安全审查；在400名All of Us参与者上与5个LLM对比，安全合规率98.5%。
key_points: 多智能体结合指南与确定性安全审计修复
400例（300癌症、100卒中）计算评估
reason: 可穿戴+多智能体新方法，有基线对比和临床医生评审，但为预印本
abstract: Translating population-level exercise guidance into individualized prescriptions requires integrating clinical and wearable data, including diagnoses, medications, functional limitations, and baseline activity, with condition-specific recommendations, a process difficult to scale beyond specialist rehabilitation settings. We developed FITTER, a multi-agent framework that integrates these data with condition-specific guidance to generate personalized FITT-VP prescriptions and applies deterministic safety audit and repair to correct rule-checkable violations. We evaluated FITTER using data from 400 All of Us participants (300 cancer, 100 stroke) against five LLM comparators through computational evaluation, ablation, and structured clinician review. FITTER achieved 98.5% safety-constraint compliance versus 75.8-85.8% for comparators and showed greater quantitative dosing precision and guideline alignment. Cancer-cohort ablation identified safety audit and repair as the largest contributor to safety-constraint compliance. Clinicians reviewed 80 prescriptions across safety, personalization, instruction concreteness, anticipated effectiveness, and clinical acceptability. FITTER provides a clinician-facing approach integrating clinical and wearable data, guidance, and explicit safety constraints.

title: Improving PI-RADS Prediction and Prostate Cancer Detection from Multiparametric MRI with Anatomical Guidance
zh_title: 解剖引导提升mpMRI的PI-RADS预测与前列腺癌检测
summary: 在mpMRI中加入前列腺分区掩码，在3D ResNet与ViT上提升PI-RADS预测与csPCa检测，并在外部数据集微调验证。
key_points: PI-RADS预测最佳QWK为0.511
csPCa检测最佳AUC为0.809
外部数据集微调结果同样受益
reason: 大规模内部数据加外部微调，多架构对比，但指标提升有限，预印本
abstract: Accurate prediction of Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System (PI-RADS) scores from multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) remains challenging, more so than clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) detection. Given the importance of lesion location in PI-RADS scoring, we evaluated whether incorporating prostate zonal masks improves PI-RADS prediction and csPCa detection across multiple architectures (3D ResNet-18, ResNet-50, and ViT) using a large-scale internal dataset. Anatomical guidance generally improved performance across architectures, with the best results achieved by ResNet-18 with 2-zone guidance for PI-RADS prediction (QWK = 0.511) and ResNet-50 with 5-zone guidance for csPCa detection (AUC = 0.809). Fine-tuned results on external datasets further demonstrated the benefits of anatomical guidance. Furthermore, models with anatomical guidance improved the utility of model-predicted PI-RADS scores for PI-RADS-based csPCa detection (positive defined as PI-RADS>=3). Combining model-predicted and expert-assigned PI-RADS scores significantly increased the AUC from 0.711 to 0.756 (p < 0.05), suggesting that AI-derived PI-RADS scores may provide complementary information to expert assessment for csPCa detection. Overall, our findings highlight the value of incorporating prostate zonal anatomy into deep learning-based prostate MRI assessment.

title: iMED: A Multi-Endoscope Dataset for Surgical 3D Perception
zh_title: iMED：面向手术三维感知的多内镜数据集
summary: 预印本提出首个同步多内镜机器人微创手术数据集，含340个序列、约17万同步时间点，提供独立留出视角。
key_points: 两台立体内镜同步采集，每时间点4视角
涵盖离体、尸体与在体手术场景，14个标本
含相机标定、位姿估计和器械分割掩码
reason: 新的手术视觉数据集，规模可观，但为预印本且信息有限
abstract: We introduce iMED, the first synchronized multi-endoscope dataset for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS), designed to address a fundamental limitation in surgical vision benchmarking: the absence of independent held-out viewpoints. Existing surgical datasets capture single-trajectory sequences from a single endoscope, making it impossible to distinguish geometric generalization from photometric interpolation along a narrow forward-facing path. iMED provides 340 sequences ~170K synchronized timepoints with 4 views per timepoint) recorded simultaneously from two independent stereo endoscopes across ex vivo, postmortem, and live surgical settings, spanning 14 specimens with diverse anatomical regions and motion regimes. The dataset includes calibrated camera intrinsics, ArUco-based frame-wise pose estimates with uncertainty quantification, instrument segmentation masks, and rich clinical metadata. Using a train-on-one-endoscope, test-on-another evaluation protocol, we benchmark 23 state-of-the-art methods across rigid and deformable novel view synthesis, pose estimation, feature matching, and monocular depth estimation. Our experiments show that methods relying primarily on photometric supervision degrade substantially under this held-out-endoscope setting, while methods with explicit geometric regularization are more robust across views in our benchmark. Notably, large-scale foundation models transfer surprisingly well to surgical imagery, often outperforming domain-specific models, suggesting pitfalls in current fine-tuning protocols. iMED establishes a new evaluation protocol for geometric generalization in surgical vision.

title: Therapy-FIS: A Dataset for Assessing Facilitative Interpersonal Skills in Psychotherapeutic Setting
zh_title: Therapy-FIS：心理治疗中促进性人际技能评估数据集
summary: 预印本发布首个公开的心理治疗促进性人际技能自动评估数据集，含面部、声学和文本信号，基于890段治疗师视频。
key_points: 首个该领域公开数据集
基于890段治疗师视频与模拟患者刺激片段
提供面部、声学、文本多模态信号
reason: 心理健康多模态新公开数据集，但规模中等、预印本
abstract: Facilitative Interpersonal Skills (FIS) is a performance-based assessment method that provides a structured framework for evaluating the interpersonal competencies of mental health professionals. However, existing FIS assessment relies heavily on human observer ratings, making the evaluation process labor-intensive, costly, and difficult to scale. Progress toward automated FIS assessment has also been constrained by the lack of publicly available professional data in psychotherapy settings. To address this limitation, we introduce Therapy-FIS, a dataset for automated FIS assessment in standardized psychotherapy tasks. To our knowledge, Therapy-FIS is the first publicly available dataset in this domain. It contains facial, acoustic, and textual signals derived from standardized therapist responses to standardized mock patient stimulus clips, based on 890 therapist video recordings and 8 patient videos, and is rated with eight FIS subscale ratings and an overall FIS score. Built on Therapy-FIS, we further establish a benchmark with two downstream tasks: Therapist Performance Rating and Joint Therapist--mock-Patient Performance Rating. We also introduce a competitive baseline, DyadicFIS, with gated fusion and routed readout under therapist-only and dyadic settings. DyadicFIS obtains the best macro CCC(Concordance Correlation Coefficient) scores on both tasks (0.2807 and 0.3299). Therapy-FIS offers a reproducible resource for data-driven automated assessment of therapeutic interpersonal skills in mental health.
zh_abstract: 促进性人际技能（Facilitative Interpersonal Skills，FIS）是一种基于表现的评估方法，为评价心理健康专业人员的人际能力提供了结构化框架。然而，现有的FIS评估严重依赖人工观察者评分，使评估过程费时费力、成本高昂且难以规模化。心理治疗场景中缺乏可公开获取的专业数据，也限制了自动化FIS评估的进展。为解决这一局限，我们提出了Therapy-FIS，这是一个用于标准化心理治疗任务中自动化FIS评估的数据集。据我们所知，Therapy-FIS是该领域首个可公开获取的数据集。它包含源自治疗师对标准化模拟患者刺激片段所作标准化回应的面部、声学和文本信号，基于890段治疗师视频记录和8段患者视频，并配有八项FIS子量表评分和一个FIS总分。基于Therapy-FIS，我们进一步建立了包含两项下游任务的基准：治疗师表现评分（Therapist Performance Rating）以及治疗师—模拟患者联合表现评分（Joint Therapist–mock-Patient Performance Rating）。我们还提出了一个具有竞争力的基线模型DyadicFIS，其在仅治疗师和二元（dyadic）设置下采用门控融合和路由读出。DyadicFIS在两项任务上均取得了最佳的宏平均CCC（一致性相关系数）得分（分别为0.2807和0.3299）。Therapy-FIS为心理健康领域中治疗性人际技能的数据驱动自动化评估提供了可复现的资源。

title: Balancing Chain-of-Thought and Answer Supervision for Small Language Models on Medical Question Answering

选择题上SwS总体更好，通用模型获益最大
Qwen3.5-4B在MedQA较零样本最多提升44.8%

abstract: Small language models (<=9B parameters) can support local medical question answering (QA) while reducing privacy and latency concerns, but effective fine-tuning remains challenging. This paper compares two chain-of-thought (CoT) supervised fine-tuning methods: Uniform-across-Sequence (UaS), which applies equal loss weighting to the full CoT-and-answer sequence, and Segment-weighted (SwS), which separately weights CoT and answer losses. We evaluate six general- and medical-domain models on multiple-choice QA (MedQA and EMS-MCQA) and free-text QA (Med-O1). Results show that neither method is universally best: on multiple-choice QA (MedQA and EMS-MCQA), SwS generally performs better, with general-purpose models benefiting most; notably, Qwen3.5-4B improves by up to 44.8% over its zero-shot baseline on MedQA. In contrast, medical-domain models show smaller or even negative gains on MCQs. On free-text QA (Med-O1), UaS performs best for nearly all models and provides consistent improvements across both model types, with the 3B Llama-3.2 model approaching the performance of much larger 7B medical-domain models. We also find that excessively long CoT generation is associated with lower performance in some models on either multiple-choice or free-text QA tasks, suggesting that limiting the CoT length during training may benefit selected models. Overall, the results show that CoT loss weighting should be matched to the task format and the knowledge already encoded in the base model, rather than using a single fine-tuning strategy for all clinical QA tasks.

title: Artificial Intelligence in Cataract Care: A Narrative Review of Evidence Maturity and Clinical Readiness.

abstract: [Journal of ophthalmology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is being investigated across the cataract care pathway, but the maturity of the evidence varies substantially between technical benchmark studies, externally validated models, prospective clinical evaluations and tools used in routine care. This narrative review critically summarises AI applications in cataract detection, intraocular lens (IOL) power calculation, perioperative risk assessment, intraoperative support and postoperative follow-up, with particular emphasis on evidence quality, external validity and clinical readiness. A structured search of PubMed/MEDLINE was conducted for English-language publications from 1 January 2018 through 31 March 2025, with selective retention of earlier seminal studies relevant to cataract risk prediction, force feedback and ophthalmic robotics. Evidence was classified by maturity, from technical proof of concept and retrospective internal validation to external or multicentre validation, prospective clinical evaluation and demonstrated workflow or patient-level benefit. The strongest evidence for cataract detection comes from large externally validated image-based models, whereas smartphone systems remain sensitive to image quality, case mix and deployment setting. Data-driven IOL formulas can improve refractive prediction in selected datasets, but comparisons are affected by constant optimisation, axial-length distribution, IOL model, measurement device and paired-eye dependence. Intraoperative AI remains dominated by phase recognition, segmentation and technical performance assessment, with limited evidence of direct clinical benefit. Postoperative conversational AI has reached multicentre prospective clinical evaluation, although safety depends on escalation pathways, human oversight and local workflow design. Clinical translation of AI in cataract care is therefore emerging but uneven: a limited number of applications have reached external or prospective clinical validation, while many remain retrospective or technical proof-of-concept systems. Future adoption should be based on external validation, transparent reporting, prospective clinical utility, postdeployment monitoring and clear regulatory and medicolegal accountability rather than benchmark performance alone.
zh_abstract: [Journal of ophthalmology] 人工智能（AI）正在白内障诊疗全流程中得到研究，但不同证据的成熟度差异很大，涵盖技术基准研究、经外部验证的模型、前瞻性临床评估以及常规诊疗中使用的工具。本叙述性综述批判性地总结了 AI 在白内障检测、人工晶状体（IOL）屈光度计算、围手术期风险评估、术中支持和术后随访中的应用，并特别强调证据质量、外部有效性和临床就绪程度。我们对 PubMed/MEDLINE 进行了结构化检索，纳入2018年1月1日至2025年3月31日发表的英文文献，并选择性保留与白内障风险预测、力反馈和眼科机器人相关的较早的开创性研究。证据按成熟度分类，从技术概念验证和回顾性内部验证，到外部或多中心验证、前瞻性临床评估，以及已证实的工作流程或患者层面获益。白内障检测方面最有力的证据来自经大规模外部验证的基于图像的模型，而智能手机系统仍对图像质量、病例构成和部署环境敏感。数据驱动的 IOL 公式可在特定数据集中改善屈光预测，但比较结果受常数优化、眼轴长度分布、IOL 型号、测量设备和双眼配对依赖性的影响。术中 AI 仍以手术阶段识别、分割和技术性能评估为主，直接临床获益的证据有限。术后对话式 AI 已进入多中心前瞻性临床评估，但其安全性取决于升级转诊路径、人工监督和本地工作流程设计。因此，AI 在白内障诊疗中的临床转化正在兴起但发展不均衡：少数应用已达到外部或前瞻性临床验证，而许多仍为回顾性或技术概念验证系统。未来的推广应基于外部验证、透明报告、前瞻性临床效用、部署后监测以及明确的监管和医疗法律责任，而不仅仅依据基准测试表现。

title: Artificial intelligence for video-based assessment of surgical performance in robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery in real operative settings: a systematic review.

summary: 系统综述评估AI基于真实患者机器人辅助手术视频评估技术技能的现有证据，并提出未来研究方向。
key_points: 检索Medline、Embase、Web of Science、Scopus等至2025年7月
仅纳入真实患者机器人手术视频研究

abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] Robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery requires specific skills of the surgeon beyond the mastery of conventional laparoscopic techniques. However, efficient and objective methods for evaluating these skills remain limited. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers potential for a more objective, video-based performance assessment. This systematic review aims to evaluate the current evidence of using AI for evaluation of surgical skill in real robotic surgery and outline potential avenues for future research. We systematically searched Ovid Medline, Embase, Clarivate Web of Science, ERIC Institute of Education Sciences and Scopus databases from inception to 10 July 2025, for studies evaluating AI-based technical skill assessment using videos of robot-assisted surgery performed on real patients. Study characteristics, AI approaches, assessment targets, reference standards, and model performance were extracted. Risk of bias and applicability were assessed using PROBAST + AI. Owing to differences in assessment constructs and reported performance measures, findings were synthesised using a structured narrative approach. In total, 2116 articles were identified, of which 5 met our eligibility criteria. AI approaches and assessment targets varied substantially across studies, including prediction of global technical skill scores, analysis of instrument-derived performance metrics, procedure-specific assessment, and surgical error detection. Reference standards included OSATS, GEARS or modified GEARS, PLACE, and procedural experience. Reported performance measures represented different constructs and were not directly comparable across studies. PROBAST + AI identified important methodological limitations, and no study reported external validation using an independent dataset. AI shows potential for video-based technical skill assessment in real robotic surgery, but current evidence is limited and heterogeneous. Future research should prioritise standardised annotation, multicentre intraoperative datasets, and external validation to support reliable translation into clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] 机器人辅助微创手术要求外科医生具备超出传统腹腔镜技术熟练程度的特定技能。然而，评估这些技能的高效且客观的方法仍然有限。人工智能（AI）为基于视频的更客观的表现评估提供了潜力。本系统综述旨在评估在真实机器人手术中使用 AI 评估手术技能的现有证据，并概述未来研究的可能方向。我们系统检索了 Ovid Medline、Embase、Clarivate Web of Science、ERIC Institute of Education Sciences 和 Scopus 数据库，检索时间从建库至 2025 年 7 月 10 日，纳入使用真实患者机器人辅助手术视频评估基于 AI 的技术技能评估的研究。提取了研究特征、AI 方法、评估目标、参考标准和模型性能。使用 PROBAST + AI 评估偏倚风险和适用性。由于评估构念和报告的性能指标存在差异，采用结构化叙述方法综合研究结果。共检索到 2116 篇文章，其中 5 篇符合我们的纳入标准。各研究的 AI 方法和评估目标差异很大，包括预测整体技术技能评分、分析源自器械的表现指标、针对特定手术的评估以及手术错误检测。参考标准包括 OSATS、GEARS 或改良 GEARS、PLACE 以及手术经验。所报告的性能指标代表不同的构念，各研究之间无法直接比较。PROBAST + AI 发现了重要的方法学局限，且没有研究报告使用独立数据集的外部验证。AI 在真实机器人手术中基于视频的技术技能评估方面显示出潜力，但目前的证据有限且异质性大。未来研究应优先考虑标准化标注、多中心术中数据集和外部验证，以支持其可靠地转化应用于临床实践。

title: Raman Spectroscopy for Glioma Diagnosis Toward Precision Neuro-Oncology: A Systematic Review.

summary: 一项按PRISMA 2020开展并在PROSPERO注册的系统综述，检索2015–2025年基于拉曼光谱的胶质瘤诊断研究，评估其诊断性能与转化成熟度。
key_points: 在PROSPERO注册，遵循PRISMA 2020
检索PubMed、Embase、Scopus、Web of Science
评估拉曼技术的诊断性能与转化就绪度

abstract: [Critical reviews in oncology/hematology] Gliomas are the most common primary malignant tumors of the central nervous system and remain difficult to manage because of diffuse infiltration and molecular heterogeneity. As glioma classification increasingly relies on molecular biomarkers, interest has grown in label-free technologies capable of providing real-time biochemical information during surgery. Although Raman spectroscopy has emerged as a promising optical approach, its diagnostic performance and translational readiness remain incompletely defined. This systematic review was registered in PROSPERO and conducted according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines. PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched for studies published between 2015 and 2025 evaluating Raman-based technologies for glioma diagnosis. Two reviewers independently performed study selection, data extraction, and risk-of-bias assessment using QUADAS-2. Owing to methodological heterogeneity, findings were synthesized using a SWiM-guided narrative approach. Forty-seven studies met the eligibility criteria. Across conventional Raman spectroscopy, surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy, stimulated Raman histology, stimulated Raman scattering, and multimodal platforms, Raman-based technologies consistently demonstrated strong performance for tissue discrimination, tumor margin assessment, molecular characterization, and intraoperative tissue evaluation. Recent studies increasingly integrated artificial intelligence for automated tissue classification and molecular prediction. However, substantial heterogeneity in acquisition protocols, analytical workflows, and validation strategies, together with predominantly retrospective single-center studies and limited external validation, reduced confidence in clinical generalizability. QUADAS-2 identified the greatest risk of bias in the patient-selection and index-test domains. Raman spectroscopy is evolving from an optical imaging technique into a molecular decision-support platform for precision neuro-oncology. Future clinical translation will depend on methodological standardization, prospective multicenter validation, explainable artificial intelligence, and integration into routine neurosurgical workflows.
zh_abstract: [Critical reviews in oncology/hematology] 胶质瘤是中枢神经系统最常见的原发性恶性肿瘤，由于其弥漫浸润和分子异质性，仍然难以处理。随着胶质瘤分类日益依赖分子生物标志物，人们对能够在术中提供实时生化信息的无标记技术的兴趣不断增加。尽管拉曼光谱已成为一种有前景的光学方法，但其诊断性能和转化应用的成熟度仍未被充分界定。本系统综述已在 PROSPERO 注册，并按照 PRISMA 2020 指南开展。检索了 PubMed、Embase、Scopus 和 Web of Science 中 2015 年至 2025 年间发表的评估基于拉曼技术用于胶质瘤诊断的研究。两名评审员独立进行研究筛选、数据提取，并使用 QUADAS-2 评估偏倚风险。由于方法学异质性，采用 SWiM 指导的叙述性方法对结果进行综合。共有 47 项研究符合纳入标准。在传统拉曼光谱、表面增强拉曼光谱、受激拉曼组织学、受激拉曼散射以及多模态平台中，基于拉曼的技术在组织鉴别、肿瘤边界评估、分子特征分析和术中组织评估方面始终表现出较强的性能。近期研究越来越多地整合人工智能用于自动化组织分类和分子预测。然而，采集方案、分析流程和验证策略存在显著异质性，加之研究以回顾性单中心为主且外部验证有限，降低了对其临床可推广性的信心。QUADAS-2 显示偏倚风险最大的是患者选择和待评价试验两个领域。拉曼光谱正从一种光学成像技术发展为面向精准神经肿瘤学的分子决策支持平台。未来的临床转化将取决于方法学标准化、前瞻性多中心验证、可解释的人工智能，以及融入常规神经外科工作流程。

abstract: [Journal of cardiovascular computed tomography] The year 2025 brought long-term outcome data supporting coronary CT angiography (CCTA)-guided management of stable chest pain, a proposed reframing of coronary artery disease around atherosclerosis rather than ischemia, and the first large-scale real-world evaluation of a national artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled CT-derived fractional flow reserve (FFR-CT) program. This review summarizes selected advances in cardiovascular computed tomography (CCT) published in print or online during 2025. The studies span coronary artery disease outcomes and prevention, quantitative plaque analysis, photon-counting detector CT, coronary artery calcium scoring, pericoronary inflammation imaging, AI and machine learning, structural and congenital heart disease, and consensus and training documents. For each study we summarize the design, principal findings, limitations, and likely clinical implications, and we close with the barriers, including technical standardization, vendor-specific thresholds, equitable access, and the need for randomized outcome trials, that must be addressed before many of these advances can be implemented broadly.
zh_abstract: [Journal of cardiovascular computed tomography] 2025年带来了支持以冠状动脉CT血管造影（CCTA）指导稳定型胸痛管理的长期结局数据、一项主张围绕动脉粥样硬化而非缺血来重新界定冠状动脉疾病的提议，以及首个对全国性人工智能（AI）赋能的CT衍生血流储备分数（FFR-CT）项目的大规模真实世界评估。本综述总结了2025年在纸质版或在线发表的心血管计算机断层扫描（CCT）领域的部分进展。这些研究涵盖冠状动脉疾病结局与预防、定量斑块分析、光子计数探测器CT、冠状动脉钙化积分、冠状动脉周围炎症成像、AI与机器学习、结构性和先天性心脏病，以及共识和培训文件。对于每项研究，我们总结了其设计、主要发现、局限性及可能的临床意义，并在最后讨论了在许多此类进展得以广泛应用之前必须解决的障碍，包括技术标准化、厂商特异性阈值、公平可及性，以及开展随机结局试验的必要性。

title: Benchmark of THReD: Evaluating an LLM Agent and Its Preprocessing Tools for Turning Electronic Health Records into AI-Ready Datasets
zh_title: THReD 基准：LLM 智能体将电子病历转为 AI 就绪数据集
summary: 预印本评测 THReD 聊天智能体：在 141 项合成 EHR 预处理任务中，首次回答完成率为 92.7%，并评估其工具的正确性与可复现性。

合成表格基于区域健康信息交换校准
