abstract: LLM agents are increasingly built into data-analysis software, yet little evidence shows how reliably they preprocess clinical data or whether the tools they invoke give correct, reproducible output. We report a benchmark of THReD, a web-based system that turns electronic health record (EHR) extracts into AI-ready datasets through a chat agent whose proposed steps run only after user confirmation. The agent benchmark has 141 tasks (100 templates) in seven categories, including goal-level requests, failure recovery, requests calling for no action, schema variation and prompt injection through the data, on synthetic tables calibrated to a regional health information exchange; success is judged by checks on the produced data. Over 2,550 episodes with Claude Haiku 5.5 in four context configurations, the deployed agent completed 92.7% (95% CI 88.1-96.4) of tasks on its first answer, abstained on every advice request, recovered from every injected fault, and never proposed an action requested by planted text. Without the data profile, completion fell to 58.0%; goal-level requests were hardest (80.6%). Six experiments on real records of two chronic-disease cohorts and on synthetic data at scale validate the tools: 91-92% of inferred patient classes and 99.7-99.8% of inferred vital-sign labels were correct in masked reconstruction; a dictionary builder combining curated dictionaries with LLM suggestions mapped 99.0% of 2,208 raw variants correctly; all 2,176 replays of 128 saved pipelines gave byte-identical files under pinned dependencies; subgroup differences in inference accuracy vanished within facility and lookup key; and the same-day consolidation rule changed 90-day emergency revisit rates by up to 3.2 points without shifting cohort composition by more than one point. Processing time grew roughly linearly to 5.5 million records while the prompt stayed at about 13 thousand tokens.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地被内置于数据分析软件中，但关于它们预处理临床数据的可靠性，以及它们所调用的工具能否给出正确且可重复的输出，目前证据甚少。我们报告了对 THReD 的基准测试。THReD 是一个基于网页的系统，通过聊天智能体将电子健康记录（EHR）提取数据转换为可用于 AI 的数据集，智能体提出的步骤仅在用户确认后才会执行。该智能体基准包含 141 项任务（100 个模板），分为七类，包括目标层面的请求、故障恢复、无需执行操作的请求、模式（schema）变异以及通过数据进行的提示注入，使用的是按某区域健康信息交换平台校准的合成表格；成功与否通过对所生成数据的检查来判定。在使用 Claude Haiku 5.5、四种上下文配置的 2,550 次测试回合中，已部署的智能体首次回答即完成了 92.7%（95% CI 88.1-96.4）的任务，对所有建议类请求均选择弃权，从所有注入的故障中恢复，并且从未提出由植入文本所要求的操作。在没有数据概况的情况下，完成率降至 58.0%；目标层面的请求最为困难（80.6%）。在两个慢性病队列的真实记录以及大规模合成数据上进行的六项实验验证了这些工具：在掩码重建中，推断的患者类别有 91-92% 正确，推断的生命体征标签有 99.7-99.8% 正确；结合人工整理词典与 LLM 建议的词典构建器，对 2,208 个原始变体中 99.0% 完成了正确映射；在固定依赖版本的条件下，对 128 条已保存流程的全部 2,176 次重放均产生了逐字节完全一致的文件；推断准确性的亚组差异在医疗机构和查找键内部消失；同日合并规则使 90 天急诊复诊率变化最多达 3.2 个百分点，而队列构成的变化不超过 1 个百分点。处理时间随记录数大致呈线性增长，直至 550 万条记录，而提示词保持在约 1.3 万个 token。

title: Accessed, never disclosed: Silent access to protected health information by medical artificial intelligence agents
zh_title: 静默访问：医疗AI智能体悄然读取受保护健康信息
summary: 研究在合成病历中植入canary，评估五种语言模型的智能体在无需标识符任务中是否不必要地调用PHI工具，发现仅看输出的评估会漏掉此类访问。
key_points: 五个模型、四级边界、七种攻击框架
三个模型不必要调用PHI工具
更严格的边界降低访问，残余多来自用户覆盖策略
reason: 预印本，针对医疗智能体隐私的新评估视角，合成数据，证据有限
abstract: Medical artificial intelligence agents should retrieve patient identifiers only when a task requires them, the data-minimization principle behind the HIPAA minimum necessary standard for protected health information (PHI). An agent can retrieve identifiers without revealing them. Such silent access remains invisible to evaluations that inspect only the output. We embedded canaries in synthetic patient records and linked each tool invocation to canary exposure in the final answers across five language models, four boundary levels, and seven attack frames for identifier-free clinical tasks. Three models invoked the PHI tools unnecessarily, whereas Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 did not. Stronger boundaries reduced this access, and the residual access under the strictest policy was confined to frames in which the user overrode the policy or asserted approval. A pre-execution gate given the task-necessity criterion nearly eliminated this access. Output-only evaluation cannot verify minimum-necessary access; boundaries, gates, and access-log audits are required together.
zh_abstract: 医疗人工智能智能体应仅在任务需要时才检索患者标识符，这是 HIPAA 对受保护健康信息（PHI）“最低必要”标准背后的数据最小化原则。智能体可以在不泄露标识符的情况下检索这些标识符。这种隐蔽的访问对仅检查输出的评估而言是不可见的。我们在合成患者记录中嵌入了金丝雀标记（canary），并在五个语言模型、四个边界级别和七种攻击框架下，针对不含标识符的临床任务，将每次工具调用与最终回答中的金丝雀暴露情况相关联。三个模型不必要地调用了 PHI 工具，而 Claude Opus 4.8 和 GPT-5.5 没有。更强的边界降低了这种访问，在最严格策略下残余的访问仅限于用户推翻策略或声称已获批准的框架。给定任务必要性标准的执行前闸门几乎消除了这种访问。仅基于输出的评估无法验证最低必要访问；需要同时采用边界、闸门和访问日志审计。

title: Training-Time Domain Transfer for Generator-Free Diagnostics on Novel Modalities in Computational Pathology
zh_title: 计算病理中面向新模态的训练时域迁移
summary: 提出训练时域迁移：用存档常规样本生成合成目标域训练数据，在未染色前列腺病理上直接诊断，一致性优于推理时虚拟染色。
key_points: 以未染色前列腺病理为概念验证
无需推理时生成，降低幻觉与监管复杂度
Cohen's κ 高于虚拟染色（原文所示0.59 vs 0.37）
reason: 有新意的病理预印本方法，有基线对比，证据有限
abstract: Novel imaging modalities promise improved diagnostics, but AI development is constrained by scarce training data. Inference-time domain transfer can address this by mapping novel modalities to established ones, enabling reuse of existing diagnostic models. However, this introduces hallucination risks, computational overhead, and regulatory complexity. Inspired by sim-to-real transfer, we propose training-time domain transfer, generating synthetic target-domain training data from archived routine samples to enable direct diagnosis on real inputs without inference-time generation. Using unstained prostate histopathology as a proof-of-concept, we compare this approach with inference-time virtual staining and conventional H&E-based cancer detection. Training-time transfer achieved higher concordance with the conventional benchmark than virtual staining for both raw (Cohen's $κ$=0.59 vs. 0.37; Gwet's AC1=0.73 vs. 0.29) and deparaffinized tissue ($κ$=0.66 vs. 0.61; AC1=0.73 vs. 0.64), supporting its potential for emerging diagnostic modalities.
zh_abstract: 新型成像模态有望改善诊断，但人工智能（AI）的开发受限于训练数据稀缺。推理阶段的域迁移（inference-time domain transfer）可通过将新型模态映射到已有模态来解决这一问题，从而复用现有的诊断模型。然而，这会带来幻觉风险、计算开销以及监管复杂性。受仿真到现实（sim-to-real）迁移的启发，我们提出训练阶段的域迁移（training-time domain transfer）：利用存档的常规样本生成合成的目标域训练数据，从而无需在推理阶段进行生成，即可直接对真实输入进行诊断。我们以未染色前列腺组织病理学作为概念验证，将该方法与推理阶段虚拟染色以及基于常规 H&E 的癌症检测进行比较。对于原始组织（Cohen's $κ$=0.59 对 0.37；Gwet's AC1=0.73 对 0.29）和脱蜡组织（$κ$=0.66 对 0.61；AC1=0.73 对 0.64），训练阶段迁移与常规基准的一致性均高于虚拟染色，这支持其在新兴诊断模态中的应用潜力。

title: Measuring AI Agents as Teammates with Collaborative Intelligence
zh_title: 以协作智能衡量AI智能体的团队协作能力
summary: 提出协作智能基准，含240项任务、8个团队协作维度，任务源自真实记录或既有基准，含临床案例，结果可程序化验证。
key_points: 评估AI智能体作为队友的能力
任务来自航空事故报告、临床案例、编程等
每项任务有可程序化验证的结果
reason: 智能体协作新基准，非医疗专属，预印本
abstract: Progress in AI is often measured by what a single model can do on its own. Yet teams of AI agents are starting to make breakthroughs and discoveries in science, medicine, mathematics and software engineering. As AI begins to work in teams of agents and people, the ability to collaborate becomes a core part of their intelligence. Research on human teams has measured this ability for decades. Inspired by this, we introduce the Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark, which measures how well an AI agent works as a teammate. It contains 240 tasks across 8 dimensions of teamwork, from refusing an unsafe shortcut to checking the work that a weaker model leaves behind. Each task comes from a real record or an existing benchmark, from aviation accident reports and clinical cases to coding tasks and negotiations, and has a programmatically verifiable outcome. To isolate teamwork from individual capability, models are scored only on tasks that they can solve by themselves when they have full information. We evaluate 18 closed- and open-weight models and find that every model, across sizes and families, has clear weaknesses as a teammate, with the best model scoring only 82.2 out of 100. Frontier models almost always refuse unsafe shortcuts and report misconduct, yet they cave under interpersonal pressure, reaching the best overall deal in only 14% of conflicts, and their pass rate drops from 97% to 81% when they take over a task in which a weaker model has cheated. Crucially, general capability does not guarantee good teamwork, as models with nearly the same capability score differ by up to 11 points as teammates. The benchmark includes 160 public tasks with code and data, along with 80 held-out tasks for evaluation. As AI agents increasingly work alongside other agents and people, the ability to collaborate effectively is becoming a crucial capability to measure and develop.
zh_abstract: 人工智能的进展通常以单个模型自身能做什么来衡量。然而，AI 智能体团队已开始在科学、医学、数学和软件工程领域取得突破和发现。随着 AI 开始在由智能体和人类组成的团队中工作，协作能力成为其智能的核心组成部分。针对人类团队的研究数十年来一直在衡量这种能力。受此启发，我们提出了协作智能基准（Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark），用于衡量 AI 智能体作为队友的表现。该基准包含涵盖团队协作 8 个维度的 240 项任务，从拒绝不安全的捷径到检查较弱模型遗留的工作。每项任务均来自真实记录或现有基准，涉及航空事故报告、临床病例、编程任务和谈判等，并具有可通过程序验证的结果。为了将团队协作与个体能力区分开来，模型仅在其掌握完整信息时能够独立解决的任务上计分。我们评估了 18 个闭源和开源权重模型，发现无论规模和系列，每个模型作为队友都有明显弱点，表现最佳的模型仅得 82.2 分（满分 100）。前沿模型几乎总是拒绝不安全的捷径并报告不当行为，但在人际压力下会让步，仅在 14% 的冲突中达成最佳整体协议；当它们接手一项较弱模型作弊过的任务时，通过率从 97% 降至 81%。关键的是，通用能力并不能保证良好的团队协作，能力得分几乎相同的模型作为队友的得分相差最多可达 11 分。该基准包含 160 项附带代码和数据的公开任务，以及 80 项用于评估的保留任务。随着 AI 智能体越来越多地与其他智能体和人类共同工作，有效协作的能力正成为一项亟需衡量和发展的关键能力。

title: SMILE: A Structured Multi-Agent Clinical Reasoning for Liver Ultrasound Understanding
zh_title: SMILE：用于肝脏超声理解的结构化多智能体临床推理
summary: 提出多专科智能体框架，经裁判引导的共识机制整合输出，用于肝脏超声结构化报告生成。
key_points: 针对单一推理路径的局限
含三个专门智能体及共识机制
面向肝脏超声报告生成
reason: VLM多智能体新方法，摘要未见充分验证
abstract: Automated liver ultrasound report generation improves the diagnosis of liver diseases by producing clinically structured descriptions of anatomical and disease-related findings. However, current generative vision-language models (VLMs) often rely on a single reasoning pathway that maps ultrasound appearance directly to textual descriptions. In addition to the inherent vision-language modality gap, this design is limited for liver ultrasound because disease interpretation is constrained by subtle visual evidence, heterogeneous disease patterns, and limited paired supervision. To address these limitations, we propose SMILE, a Structured Multi-agent clInicaL rEasoning framework that uses multiple complementary specialist agents to interpret ultrasound images and consolidates their outputs through a judge-guided consensus mechanism. Our approach employs three specialized agents: an image interpretation agent for morphological descriptions, a clinical-stage reasoning agent, and a visual question answering (VQA) agent for targeted queries. These agent responses are then aggregated and scrutinized by a judge VLM using a consensus filtering prompt to produce a unified, clinically coherent output. Across a public liver ultrasound dataset and an internal clinical dataset, SMILE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art VLMs, achieving up to 19.0\% improvement in ROUGE-1 and 18.8\% improvement in clinical F1-score, while reaching VQA F1-scores of 0.82 and 0.65 on public and internal datasets, respectively. These results demonstrate the potential of SMILE for data-scarce and limited-supervision clinical settings. Our models, datasets, and code are available \href{https://github.com/CMME-Lab/SMILE}{here}.
zh_abstract: 自动化肝脏超声报告生成通过生成具有临床结构的解剖及疾病相关发现描述，改善了肝脏疾病的诊断。然而，当前的生成式视觉-语言模型（VLM）往往依赖单一推理路径，将超声表现直接映射为文本描述。除了固有的视觉-语言模态差距外，这种设计对肝脏超声而言还存在局限，因为疾病解读受到细微视觉证据、异质性疾病表现以及配对监督有限的制约。为解决这些局限，我们提出了SMILE（Structured Multi-agent clInicaL rEasoning，结构化多智能体临床推理）框架，该框架利用多个互补的专家智能体解读超声图像，并通过由裁判引导的共识机制整合其输出。我们的方法采用三个专门的智能体：用于形态学描述的图像解读智能体、临床分期推理智能体，以及用于针对性提问的视觉问答（VQA）智能体。随后，这些智能体的回答由一个裁判VLM汇总，并通过共识过滤提示进行审查，以产生统一且临床上连贯的输出。在一个公开肝脏超声数据集和一个内部临床数据集上，SMILE始终优于最先进的VLM，ROUGE-1最高提升19.0%，临床F1分数最高提升18.8%，同时在公开和内部数据集上的VQA F1分数分别达到0.82和0.65。这些结果表明SMILE在数据稀缺和监督有限的临床场景中具有潜力。我们的模型、数据集和代码可在此获取：https://github.com/CMME-Lab/SMILE。

title: Window-Aware Scheduling for Health Messaging under Platform Delivery Constraints: Evidence from an AI-Powered WhatsApp Maternal and Infant Health Chatbot in Nigeria
zh_title: WhatsApp孕产婴健康聊天机器人的窗口感知消息调度
summary: 分析尼日利亚AI母婴健康WhatsApp聊天机器人向3,696名母亲发送的98,607条消息，发现24小时窗口关闭后自由文本消息发送失败率骤升93个百分点。
key_points: 窗口开启时35,500条自由消息零失败
两类流程占全部失败的66.1%
将窗口感知调度形式化为决策问题并做离线评估
reason: 真实部署大样本数据，有实践价值，但为预印本且偏平台工程问题
abstract: WhatsApp lets a business send free-form messages only within 24 hours of a user's last message; outside this customer service window, only pre-approved templates are delivered. Health chatbots inherit this rule, but its cost is rarely measured. We analyse 98,607 messages sent to 3,696 mothers by a WhatsApp maternal health chatbot in Nigeria, with a largely separate export as replication. No free-form message failed with the window open (0 of 35,500), and failure jumped by 93.0 percentage points (95% CI 87.0 to 99.1) at exactly 24 hours. Two flows produced 66.1% of failures, including an offer to speak with a medical professional that, as built, reached 0.3 in 100 mothers whose window had closed. We formalise window-aware scheduling as a decision problem with an action of known zero value. Model-based offline evaluation, with bounds for unconfirmed delivery, estimates that sending the offer as an approved template would reach 81.5 to 86.8 in 100 such mothers, against 16.6 for waiting and 11.6 for a reply prompt. In a calibrated simulation, tabular Q-learning converges to the same template rule and does not beat it in any of 13 stress tests, and opting out does not rise with message volume. The main gain comes from respecting the platform rule, and it needs no learning. All outcomes are deliveries, not health outcomes.
zh_abstract: WhatsApp 仅允许企业在用户最后一条消息发出后的 24 小时内发送自由格式消息；超出该客户服务窗口后，只有预先获批的模板消息才能送达。健康聊天机器人沿用了这一规则，但其代价很少被衡量。我们分析了尼日利亚一个 WhatsApp 孕产妇健康聊天机器人向 3,696 位母亲发送的 98,607 条消息，并以一份基本独立的导出数据作为重复验证。窗口开放时，没有任何自由格式消息发送失败（0/35,500），而在恰好 24 小时处，失败率上升了 93.0 个百分点（95% CI 87.0 至 99.1）。两个流程造成了 66.1% 的失败，其中包括一项与医疗专业人员交谈的邀请，按当前构建方式，它只触达了每 100 位窗口已关闭的母亲中的 0.3 位。我们将窗口感知调度形式化为一个含有已知零价值动作的决策问题。基于模型的离线评估（并对未确认送达设定了界限）估计，若将该邀请以获批模板发送，可触达每 100 位此类母亲中的 81.5 至 86.8 位，而等待为 16.6 位，回复提示为 11.6 位。在经校准的模拟中，表格型 Q 学习收敛到同样的模板规则，并且在 13 项压力测试中无一优于该规则，且退订率不随消息量增加而上升。主要收益来自遵守平台规则，无需任何学习。所有结局均为消息送达，而非健康结局。

title: The DynaCell Evaluation Suite for Dynamic 3D Virtual Staining of Live Cells
zh_title: DynaCell：活细胞动态3D虚拟染色评测套件
summary: 提出面向3D延时活细胞虚拟染色的评测套件，含配对有/无荧光标记的3D延时图像、基线模型和三层指标体系。
key_points: 配对3D延时成像数据与基线模型
三层指标含像素保真度与细胞器分割
填补体数据时序虚拟染色评测空白
reason: 新基准与数据有价值，但为预印本，规模和影响未明
abstract: Understanding how cells respond to perturbations over time is central to cell biology and drug discovery. Live-cell imaging captures the dynamics of perturbation-induced phenotypes in individual cells. While fluorescence imaging can visualize specific molecular phenotypes, labeling and repeated illumination often affect cell health. Virtual staining offers an alternative by predicting these fluorescence images from images acquired without fluorescent labels. Although many virtual staining models have been developed, their performance on volumetric time-lapse data remains poorly characterized. We address this gap with an evaluation suite for 3D time-lapse virtual staining of live cells. The suite combines paired 3D time-lapse images acquired with and without fluorescent labels, a set of baseline models, and three metric tiers measuring pixel-level fidelity, organelle segmentation performance, and single-cell phenotype similarity. Using this evaluation suite, we study metric and model behavior across 3 cell types, 2 microscopes, 4 organelles, and 3 perturbation states. We find that regression baselines better predict the spatial localization of target organelles, whereas the generative baseline better captures the distribution of phenotypes across cells. These differences expose trade-offs between structural and phenotypic fidelity that are obscured by single-metric evaluation and suggest how virtual staining models can be developed for diverse downstream tasks such as localization, segmentation, tracking, and phenotypic profiling. We release the curated datasets, baseline checkpoints, and evaluation code as part of DynaCell, a broader framework for image-based profiling of cell-state dynamics.
zh_abstract: 理解细胞如何随时间响应扰动，是细胞生物学和药物发现的核心。活细胞成像可捕捉单个细胞中扰动诱导表型的动态变化。荧光成像可以显示特定的分子表型，但标记和反复照射常会影响细胞健康。虚拟染色提供了一种替代方案，即根据无荧光标记获得的图像预测这些荧光图像。尽管已开发出许多虚拟染色模型，但它们在体积（三维）延时数据上的表现仍缺乏充分刻画。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一套用于活细胞三维延时虚拟染色的评估套件。该套件结合了有荧光标记和无荧光标记条件下获得的配对三维延时图像、一组基线模型，以及三个层级的指标，分别衡量像素级保真度、细胞器分割性能和单细胞表型相似性。利用该评估套件，我们研究了 3 种细胞类型、2 种显微镜、4 种细胞器和 3 种扰动状态下的指标与模型行为。我们发现，回归基线模型能更好地预测目标细胞器的空间定位，而生成式基线模型则能更好地捕捉细胞间表型的分布。这些差异揭示了结构保真度与表型保真度之间的权衡，而单一指标评估会掩盖这种权衡，并提示如何针对定位、分割、追踪和表型分析等多样的下游任务开发虚拟染色模型。我们将整理后的数据集、基线模型检查点和评估代码作为 DynaCell 的一部分发布，DynaCell 是一个面向细胞状态动态的基于图像分析的更广泛框架。

title: ECGJev: Question-Conditioned Option Scoring for 12-Lead ECG Interpretation
zh_title: ECGJev：问题条件化选项评分的12导联心电图解读
summary: 提出基于决策解码器的ECG框架，将波形特征压缩为16个token，一次前向对所有选项评分，在四个ECG基准上评测。
key_points: PTB-XL为71.68%，Chapman为96.86%
概念探针显示预测依赖ECG证据
reason: 多基准对比的新方法预印本，缺少外部临床验证
abstract: Clinical interpretation of a 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) often requires answering targeted diagnostic questions with clear, quantifiable decisions. We introduce ECGJev, the first ECG framework built on a decision decoder, a pretrained language model trained to return a probability for every listed option. A question-conditioned bridge compresses frozen waveform and spectrogram features into 16 ECG tokens, and a two-stage procedure adapts the bridge and low-rank adapters on the decoder's native option readout using diagnostic labels alone, scoring all options for a question in one forward pass. Evaluated across four ECG benchmarks, ECGJev achieves the highest macro-F1 on CPSC2018 (80.46%), PTB-XL (71.68%) and Chapman (96.86%), and generalizes competitively to the small-sample PTB cohort. Concept probes and perturbation analyses further show that its predictions rely directly on the ECG input, remain stable under option-order and wording variations, and transfer zero-shot to unseen waveform concepts. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhuoyuanli-lab/ECGJev.
zh_abstract: 12导联心电图（ECG）的临床解读通常需要针对特定诊断问题给出清晰、可量化的判断。我们提出了ECGJev，这是首个基于决策解码器（decision decoder）构建的ECG框架；决策解码器是一种预训练语言模型，经训练后可对列出的每个选项返回一个概率。一个以问题为条件的桥接模块将冻结的波形特征和频谱图特征压缩为16个ECG token，并采用两阶段流程，仅使用诊断标签，在解码器原生的选项读出上对桥接模块和低秩适配器进行适配，一次前向传播即可为某一问题的所有选项打分。在四个ECG基准上进行评估，ECGJev在CPSC2018（80.46%）、PTB-XL（71.68%）和Chapman（96.86%）上取得了最高的宏平均F1，并在小样本PTB队列上表现出具有竞争力的泛化能力。概念探针和扰动分析进一步表明，其预测直接依赖于ECG输入，在选项顺序和措辞变化下保持稳定，并可零样本迁移至未见过的波形概念。我们的代码公开于 https://github.com/zhuoyuanli-lab/ECGJev。

title: SurgPace: Complexity-Aware Progressive Distillation for Surgical Multimodal Large Language Models
zh_title: SurgPace：手术多模态大模型的复杂度感知渐进蒸馏
summary: 提出复杂度感知的连续课程式渐进蒸馏框架，用于构建紧凑的手术视觉语言模型，降低临床部署算力成本。
key_points: 针对手术样本难度与上下文差异大
早期强教师引导，后期偏任务监督
目标是紧凑可部署的手术MLLM
reason: 预印本，新颖蒸馏方法，摘要未见结果；手术多模态略加分
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential in robotic surgery for question answering, scene understanding, and grounded assistance, but their high computational cost limits real clinical deployment. Knowledge distillation provides a practical way to build compact surgical MLLMs, yet direct distillation is not well suited to surgical data because surgical samples vary greatly in difficulty, visual ambiguity, and required clinical context, making uniform teacher-student transfer unstable. In addition, the role of supervision changes during training: early stages require stronger teacher guidance for multimodal alignment, while later stages rely more on task supervision for effective optimization. To address these challenges, we propose SurgPace, a complexity-aware continuous curriculum framework for progressive distillation of surgical vision-language models. SurgPace estimates sample complexity using predictive confidence and Lorentz geometric consistency, and uses the fused score to guide a continuous easy-to-hard training process. We further introduce hierarchical representation alignment, which aligns the student with the teacher at the feature, logit, and probability levels, while gradually shifting the training focus from teacher imitation to task supervision. This design separates sample-level curriculum from objective-level scheduling, leading to more stable and effective distillation. We evaluate SurgPace on Surg-396K, a benchmark built from four public surgical datasets and covering five dialogue paradigms. SurgPace consistently outperforms strong MLLM distillation baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness for building compact, memory-efficient surgical MLLMs with faster decoding under controlled benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/hezhicheng2002/SurgPace.
zh_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在机器人手术的问答、场景理解和落地辅助（grounded assistance）方面已显示出强大潜力，但其高昂的计算成本限制了其在真实临床环境中的部署。知识蒸馏为构建紧凑的手术MLLM提供了一条切实可行的途径，然而直接蒸馏并不适合手术数据，因为手术样本在难度、视觉模糊性以及所需临床背景方面差异很大，使得统一的师生迁移不稳定。此外，训练过程中监督的作用也在变化：早期阶段需要更强的教师指导以实现多模态对齐，而后期则更依赖任务监督以实现有效优化。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了SurgPace，一种面向手术视觉-语言模型渐进式蒸馏的、具有复杂度感知的连续课程学习框架。SurgPace利用预测置信度和洛伦兹（Lorentz）几何一致性来估计样本复杂度，并利用融合后的得分引导由易到难的连续训练过程。我们进一步提出分层表征对齐，在特征、logit和概率三个层面使学生模型与教师模型对齐，同时将训练重心从教师模仿逐步转向任务监督。该设计将样本层面的课程与目标层面的调度分离，使蒸馏更加稳定有效。我们在Surg-396K上评估SurgPace，该基准由四个公开手术数据集构建而成，涵盖五种对话范式。SurgPace持续优于强大的MLLM蒸馏基线，表明其在受控基准下可有效用于构建紧凑、节省内存且解码更快的手术MLLM。代码见 https://github.com/hezhicheng2002/SurgPace。

title: Where Is a Prediction Model Miscalibrated, and for Whom? Local Audits in Outcome-Learned Pockets
zh_title: 预测模型在何处、对谁失准：结局学习口袋的局部审计
summary: 提出利用随机森林相似度将观测分组为“口袋”，审计预测模型局部校准偏差及不同人口学群体间差异，并给出同时置信区间。
key_points: 仅需特征、结局与固定预测值
口袋在一个样本学习、另一样本检验
在17个模拟场景中验证植入误差检测
reason: 模型校准与公平审计方法，有新意但证据有限
abstract: Overall and group-level averages, and ranking metrics such as the AUC, can hide sets of observations for which a prediction model systematically over- or under-predicts. We present an audit that asks where a model is miscalibrated (in which sets of similar observations it over- or under-predicts on average) and for whom (whether its average prediction error differs between demographic groups, such as by race or sex, within the same set). It groups observations into pockets using random-forest similarity, which weighs each feature by its importance for predicting the outcome, with a ridge-regression grouping alongside. Pockets are learned on one sample and tested on another, with simultaneous confidence intervals that allow for correlation within units such as hospitals; the audit needs only features, outcomes and fixed predictions. In 17 simulation scenarios with an error planted for one group, the combined audit located it better than the strongest alternative grouping in 15, with false-alarm rates near or below 5%; with a local error planted for everyone, it won in 12 of 15 scenarios at the smaller error size and lost when the error was unrelated to the outcome. In public synthetic data from the care-management algorithm studied by Obermeyer et al., it found no detectable overall error but under-prediction of illness in the sickest pockets and over-prediction elsewhere, and distinguished Black patients' concentration where the score under-predicted for everyone from a Black-White gap within pockets. For APACHE IVa, an exploratory analysis located its previously reported over-prediction of ICU mortality in a mostly ventilated pocket and a low-risk pocket, with none detected in a moderate-risk one. Two chest X-ray classifiers showed offsetting local errors behind no detectable overall error. Code: https://github.com/modenesi/pocket-audit
zh_abstract: 总体和分组层面的平均值，以及AUC等排序指标，可能掩盖预测模型系统性高估或低估的观测集合。我们提出一种审计方法，用于探究模型在何处存在校准偏差（即在哪些相似观测集合上平均而言高估或低估），以及针对谁存在偏差（即在同一集合内，不同人口学群体（如种族或性别）之间的平均预测误差是否不同）。该方法利用随机森林相似度将观测分组为“口袋”（pockets），该相似度按各特征对预测结果的重要性进行加权，同时辅以岭回归分组。口袋在一个样本上学习，在另一个样本上检验，并使用允许医院等单位内部存在相关性的同时置信区间；该审计仅需特征、结局和固定的预测值。在17个针对某一群体植入误差的模拟情景中，组合审计在15个情景中比最强的替代分组更好地定位了误差，假警报率接近或低于5%；在针对所有人植入局部误差的情形中，在较小误差规模下，其在15个情景中的12个胜出，而当误差与结局无关时则表现较差。在Obermeyer等人研究的医疗管理算法的公开合成数据中，该方法未发现可检测的总体误差，但发现在病情最重的口袋中低估了疾病，而在其他口袋中高估，并区分了黑人患者集中于评分对所有人均低估的区域，与口袋内部存在的黑人—白人差距。对于APACHE IVa，一项探索性分析将其先前报告的ICU死亡率高估定位在一个以通气患者为主的口袋和一个低风险口袋中，而在一个中等风险口袋中未检测到。两个胸部X线分类器显示，在未检出总体误差的背后存在相互抵消的局部误差。代码：https://github.com/modenesi/pocket-audit

title: A Scientific Claim Stability Framework for Evaluating MRI Morphometry Pipelines
zh_title: 评估MRI形态测量流程的科学结论稳定性框架
summary: 提出以结论为中心的SCS框架，将ROI形态测量表转为可审计的结论卡，在3个数据集、5个队列共10,370例MRI上评估不同流程、图谱下结论的稳定性。
key_points: 生成2,783张结论卡，评估89个结论族对
区分稳定、可迁移与脆弱结论
FreeSurfer 8与FastSurfer证据一致性高但解剖支持重叠低
reason: 预印本，多队列大样本评估框架有新意，但临床证据有限
abstract: MRI morphometry pipelines are often evaluated by measurement agreement or downstream accuracy, yet their scientific value depends on the conclusions they support. Two pipelines can produce similar feature-level results yet support different conclusions about aging, cognitive decline, or neurodegeneration. We introduce Scientific Claim Stability (SCS), a claim-centric evaluation framework that converts region-of-interest (ROI) morphometry tables into auditable claim cards and evaluates their support under changes in dataset, processing pipeline, atlas, feature family, and target. Across 10,370 MRI scans from three datasets and five cohorts, SCS generates 2,783 claim cards and evaluates 89 claim-family pairs. The evaluation distinguishes stable, transferable, and fragile claims. FreeSurfer 8-FastSurfer comparisons show high evidence concordance and low anatomical-support overlap under the primary covariate specification. Acquisition-adjusted analyses show that the magnitude of support disagreement depends on the model specification. Structured review by specialists in geriatrics, neuroscience, and radiology, alongside auxiliary ChatGPT and Gemini reviewers, assesses claim plausibility, clarity, faithfulness, usefulness, and caution. SCS provides a reproducible way to audit the evidential stability of morphometry claims without assuming a universal gold standard.
zh_abstract: MRI形态测量流程通常通过测量一致性或下游准确性来评估，但其科学价值取决于其所支持的结论。两个流程可能产生相似的特征层面结果，却对衰老、认知衰退或神经退行性变得出不同的结论。我们提出了科学主张稳定性（Scientific Claim Stability，SCS），这是一个以主张为中心的评估框架，它将感兴趣区（ROI）形态测量表转换为可审计的主张卡片，并在数据集、处理流程、图谱、特征族和目标变化的情况下评估其支持程度。在来自三个数据集和五个队列的10,370例MRI扫描中，SCS生成了2,783张主张卡片，并评估了89个主张—族对。该评估区分了稳定、可迁移和脆弱的主张。FreeSurfer 8与FastSurfer的比较显示，在主要协变量设定下，证据一致性高而解剖学支持重叠度低。经采集因素校正的分析表明，支持度分歧的幅度取决于模型设定。由老年医学、神经科学和放射学专家进行的结构化评审，以及辅助的ChatGPT和Gemini评审者，评估了主张的合理性、清晰度、忠实性、实用性和审慎性。SCS提供了一种可复现的方法来审计形态测量主张的证据稳定性，而无需假定存在通用的金标准。

title: FindLink: Learning to Assess Scientific Connections from Source-Grounded Premises
zh_title: FindLink：基于来源依据前提评估科学关联
summary: 提出消化道肿瘤领域含10,282个问题的GI-TraceBench基准及两阶段溯源推理框架FindLink。
key_points: 基准统一溯源问答、知识发现与假设评估
前提落地后生成支持计划并经编译器验证
聚焦消化道肿瘤文献推理
reason: 预印本，新基准加科学发现方向，但证据有限
abstract: Scientific discovery from the literature requires assessing connections among findings obtained under different study conditions. Source attribution makes individual findings traceable, but does not determine what they jointly support. We introduce GI-TraceBench, a benchmark of 10,282 questions in gastrointestinal oncology that unifies provenance question answering, knowledge discovery, and hypothesis evaluation through shared Paper, Claim, and Evidence Span records. We further propose FindLink, a two-stage framework for provenance-grounded scientific reasoning. Premise Grounding constructs source-bound premises with explicit study context and support status. Structured Reasoning organizes these premises into support plans that represent both supported relations and unresolved conditions, then generates evidence-conditioned answers using deterministic compiler feedback. The compiler verifies structural and source-binding consistency, but does not assess scientific entailment. On the 1,545-question fixed-evidence test set, FindLink improves the balanced family macro score from 67.95 to 87.25 over direct supervised fine-tuning of the same backbone. A retrained variant without Structured Reasoning achieves slightly higher premise-identifier F1, but substantially lower relation and evidence-sufficiency F1. These results indicate that scientific reasoning requires not only identifying grounded premises, but also assessing what connections those premises support.
zh_abstract: 从文献中进行科学发现，需要评估在不同研究条件下获得的各项发现之间的联系。来源归因使单个发现可追溯，但无法确定这些发现共同支持什么结论。我们提出 GI-TraceBench，这是一个包含 10,282 个问题的胃肠肿瘤学基准，通过共享的论文（Paper）、论断（Claim）和证据片段（Evidence Span）记录，统一了溯源问答、知识发现和假设评估。我们进一步提出 FindLink，一个用于基于溯源的科学推理的两阶段框架。前提落地（Premise Grounding）构建绑定来源的前提，并明确研究背景和支持状态。结构化推理（Structured Reasoning）将这些前提组织为支持方案，既表示已获支持的关系，也表示尚未解决的条件，然后利用确定性编译器反馈生成以证据为条件的答案。该编译器验证结构及来源绑定的一致性，但不评估科学蕴含关系。在包含 1,545 个问题的固定证据测试集上，FindLink 将均衡的家族宏平均得分从同一骨干模型直接监督微调的 67.95 提高到 87.25。去除结构化推理后重新训练的变体，其前提标识符 F1 略高，但关系 F1 和证据充分性 F1 显著更低。这些结果表明，科学推理不仅需要识别有据可依的前提，还需要评估这些前提支持何种联系。

title: Multimodal Prompt Learning with Dual-Granularity Contrastive Alignment for Preoperative Prediction of Lung Adenocarcinoma Invasiveness Using 3D CT
zh_title: 基于3D CT的多模态提示学习预测肺腺癌侵袭性
summary: 预印本提出双粒度图文对比对齐的多模态提示学习框架，结合3D ResNet-CBAM与冻结RadBERT，用于术前区分浸润性腺癌与癌前病变。
key_points: 3D ResNet-CBAM提取视觉特征，RadBERT加可学习提示
报告级与关键词级双粒度对比对齐
用临床报告语义初始化提示
reason: 多模态图文方法有新意，但摘要未见外部验证，预印本
abstract: Accurate preoperative prediction of lung adenocarcinoma invasiveness is important for surgical planning and individualized treatment. However, overlapping CT appearances make it challenging to distinguish invasive adenocarcinoma (IAD) from Pre-IAD lesions. We propose a multimodal prompt-learning framework with dual-granularity image-text alignment for 3D CT-based IAD classification. A 3D ResNet-CBAM encoder extracts global and spatial visual features. A frozen RadBERT backbone is adapted with separate learnable prompts for report-level and keyword-level text encoding. These prompts are initialized using semantic representations derived from real-world clinical reports. Global contrastive alignment connects whole-volume CT representations with reports generated from clinician-annotated radiological attributes to provide overall semantic supervision. A multiple instance learning-based local alignment module associates spatial CT features with vascular-focused radiological keywords, to capture local imaging characteristics potentially associated with tumor invasion. The framework jointly optimizes classification and alignment objectives, while inference requires only CT images. Experiments included 1,593 pathologically confirmed nodules. On the test set, the proposed method achieved an accuracy of 87.92%, F1-score of 87.78%, and AUC of 0.9499. Its AUC significantly exceeded that of the image-only Res-CBAM baseline with the same visual backbone (0.9297; DeLong test, p = 0.0078). Ablation analyses supported the complementary contributions of global and local alignment and the benefit of report-based prompt initialization. Qualitative visualizations showed activation within nodules and adjacent vascular structures. These findings suggest that dual-granularity radiological supervision can enhance CT-based invasiveness prediction while preserving a CT-only inference workflow.
zh_abstract: 术前准确预测肺腺癌的侵袭性对于手术规划和个体化治疗具有重要意义。然而，CT 表现相互重叠，使得区分浸润性腺癌（IAD）与浸润前病变（Pre-IAD）具有挑战性。我们提出了一种具有双粒度图像-文本对齐的多模态提示学习框架，用于基于 3D CT 的 IAD 分类。3D ResNet-CBAM 编码器用于提取全局和空间视觉特征。冻结的 RadBERT 主干网络通过分别针对报告级和关键词级文本编码的可学习提示进行适配。这些提示使用来源于真实世界临床报告的语义表示进行初始化。全局对比对齐将整体 CT 体积表示与由临床医师标注的影像学属性生成的报告相连接，以提供整体语义监督。基于多示例学习的局部对齐模块将 CT 空间特征与以血管为重点的影像学关键词相关联，以捕捉可能与肿瘤侵袭相关的局部影像特征。该框架联合优化分类目标和对齐目标，而推理阶段仅需 CT 图像。实验纳入了 1,593 个经病理证实的结节。在测试集上，所提方法的准确率为 87.92%，F1 分数为 87.78%，AUC 为 0.9499。其 AUC 显著高于使用相同视觉主干网络的仅图像 Res-CBAM 基线（0.9297；DeLong 检验，p = 0.0078）。消融分析支持全局对齐与局部对齐的互补作用，以及基于报告的提示初始化的益处。定性可视化显示结节内及邻近血管结构出现激活。这些结果提示，双粒度影像学监督可在保持仅需 CT 的推理流程的同时，提升基于 CT 的侵袭性预测。

title: State-Aware Virtual Patient Simulation for Training Psychiatrists in Challenging Clinical Scenarios
zh_title: 面向精神科医生培训的状态感知虚拟患者模拟
summary: 提出一种状态感知的虚拟患者模拟流程，在交互中维护动态演化的患者心理状态并编排患者行为，而非完全交由LLM生成回应，用于训练精神科医生应对高风险情境。
key_points: 针对自杀意念、幻觉等高风险场景训练
维护演化的患者状态，不完全依赖LLM回应
预印本，摘要未见评估结果
reason: 精神健康方向LLM智能体新方法，预印本，摘要未见评估证据
abstract: Psychiatrists must be prepared to manage patients exhibiting challenging psychological states, including suicidal ideation, hallucinations, and other high-risk behaviors. However, opportunities to safely practice such interactions are limited. While recent conversational agents can simulate patients, existing approaches largely rely on large language models (LLMs) to determine patient responses, making it difficult to consistently maintain psychological state, adapt to the clinician's responses, and generate clinically plausible challenges that meaningfully test the clinician. We present a state-aware virtual patient simulation pipeline for training psychiatrists in challenging clinical scenarios. The proposed system maintains an evolving patient state throughout the interaction and orchestrates patient behavior rather than leaving response generation entirely to an LLM. At each interaction, a learning-based behavioral strategy selector determines the type and level of challenge appropriate to the current patient and clinician context. The selected strategy, patient state, clinician response, interaction history, and relevant clinical knowledge are then provided as grounded context to an LLM to generate a semantically relevant and psychologically consistent patient response. Following each session, the system analyzes the interaction and provides feedback to the clinician on their communication and management of the virtual patient.
zh_abstract: 精神科医师必须做好准备，应对表现出具有挑战性心理状态的患者，包括自杀意念、幻觉及其他高风险行为。然而，安全地练习此类互动的机会有限。尽管近期的对话式智能体可以模拟患者，但现有方法在很大程度上依赖大语言模型（LLM）来决定患者的回应，因而难以持续保持心理状态、适应临床医师的回应，并生成能够对临床医师形成有意义考验且在临床上合理的挑战。我们提出了一种用于在具有挑战性的临床情境中培训精神科医师的状态感知虚拟患者模拟流程。所提系统在整个互动过程中维护一个不断演变的患者状态，并统筹患者行为，而不是将回应生成完全交给 LLM。在每次互动中，一个基于学习的行为策略选择器根据当前患者和临床医师的情境确定适当的挑战类型和水平。随后，所选策略、患者状态、临床医师的回应、互动历史以及相关临床知识作为有依据的上下文提供给 LLM，以生成语义相关且心理上一致的患者回应。每次会话结束后，系统分析该互动，并就临床医师对虚拟患者的沟通和处理向其提供反馈。
