title: VIGAT: VLM-guided gene activity quantification from single-cell ATAC-seq
zh_title: VIGAT：视觉语言模型引导的单细胞ATAC-seq基因活性量化
summary: 预印本提出VIGAT工具，用VLM解读ATAC覆盖图以选择基因特异区域，在196个配对scRNA/scATAC数据集上优于五种现有方法。
key_points: VLM自动解读ATAC覆盖图并选择区域
生成基因-细胞活性矩阵
196个配对数据集上优于五种方法
reason: 新颖的VLM用于单细胞组学，对比基线较充分，但属预印本
abstract: Summary: Gene activity quantification from single-cell ATAC-seq is challenging because genomic regions informative of cell identity can vary across genes and tissues, while broadly accessible regions may provide limited cell-type-discriminative information. We developed VIGAT, a vision-language model (VLM)-guided tool that automates visual interpretation of ATAC coverage plots for adaptive gene activity quantification. VIGAT jointly examines accessibility patterns across multiple marker genes, integrating genomic annotations and biological context to select gene-specific regions enriched for cluster-discriminative signals. Selected regions are used to generate a gene-by-cell activity matrix. Across 196 paired single-cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq datasets, VIGAT outperformed five existing methods in recovering marker-associated accessibility enriched in the corresponding cell populations, demonstrating the utility of VLM-guided visual reasoning for scalable gene activity quantification. Availability and implementation: VIGAT is implemented as an open-source R package and is freely available at https://github.com/beijie02/VIGAT.
zh_abstract:
【摘要】由于对细胞身份具有提示性的基因组区域可因基因和组织而异，而广泛可及的区域可能仅提供有限的细胞类型区分信息，因此基于单细胞ATAC-seq的基因活性定量具有挑战性。我们开发了VIGAT，这是一种由视觉-语言模型（VLM）引导的工具，可自动对ATAC覆盖度图进行视觉解读，以实现自适应的基因活性定量。VIGAT联合考察多个标记基因的可及性模式，整合基因组注释和生物学背景，选择富含簇区分信号的基因特异性区域。所选区域用于生成基因-细胞活性矩阵。在196个配对的单细胞RNA-seq和ATAC-seq数据集中，VIGAT在恢复相应细胞群体中富集的标记相关可及性方面优于五种现有方法，证明了VLM引导的视觉推理在可扩展基因活性定量中的实用性。
【可用性与实现】VIGAT以开源R包形式实现，可在 https://github.com/beijie02/VIGAT 免费获取。

title: DEEPNET-LLM: Highly accurate structure prediction of unknown metabolites from mass spectra via their molecular neighborhoods
zh_title: DEEPNET-LLM：借分子邻域从质谱预测未知代谢物结构
summary: 利用分子社区网络限定查询谱的局部代谢组邻域，并以LLM推理传播结构信息，从质谱预测未知代谢物结构。
key_points: 针对超90%未注释的代谢组“暗物质”
分子社区网络限制搜索空间
LLM推理传播邻近分子结构信息
reason: 预印本，LLM用于生物医学发现，新方法，细节证据有限
abstract: Most molecular features detected by untargeted mass spectrometry-based metabolomics remain unannotated. This so-called 'dark matter' currently comprises more than 90% and likely holds uncharacterized bioactive chemistry. Structure prediction from fragmentation spectra remains an outstanding challenge, because a spectrum does not uniquely determine a structure and the space of candidate structures is mostly unbounded; correspondingly, existing methods rarely return the correct de novo structure as their top prediction. Here we describe De novo Ego network-Enabled Propagation and Neighborhood Extrapolation of Topology using Large Language Models (DEEPNET-LLM) reasoning approach, which uses Molecular Community Networking (MCN) to restrict the search of a query spectrum to its local neighborhood within the global metabolome, and applies AI reasoning to propagate structural information from neighbors to the query. For a collection of 900 authentic standards (2,249 spectra) that have never been publicly released to exclude possibility of data leakage, DEEPNET-LLM returned the correct structure as its top prediction for 84.7% of spectra. Accuracy was independent of precursor mass across a range over which the number of candidate structures grows by 30 orders of magnitude, and was comparable across ion polarity, adducts and in-source fragmentation. On a random subset of the public MassSpecGym benchmark, DEEPNET-LLM reached 85.9% top-1 accuracy excluding stereochemistry. We showcase the use of DEEPNET-LLM with an example of a discovery of tryptamine amidate of a bile acid in mouse gut, confirmed against a synthetic standard. The DEEPNET-LLM approach is orthogonal to existing in silico methods and can be combined with them.
zh_abstract: 基于质谱的非靶向代谢组学所检测到的大多数分子特征仍未被注释。这部分所谓的“暗物质”目前占比超过90%，很可能蕴含尚未被表征的生物活性化学物质。根据碎裂谱预测结构仍是一项悬而未决的难题，因为一张谱图并不能唯一确定一个结构，且候选结构空间大多没有边界；相应地，现有方法很少能将正确的从头结构作为其首选预测结果返回。在此，我们介绍基于大语言模型的从头自我网络驱动的拓扑传播与邻域外推（De novo Ego network-Enabled Propagation and Neighborhood Extrapolation of Topology using Large Language Models，DEEPNET-LLM）推理方法，该方法利用分子群落网络（Molecular Community Networking，MCN）将查询谱图的搜索范围限制在其于全局代谢组内的局部邻域，并应用人工智能推理将邻近谱图的结构信息传递给查询谱图。对于一组从未公开发布（以排除数据泄露可能性）的900种真实标准品（2,249张谱图），DEEPNET-LLM对84.7%的谱图返回了正确结构作为其首选预测。在候选结构数量增长30个数量级的前体质量范围内，准确率与前体质量无关，并且在离子极性、加合物和源内碎裂方面表现相当。在公共MassSpecGym基准的一个随机子集上，不考虑立体化学时，DEEPNET-LLM的top-1准确率达到85.9%。我们以在小鼠肠道中发现一种胆汁酸的色胺酰胺化物为例展示了DEEPNET-LLM的应用，并经合成标准品证实。DEEPNET-LLM方法与现有的计算机模拟方法相互正交，可与之结合使用。

title: LOTUS: lineage-aware optimal transport reconstructs continuous clonal fate dynamics
zh_title: LOTUS：谱系感知最优传输重建连续克隆命运动力学
summary: 提出结合时间分辨转录组快照与克隆谱系信息的最优传输框架，在模拟和LARRY造血数据上降低谱系不一致的传输并改进轨迹重建。
key_points: 耦合克隆级最优传输与神经非平衡传输
在LARRY造血scRNA-seq上重建分支轨迹
reason: 有基线对比的新方法预印本，证据有限
abstract: Destructive sampling in single-cell sequencing obscures ancestor-descendant relationships, limiting the continuous reconstruction of cell-fate dynamics. Here we present Lineage-aware optimal transport for unbalanced single-cell dynamics (LOTUS), a framework that integrates time-resolved transcriptomic snapshots with clonal lineage information from engineered barcodes or endogenous T cell receptor clonotypes. LOTUS couples clone-level optimal transport with neural unbalanced transport to model continuous cellular state change, population growth and clonal propagation under lineage-consistent constraints. In branching simulations, LOTUS reduced lineage-inconsistent transport relative to benchmark methods, lowering off-target routing from 4.94-14.84% to 1.10%. On LARRY lineage-barcode scRNA-seq of hematopoiesis, LOTUS reconstructed branching trajectories, improved early neutrophil-monocyte fate-boundary prediction, and inferred multi-fate progenitors and fate-biased meta-clones, linking their distinct fate potentials to inferred epigenetic priming. On CellTagging scRNA-seq of fibroblast reprogramming, it distinguished reprogrammed from failed trajectories and prioritized fate-associated perturbation genes. In longitudinal scRNA-seq and TCR-seq of malaria-responsive memory (CD45RA-) CD4+ T cells, it preserved endogenous clonotype structure and reconstructed TR1 dynamics and regulatory networks. LOTUS thus converts lineage-resolved single-cell snapshots into interpretable, continuous models of fate dynamics and their regulatory programs.
zh_abstract: 单细胞测序中的破坏性取样会掩盖祖先与后代之间的关系，限制了对细胞命运动态的连续重建。在此，我们提出用于非平衡单细胞动态的谱系感知最优传输（Lineage-aware optimal transport for unbalanced single-cell dynamics，LOTUS）框架，该框架将时间分辨的转录组快照与来自工程化条形码或内源性T细胞受体克隆型的克隆谱系信息整合在一起。LOTUS将克隆水平的最优传输与神经非平衡传输相结合，在谱系一致性约束下对连续的细胞状态变化、群体增长和克隆扩增进行建模。在分支模拟中，相较于基准方法，LOTUS减少了谱系不一致的传输，将脱靶路由从4.94-14.84%降至1.10%。在造血系统的LARRY谱系条形码scRNA-seq数据上，LOTUS重建了分支轨迹，改善了早期中性粒细胞-单核细胞命运边界的预测，并推断出多命运祖细胞和命运偏向性元克隆，将它们各自不同的命运潜能与推断的表观遗传预置（priming）联系起来。在成纤维细胞重编程的CellTagging scRNA-seq数据上，它区分了重编程成功与失败的轨迹，并对与命运相关的扰动基因进行了优先排序。在疟疾应答性记忆（CD45RA-）CD4+ T细胞的纵向scRNA-seq和TCR-seq数据中，它保留了内源性克隆型结构，并重建了TR1动态及调控网络。因此，LOTUS可将谱系解析的单细胞快照转化为可解释的、连续的命运动态模型及其调控程序。

title: Development and cross-cohort evaluation of a multimodal deep-learning model for ER, PR and HER2 status classification in breast cancer
zh_title: 乳腺癌ER、PR、HER2状态分类的多模态深度学习模型及跨队列评估
summary: 模型整合全切片图像、转录组、年龄和分期，在TCGA-BRCA开发并在CPTAC-BRCA外部评估，考察增量价值、对HER2转录本依赖及校准迁移。
key_points: TCGA-BRCA 1051例开发，CPTAC-BRCA 120例评估
分析含配对比较、转录本移除、重校准
CPTAC曾在早期开发中被观察，仅13例HER2阳性
reason: 病理多模态有跨队列评估，但外部样本小且存在数据泄露风险，预印本
abstract: Background. Estrogen receptor (ER), progesterone receptor (PR) and HER2 status guide systemic treatment in breast cancer. Multimodal models are rarely benchmarked against key biomarker molecular baselines or evaluated for cross-cohort calibration. We assessed incremental value, dependence on label-proximal HER2 transcripts, and transport of discrimination and calibration. Methods. A model combining whole-slide images, transcriptomes, age and stage was developed in TCGA-BRCA (1051 patients; ER/PR/HER2 analysis sets: 1001/998/1006) and evaluated in CPTAC-BRCA (120 patients; 118/113/95). CPTAC had been observed during earlier development and included 13 HER2-positive cases. Analyses included paired model comparisons, transcript removal, alternative loss functions and recalibration. Internal discrimination used pooled out-of-fold predictions; external discrimination used fold-mean estimates, with ensemble calibration reported separately. Internal calibration and macro-AUC uncertainty were interpreted as exploratory. Results. Internal AUCs were 0.943 for ER, 0.901 for PR, and 0.860 for HER2; external AUCs were 0.952, 0.937, and 0.918, respectively. External macro-AUC was 0.936 for the multimodal model and 0.957 for logistic regression using ESR1, PGR, and ERBB2 (difference -0.021). Removal of the extended 29-transcript 17q12-q21 region changed HER2 AUC by -0.035 [-0.058 to -0.013] (95% CI) internally and by -0.042 [-0.089 to -0.007] externally relative to the baseline multimodal model. For external 15-model ensemble predictions, recalibrated HER2 expected calibration error (ECE) was 0.236, exceeding the ECE reference ceiling of 0.125, while calibration-in-the-large was -1.657 [-2.373 to -1.023] (profile-likelihood 95% CI), indicating systematic overprediction. ER and PR also showed overprediction. In paired fold-mean comparisons, HER2 ECE and Brier score favoured the three-transcript model (ESR1, PGR, and ERBB2). Conclusions. A multimodal deep-learning model achieved high discrimination across cohorts but did not demonstrate clear incremental value over a parsimonious three-transcript baseline, while cross-cohort calibration remained a substantial challenge. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating incremental value, calibration, and clinical utility alongside discrimination when assessing AI-based prediction models for medical use.
zh_abstract: 【背景】雌激素受体（ER）、孕激素受体（PR）和HER2状态指导乳腺癌的全身治疗。多模态模型很少与关键生物标志物的分子基线进行基准比较，也很少评估其跨队列校准。我们评估了增量价值、对与标签邻近的HER2转录本的依赖性，以及区分度和校准度的可迁移性。【方法】在TCGA-BRCA（1051例患者；ER/PR/HER2分析集分别为1001/998/1006）中开发了一个整合全切片图像、转录组、年龄和分期的模型，并在CPTAC-BRCA（120例患者；118/113/95）中进行评估。CPTAC在早期开发阶段已被观察过，且包含13例HER2阳性病例。分析包括配对模型比较、转录本剔除、替代损失函数和重新校准。内部区分度使用汇总的折外预测；外部区分度使用折均值估计，集成校准单独报告。内部校准和宏平均AUC的不确定性作为探索性结果解读。【结果】内部AUC分别为：ER 0.943、PR 0.901、HER2 0.860；外部AUC分别为0.952、0.937和0.918。外部宏平均AUC在多模态模型中为0.936，在使用ESR1、PGR和ERBB2的逻辑回归中为0.957（差值-0.021）。相对于基线多模态模型，剔除扩展的29个转录本的17q12-q21区域后，HER2 AUC在内部变化-0.035 [-0.058至-0.013]（95% CI），在外部变化-0.042 [-0.089至-0.007]。对于外部15模型集成预测，重新校准后的HER2预期校准误差（ECE）为0.236，超过ECE参考上限0.125，而整体校准（calibration-in-the-large）为-1.657 [-2.373至-1.023]（剖面似然95% CI），提示系统性高估。ER和PR同样表现为高估。在配对折均值比较中，HER2的ECE和Brier评分均更有利于三转录本模型（ESR1、PGR和ERBB2）。【结论】多模态深度学习模型在各队列中实现了较高的区分度，但相对于精简的三转录本基线并未显示出明确的增量价值，而跨队列校准仍是一项重大挑战。这些发现凸显了在评估用于医疗的基于AI的预测模型时，除区分度外，还需评估增量价值、校准度和临床效用。

title: Accuracy Is Not Risk: Why Medical AI Should Not Report Only Its Most Likely Label
zh_title: 准确率不等于风险：医学AI不应只报告最可能标签
summary: 预印本用Jeffrey条件化规则论证，医学AI只输出最可能标签会丢失概率信息、扭曲下游风险估计，并提出面向开发者、监管者和保险方的防护建议。
key_points: 指出只报告首位标签的两类误差
给出标签与完整分布决策一致的条件
针对开发者、监管者、保险方提出防护措施
reason: 有理论论证与监管意义，但为预印本且结果基于假设示例
abstract: Background. Many medical AI models are trained to reproduce a single reference label and hand the most likely label to the next step in a clinical workflow. A classifier can select that label correctly while providing an inadequate summary for estimating downstream risk. Methods. We use Jeffrey's rule of conditioning to specify when probabilities over intermediate states, such as diagnoses or imaging categories, can be carried forward to an outcome risk. We separate two errors of reporting only the most likely label, discarding the probability of the other states and applying the risk of patients who have the leading diagnosis to a patient who only probably has it. We also give conditions under which the label and the full distribution lead to the same decision, and we propose guardrails for device developers, regulatory reviewers, and health insurers. Results. In a hypothetical chest-pain differential, reporting only the benign leading diagnosis greatly understates the patient's risk of death or cardiac arrest, so a patient who warrants evaluation could be discharged or denied imaging. In a hypothetical BI-RADS example, the most likely category is "probably benign," yet the propagated malignancy risk exceeds the ceiling that defines that category. Conclusions. A predicted label is not an observed state, and a calibrated classifier is not automatically a valid outcome model. Clinical and insurance coverage decisions should rest on the patient's outcome risk, judged against a threshold justified by the consequences of acting and not acting. Developers should state what each model output means and check that every step between the model and the decision preserves the patient's risk.
zh_abstract:
【背景】许多医学人工智能模型被训练为复现单一参考标签，并将最可能的标签交给临床工作流程的下一步。分类器可能正确地选出该标签，却不足以作为估计下游风险的摘要。
【方法】我们运用Jeffrey条件化规则，说明诊断或影像分类等中间状态的概率何时可以传递至结局风险。我们区分了仅报告最可能标签所带来的两类错误：丢弃其他状态的概率，以及将具有首位诊断的患者的风险套用于仅仅可能具有该诊断的患者。我们还给出了标签与完整分布导致相同决策的条件，并为器械开发者、监管审评人员和健康保险机构提出了防护措施。
【结果】在一个假设的胸痛鉴别诊断中，仅报告良性的首位诊断会大幅低估患者的死亡或心脏骤停风险，因此本应接受评估的患者可能被出院或被拒绝影像检查。在一个假设的BI-RADS示例中，最可能的类别为“可能良性”，但传递后的恶性风险超过了界定该类别的上限。
【结论】预测标签不是观察到的状态，经过校准的分类器也不会自动成为有效的结局模型。临床和保险覆盖决策应基于患者的结局风险，并依据由采取行动与不采取行动的后果所论证的阈值来判断。开发者应说明每项模型输出的含义，并检查模型与决策之间的每一步是否保留了患者的风险。

title: Deep Learning for Cervical Cytology Screening: Methods, Algorithms, Challenges and Prospects
zh_title: 宫颈细胞学筛查深度学习综述：方法、算法、挑战与展望
summary: 综述按数据尺度、功能任务和监督方式梳理宫颈细胞学深度学习研究，区分全玻片置信度聚合与细胞级检测加Bethesda分类两条路线，并考察16个数据集。
key_points: 按数据尺度、任务、监督方式三轴组织
区分WSI聚合与细胞级检测两条路线
考察16个公开或有文档的细胞学数据集
reason: 病理方向有信息量的综述，预印本且综述受限
abstract: Cervical cancer remains a leading cause of cancer death among women, with more than 90\% of deaths occurring in low- and middle-income countries, where cytology screening is constrained by a shortage of trained cytopathologists. Deep learning has made automated cytology screening increasingly feasible, but the literature is fragmented across cell, patch and whole-slide-image scales, task formulations and supervision regimes, hindering comparison and clinical translation. This Review synthesizes the deep learning literature for cervical cytology screening, organizing the field along three axes---data scale, functional task and supervision---and distinguishing two clinical roadmaps: whole-slide-image confidence aggregation and cell-level detection with Bethesda classification. We examine 16 publicly available or publicly documented cytology datasets alongside the CAISHI histopathology dataset, compare quantitative performance while exposing incomparable metrics and data leakage, and assess commercial systems, regulatory status, HPV-era screening pathways and low-resource deployment. Single-cell accuracy on Herlev and SIPaKMeD has plateaued, but this reflects benchmark saturation rather than clinical readiness; prospective and randomized evidence is emerging but remains limited. We consolidate the evidence into five challenge areas---data and benchmarks, architecture and label-efficient learning, trustworthy AI, clinical translation and health economics, and evaluation and reproducibility---and provide an evidence-to-agenda map and a deployment decision matrix. Progress now depends on multi-center benchmarks, externally validated label-efficient methods, calibrated and fair predictions, and pragmatic clinical trials rather than further gains on saturated single-cell benchmarks.
zh_abstract: 宫颈癌仍是女性癌症死亡的主要原因之一，超过90%的死亡发生在低收入和中等收入国家，这些国家的细胞学筛查受限于训练有素的细胞病理医师短缺。深度学习使自动化细胞学筛查日益可行，但相关文献在细胞、图像块和全切片图像尺度、任务设定及监督方式上较为分散，妨碍了比较与临床转化。本综述对宫颈细胞学筛查的深度学习文献进行了整合，沿数据尺度、功能任务和监督方式三个维度组织该领域，并区分了两条临床路线：全切片图像置信度聚合，以及细胞水平检测结合Bethesda分类。我们考察了16个公开或公开记录的细胞学数据集以及CAISHI组织病理学数据集，比较了定量性能，同时揭示了不可比的指标和数据泄露问题，并评估了商业系统、监管状况、HPV时代的筛查路径及低资源环境下的部署。Herlev和SIPaKMeD上的单细胞准确率已趋于平台期，但这反映的是基准饱和而非临床就绪；前瞻性和随机化证据正在出现，但仍然有限。我们将证据归纳为五大挑战领域——数据与基准、架构与标签高效学习、可信AI、临床转化与卫生经济学、评估与可重复性——并提供了证据到议程的图谱和部署决策矩阵。目前的进展取决于多中心基准、经外部验证的标签高效方法、经校准且公平的预测以及务实的临床试验，而非在已饱和的单细胞基准上继续提升。

title: AR-RRG: Anatomy-Guided Retrieval-Driven Radiology Report Generation
zh_title: AR-RRG：解剖引导的检索驱动放射报告生成
summary: 预印本提出AR-RRG，用解剖感知病灶检测与检索驱动生成，减少检索整份报告带来的噪声和图文错配。
key_points: ASLDNet通过自训练实现病灶定位
采用解剖感知空间验证与类别自适应阈值
目标是缓解幻觉与漏检病灶
reason: 有新方法的视觉-语言预印本，证据有限，中档
abstract: Radiology report generation (RRG) streamlines clinical workflows and alleviates the burden of radiologists' documentation. Standard vision-language models capture global visual cues and lack fine-grained alignment between anatomical regions and diagnostic text. Most retrieval-augmented methods retrieve complete historical reports, introducing redundant noise and severe vision-text mismatches that trigger clinically risky hallucinations and missed lesions. In this paper, we introduce AR-RRG, an anatomy-guided retrieval-driven method for the generation of radiology reports. AR-RRG consists of two core modules: the anatomy-aware self-training lesion detection network (ASLDNet) and the retrieval-driven radiology report generation (RRRG). ASLDNet leverages anatomy-aware spatial verification (ASV) and class-adaptive dynamic thresholding (CDT) via self-training, delivering accurate lesion localization to support subsequent generation. As the generative branch of AR-RRG, RRRG eliminates clinical hallucinations through dual-granularity retrieval (DR) and complements missing lesions with a neighborhood consensus (NC) mechanism. A parallel continuous visual perception (PCVP) stream converts radiographs into visual tokens through fixed medical encoding and resampling. Multi-scale text and visual features are fused, followed by LoRA-efficient large language model tuning to generate clinically consistent, visually grounded radiology reports. Extensive evaluations on MS-CXR, MIMIC-CXR, and IU X-Ray demonstrate that AR-RRG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across mainstream metrics. Our code will be made publicly available.
zh_abstract: 放射学报告生成（RRG）可简化临床工作流程，减轻放射科医生的文书负担。标准视觉-语言模型捕获的是全局视觉线索，缺乏解剖区域与诊断文本之间的细粒度对齐。大多数检索增强方法检索完整的历史报告，引入冗余噪声和严重的视觉-文本不匹配，从而引发具有临床风险的幻觉和病灶漏检。本文提出AR-RRG，一种解剖引导的、检索驱动的放射学报告生成方法。AR-RRG由两个核心模块组成：解剖感知自训练病灶检测网络（ASLDNet）和检索驱动的放射学报告生成（RRRG）。ASLDNet通过自训练利用解剖感知空间验证（ASV）和类别自适应动态阈值（CDT），提供准确的病灶定位以支持后续生成。作为AR-RRG的生成分支，RRRG通过双粒度检索（DR）消除临床幻觉，并通过邻域共识（NC）机制补充缺失的病灶。并行连续视觉感知（PCVP）流通过固定的医学编码和重采样将X线片转换为视觉token。多尺度文本和视觉特征被融合，随后进行基于LoRA的高效大语言模型微调，以生成临床一致、视觉依据充分的放射学报告。在MS-CXR、MIMIC-CXR和IU X-Ray上的大量评估表明，AR-RRG在主流指标上始终优于最先进的方法。我们的代码将公开发布。

title: Accounting for Irregular State Transitions through Belief Estimation in Online Medical Consultation
zh_title: 在线问诊中基于信念估计处理不规则状态转移的PRISM框架
summary: 在16个医疗对话数据集上发现真实在线问诊连续性更低、更不可预测，并提出受POMDP启发的PRISM框架，将潜在状态估计与动作选择解耦。
key_points: 实证比较16个医疗对话数据集
真实在线交互连续性低于线下与模拟基准
PRISM分解为信念估计、策略优化与回复生成
reason: 预印本，新方法有数据集分析，但证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: While online medical consultation broadens access, unprompted patient disclosures and topic shifts frequently disrupt clinician inquiry, leaving clinical states progressively revealed. We characterize these dynamics using both existing evaluation metrics and task-specific interaction metrics designed in this work. Through an empirical study across 16 medical dialogue datasets, we show that authentic online interactions exhibit substantially lower contextual continuity and higher unpredictability than offline and simulated benchmarks. We propose PRISM (Policy Reasoning with Inferred States for Medicine), a framework inspired by partially observable Markov decision processes that decouples latent state estimation from action selection to address drifting dialogue trajectories. Specifically, PRISM factorizes clinical triage into belief estimation, policy optimization, and response realization. By maintaining an evolving posterior belief over consultation states and conditioning action selection on the maximum a posteriori state, PRISM advances clinical goals while accommodating patient-initiated shifts. Extensive evaluations show that PRISM substantially outperforms frontier LLMs and clinical agents, achieving a 22.40 percentage point gain in clinical decision accuracy alongside decisive improvements in response generation, surpassing the strongest baseline by 5.51 points in BERTScore_F1. Furthermore, ablation studies show that providing oracle consultation states consistently boosts response quality across all evaluated baselines by guiding their action reasoning, yielding average gains of 5.58 points in BERTScore_F1.
zh_abstract: 尽管在线医疗咨询扩大了就医可及性，但患者未经提示的主动陈述和话题转换常常打断临床医生的问诊，使临床状态只能逐步显现。我们利用现有评价指标以及本研究设计的针对任务的交互指标来刻画这些动态。通过对16个医疗对话数据集的实证研究，我们发现真实的在线交互相比线下和模拟基准表现出明显更低的上下文连续性和更高的不可预测性。我们提出PRISM（Policy Reasoning with Inferred States for Medicine），这是一个受部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程启发的框架，将潜在状态估计与动作选择解耦，以应对漂移的对话轨迹。具体而言，PRISM将临床分诊分解为信念估计、策略优化和回复生成。通过维护对咨询状态不断演化的后验信念，并以最大后验状态为条件进行动作选择，PRISM在适应患者主动发起的转换的同时推进临床目标。大量评估表明，PRISM显著优于前沿大语言模型和临床智能体，临床决策准确率提高22.40个百分点，同时回复生成也有显著提升，BERTScore_F1比最强基线高5.51分。此外，消融研究显示，提供真实（oracle）咨询状态可通过指导动作推理，一致地提升所有被评估基线的回复质量，BERTScore_F1平均提高5.58分。

title: Missingness-Aware Prior-Data Fitted Network for Irregular Clinical Time-Series
zh_title: 面向不规则临床时间序列的缺失感知PFN
summary: 提出MA-PFN：基于扩散先验生成含缺失掩码的合成轨迹训练PFN式预测器，对新入院患者单次前向预测，无需重训。
key_points: 从源域电子病历学习实验室值与观测掩码的联合先验
将缺失视为信息性信号而非噪声
合成轨迹转为上下文-查询任务训练
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，摘要未见充分外部验证
abstract: Clinical time series are irregularly observed with laboratory measurements recorded at uneven intervals and observation patterns often reflecting patient state, clinical concern, and site-specific practice. Consequently, missingness is not merely a nuisance factor but an informative signal for prediction. We propose a Missingness-Aware Prior-Data Fitted Network (MA-PFN) for irregular clinical time-series prediction. MA-PFN first learns a diffusion-based prior over joint laboratory value and observation-mask trajectories from source-domain electronic health records, capturing both physiological dynamics and measurement processes. Synthetic trajectories sampled from this prior are then transformed into context-query tasks to train a PFN-style conditional predictor. Once trained, the model performs prediction for new admissions in a single forward pass, requiring neither retraining nor parameter adaptation on target datasets. The framework naturally supports both imputation and forecasting through different context-query constructions. We conduct internal validation on a held-out MIMIC-III test set and external validation on eICU, evaluating both imputation and forecasting and assessing cross-domain generalization under shifts in patient populations, clinical practices, and observation mechanisms. MA-PFN achieves the best performance across all evaluated settings, with Overall/Macro nRMSD ranging from (0.193/0.186) for internal imputation to (0.297/0.297) for external forecasting, without target-domain adaptation. These results demonstrate that learning missingness-aware task priors enables accurate and transferable clinical time-series prediction under informative missingness.
zh_abstract: 临床时间序列是不规则观测的，实验室测量的记录间隔不均，观测模式往往反映患者状态、临床关注度及各机构的具体实践。因此，缺失并不仅仅是干扰因素，而是对预测具有信息价值的信号。我们提出了用于不规则临床时间序列预测的缺失感知先验数据拟合网络（Missingness-Aware Prior-Data Fitted Network，MA-PFN）。MA-PFN首先基于源域电子健康记录，学习实验室数值与观测掩码联合轨迹上的基于扩散的先验，以捕捉生理动态和测量过程。随后，将从该先验中采样的合成轨迹转换为上下文-查询任务，用于训练PFN式条件预测器。训练完成后，该模型可通过一次前向传播对新入院患者进行预测，无需在目标数据集上重新训练或调整参数。该框架通过不同的上下文-查询构建方式，自然地同时支持插补和预测。我们在保留的MIMIC-III测试集上进行内部验证，并在eICU上进行外部验证，评估插补和预测，并评估在患者人群、临床实践和观测机制发生变化时的跨域泛化能力。在所有评估设置中，MA-PFN均取得最佳表现，在无需目标域适配的情况下，总体/宏平均nRMSD范围从内部插补的（0.193/0.186）到外部预测的（0.297/0.297）。这些结果表明，学习缺失感知的任务先验能够在信息性缺失条件下实现准确且可迁移的临床时间序列预测。

title: Zero-shot evaluation of open vision-language models as System 1 decision models on radiology tasks
zh_title: 开放视觉语言模型在放射学任务上的零样本评估
summary: 在七项放射学任务（文本、X线、CT、MRI）上零样本比较Clef 27B、d1 3B与Qwen文本模型，主要终点为AUROC。
key_points: 任务含CT-RATE、PadChest、RANZCR、BraTS等
三个模型均未做任务微调
以AUROC为主要终点
reason: 多模态VLM放射评估，有基线对比但摘要结果有限，预印本
abstract: Purpose: We compared two multimodal System 1 decision models, Clef 27B and d1 3B, with a traditional LLM (Qwen 3.8-27B) on seven radiology tasks covering text, radiographs, CT and MRI. Methods: Three models were compared: Clef, Qwen3.8-27B and d1. Three tasks were interpretation of text and 4 were detection of finding in images. The tasks were: 1. finding presence of finding in CT-RATE chest CT reports; 2. Presence of finding in PadChest chest radiograph reports; 3. the same 18 findings on CT-RATE chest CT but 3D volumes; 4. MR safety status of devices from AccessGUDID device records; 5. line and tube position on RANZCR CLiP chest radiographs; 6. motion-artifact severity on MR-ART T1-weighted brain MRI and 7. sequence identification on BraTS 2021 brain MRI. The primary endpoint was AUROC. There was no fine-tuning of the models on the tasks. Results: All models completed all tests without a failed request. All retrieved findings from reports almost perfectly (AUROC >0.95). Clef ranked higher than its Qwen backbone on CT-RATE volumes and RANZCR lower on MR-ART. The two did not differ on BraTS, GUDID or PadChest, and differed by 0.002 on CT-RATE reports. On BraTS, Clef correctly identified 90 of 100 FLAIR volumes while Qwen never chose it. d1 ranked lower than Clef on six of seven tasks. No model performed well on motion severity. Clef was faster per request than Qwen on tasks with many questions per input. d1 used 3 to 9 times less energy per request than Clef. Conclusions: System 1 models can perform important tasks in radiology with high accuracy, at lower compute cost than LLMs used in the usual way. When an LLM is constrained to a single answer token, its cost and performance is similar to System 1 models unless multiple questions are asked. A 3B System 1 model was close to the 27B models on report text but not on images. No model performed well on motion severity.
zh_abstract: 【目的】我们将两种多模态“系统1”决策模型 Clef 27B 和 d1 3B，与传统大语言模型（Qwen 3.8-27B）在涵盖文本、X线片、CT 和 MRI 的七项放射学任务上进行了比较。【方法】比较了三种模型：Clef、Qwen3.8-27B 和 d1。其中三项任务为文本解读，四项为图像中的征象检测。任务包括：1. CT-RATE 胸部 CT 报告中的征象有无；2. PadChest 胸部 X 线片报告中的征象有无；3. 在 CT-RATE 胸部 CT 上对相同的 18 种征象进行判断，但使用三维容积数据；4. 根据 AccessGUDID 器械记录判断器械的 MR 安全状态；5. 在 RANZCR CLiP 胸部 X 线片上判断管线与导管位置；6. 在 MR-ART T1 加权脑 MRI 上判断运动伪影严重程度；7. 在 BraTS 2021 脑 MRI 上识别序列。主要终点为 AUROC。未针对这些任务对模型进行微调。【结果】所有模型均完成了全部测试，无请求失败。所有模型从报告中提取征象的表现几乎完美（AUROC >0.95）。在 CT-RATE 容积数据和 RANZCR 上，Clef 的排名高于其 Qwen 骨干模型；在 MR-ART 上则较低。两者在 BraTS、GUDID 或 PadChest 上无差异，在 CT-RATE 报告上相差 0.002。在 BraTS 上，Clef 正确识别了 100 个 FLAIR 容积中的 90 个，而 Qwen 从未选择该序列。d1 在七项任务中有六项排名低于 Clef。没有任何模型在运动严重程度任务上表现良好。在每个输入对应多个问题的任务中，Clef 每次请求的速度快于 Qwen。d1 每次请求的能耗比 Clef 低 3 至 9 倍。【结论】“系统1”模型能够以高准确度完成放射学中的重要任务，且计算成本低于常规用法下的大语言模型。当大语言模型被限制为只输出单个答案词元时，除非提出多个问题，否则其成本和表现与“系统1”模型相近。3B 的“系统1”模型在报告文本上接近 27B 模型，但在图像上则不然。没有任何模型在运动严重程度任务上表现良好。

title: RAG-TRACE: Tracing Measurement Evidence and Diagnostic Completeness in AI-Generated ECG Reports
zh_title: RAG-TRACE：追溯AI生成心电报告中的测量证据与诊断完整性
summary: 基于1,083例PTB-XL记录评估RAG在AI心电报告中引入的诊断标准是否有测量支持，关键词检索在46.8%的报告中引入了无法验证或被测量否定的标准。
key_points: 使用47张标准卡，其中33张无数值验证规则
确定性验证规则撤回647次标准应用
预印本，未经同行评审，单一数据集
reason: 预印本，有新意的RAG验证评估，数据集单一，属值得一看档
abstract: Purpose: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can introduce electrocardiogram (ECG) criteria that lack patient-specific measurement support. This study evaluates the reliability of retrieved diagnostic criteria in AI-generated ECG reports. Methods: We analyzed 1,083 human-validated PTB-XL patient records using a library of 47 criteria cards, including 33 without numeric verification rules. Language models generated structured reports with and without retrieval. Criterion applicability was evaluated using Marquette 12SL measurements, with independent assessment using Uni-G and comparison against expert-validated diagnostic labels. Results: Keyword retrieval introduced untestable or measurement-disconfirmed criteria in 46.8% of GPT-4.1-mini reports. A deterministic verification rule withdrew 647 criterion applications, including 639 without numeric checks, while preserving 268 of 269 applications independently supported by Uni-G. Restricting retrieval to 14 testable criteria reduced the initial unsupported-criterion rate to 13.8%. Under matched instructions and an identical output schema, retrieval increased unsupported-criterion reports from 17.4% to 31.1%, while hypertrophy recall remained unchanged at 62.6%. Conclusion: These findings identify a fundamental limitation of retrieval-based clinical report generation: retrieved criteria do not necessarily provide valid patient-specific evidence. Measurement-based verification can reduce unsupported criterion applications, but diagnostic validity requires independent assessment.
zh_abstract: 【目的】检索增强生成（RAG）可能引入缺乏患者特异性测量支持的心电图（ECG）诊断标准。本研究评估 AI 生成的 ECG 报告中所检索诊断标准的可靠性。【方法】我们分析了 1,083 份经人工验证的 PTB-XL 患者记录，使用包含 47 张标准卡片的库，其中 33 张没有数值验证规则。语言模型在有检索和无检索条件下生成结构化报告。使用 Marquette 12SL 测量值评估标准的适用性，并用 Uni-G 进行独立评估，同时与专家验证的诊断标签进行比较。【结果】关键词检索在 46.8% 的 GPT-4.1-mini 报告中引入了不可检验或被测量结果否定的标准。一条确定性验证规则撤销了 647 次标准应用，其中 639 次无数值检查，同时保留了 Uni-G 独立支持的 269 次应用中的 268 次。将检索限制在 14 条可检验标准后，初始无支持标准率降至 13.8%。在指令匹配且输出模式相同的条件下，检索使含无支持标准的报告比例从 17.4% 升至 31.1%，而肥厚的召回率保持不变，为 62.6%。【结论】这些发现揭示了基于检索的临床报告生成的一个根本局限：检索到的标准不一定提供有效的患者特异性证据。基于测量的验证可以减少无支持的标准应用，但诊断有效性仍需独立评估。

title: MedNet and U$^2$-ViT: A Nested Vision Transformer Diffusion Framework for Diverse Medical Images Generation
zh_title: MedNet与U²-ViT：嵌套ViT扩散的多样医学图像生成
summary: 发布涵盖61类疾病、160个类别的多模态文生图数据集MedNet，并提出嵌套U-Net结构的ViT扩散模型U²-ViT。
key_points: 数据集覆盖人和动物
来源为可信公共仓库
U²-ViT嵌套ViT提升生成多样性与保真度
reason: 新数据集加生成方法，但为预印本，临床验证不详
abstract: The scarcity of diverse, high-quality medical images remains a significant bottleneck in advancing AI-driven medical diagnostics and treatment planning. Traditional datasets often suffer from class imbalances, limited disease coverage, and insufficient variations in imaging conditions - challenges that hinder the development of robust, generalizable models. To address this, we introduce MedNet, a large-scale, multi-modal text-to-image dataset spanning 61 disease categories with 160 classes, covering both humans and animals. We built this with images from trusted public repositories, ensuring data diversity, quality, and ethical compliance. Additionally, we propose U$^2$-ViT, a novel diffusion-based text-to-image generation architecture arranging Vision Transformers (ViTs) in a nested U-Net structure to enhance the generation of diverse, and high-fidelity medical images. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our model achieves the best Fr'echet Inception Distance (FID) score compared to state-of-the-art models. The source code is available at https://github.com/LakshmikarPolamreddy/MedNet-U2-ViT.
zh_abstract: 多样化、高质量医学图像的稀缺，仍然是推进人工智能驱动的医学诊断和治疗规划的重大瓶颈。传统数据集常存在类别不平衡、疾病覆盖有限以及成像条件变化不足等问题，这些挑战阻碍了稳健且可泛化模型的开发。为此，我们提出MedNet，这是一个大规模多模态文本到图像数据集，涵盖61个疾病类别、160个分类，涉及人类和动物。我们使用来自可信公共数据库的图像构建该数据集，以确保数据的多样性、质量和伦理合规。此外，我们提出U$^2$-ViT，一种新型基于扩散的文本到图像生成架构，将视觉Transformer（ViT）排列于嵌套的U-Net结构中，以增强多样且高保真医学图像的生成。通过大量实验，我们证明与最先进模型相比，我们的模型取得了最佳的Fréchet Inception Distance（FID）得分。源代码公开于 https://github.com/LakshmikarPolamreddy/MedNet-U2-ViT。

title: SurgStream: A Workflow-Anchored Proactive Streaming Framework and Benchmark for Real-Time Surgical Video Understanding
zh_title: SurgStream：面向实时手术视频理解的流式主动框架与基准
summary: 提出以工作流为锚的主动流式框架，包含工作流锚定记忆与截止期感知转换学习，并配套基准，用于实时手术视频理解。
key_points: WAM记录器械-动作-目标并折叠为阶段摘要
DTL监督响应时机
同时提供流式手术视频基准
reason: 预印本，新方法加基准，摘要缺少结果与外部验证
abstract: Surgical video understanding is essential for intraoperative assistance such as workflow monitoring, instrument preparation and procedural documentation. Delivering such assistance in real time requires a model to jointly perceive the ongoing scene, remember past surgical events, and respond before clinically relevant moments pass. Existing approaches provide limited support for jointly retaining procedural evidence and deciding when to respond in streaming surgical video. In this work, we propose SurgStream, a workflow-anchored proactive streaming framework for real-time surgical video understanding. We first introduce Workflow-Anchored Memory (WAM) to record structured instrument-action-target observations and fold them into phase-level summaries, providing compact and queryable surgical memory. Deadline-aware Transition Learning (DTL) is then devised to supervise response states within clinical windows, enabling timely responses before procedural deadlines. We further introduce SurgStream-Bench, comprising 11.7K streaming interactions across various tasks covering real-time perception, backward memory queries, forward proactive QA, proactive alerts and caption memory. Experiments on SurgStream-Bench show gains over state-of-the-art methods, especially in memory and forward proactive QA. The source code will be available.

title: MedAstra: ASR-less Speech Retrieval with Diagnostic Grounding for Medical QA
zh_title: MedAstra：面向医学问答的免ASR语音检索与诊断落地
summary: 将冻结WavLM语音表示经轻量适配器映射到冻结E5文本嵌入空间，实现无需转写的语音检索以支持医学问答。
key_points: 避免ASR错误破坏关键医学术语
纯语音检索器Recall@10为87.6
结合实体替代与诊断对比辅助生成答案
reason: 预印本，有新意的检索方法，证据有限
abstract: Spoken medical question answering can fail when automatic speech recognition (ASR) corrupts a clinically important term before retrieval. We present MedAstra, a framework that maps frozen WavLM speech representations through a lightweight adapter into a frozen E5 text embedding space. This enables a dense retrieval path that accepts a waveform without a query transcript. Retrieved passages and speech-linked textual metadata support answer generation with entity alternatives, diagnostic contrasts, relation heuristics, and bounded retrieval refinement. ASR-less refers to the initial speech retrieval interface; lexical retrieval, string-based entity correction, and the text generator require textual inputs. The deterministic speech embedding does not constitute a calibrated model of acoustic uncertainty. Reported retrieval results reach 87.6 Recall@10 for the speech-only retriever and 90.4 for the hybrid configuration, compared with 81.0 for transcript-first dense retrieval. Medical QA and ablations provide descriptive system comparisons, with input-provenance and evaluation limitations stated explicitly. We distinguish controlled synthetic acoustic tests from real clinical speech, qualify component attribution, and specify the remaining comparisons needed to assess speech-only QA and clinical generalization.
zh_abstract: 当自动语音识别（ASR）在检索之前破坏了具有临床重要性的术语时，口语医学问答可能会失败。我们提出 MedAstra，这是一个通过轻量级适配器将冻结的 WavLM 语音表征映射到冻结的 E5 文本嵌入空间的框架。这使得稠密检索路径能够在没有查询转录文本的情况下直接接受波形输入。检索到的段落及与语音关联的文本元数据，通过实体备选项、诊断对比、关系启发式规则和有界检索优化来支持答案生成。“无 ASR”仅指初始的语音检索接口；词汇检索、基于字符串的实体纠正以及文本生成器仍需要文本输入。该确定性语音嵌入并不构成对声学不确定性的校准模型。所报告的检索结果为：仅语音检索器的 Recall@10 达到 87.6，混合配置为 90.4，而先转录再稠密检索的方式为 81.0。医学问答与消融实验提供的是描述性的系统比较，并明确说明了输入来源和评估方面的局限。我们区分了受控的合成声学测试与真实临床语音，对各组件的贡献归因加以限定，并指出了评估仅语音问答及临床泛化能力尚需进行的比较。

title: CONFIRM: Governing Scientific Reporting for Trustworthy Agentic Neuroimaging
zh_title: CONFIRM：为可信的智能体神经影像分析规范科学报告
summary: 提出CONFIRM框架，将分析执行与结论报告决策分离，通过预先指定的分析计划和五道确定性关卡过滤LLM智能体的神经影像发现；该预印本称LLM评判者会认可站点混杂的结果。
key_points: 称LLM评判者会认可存在站点混杂的发现
分析计划预先固定假设与通过标准
五道确定性关卡，含混杂、功效与重复验证
reason: 预印本新方法，智能体神经影像可信性，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can autonomously run neuroimaging analyses from research questions to reported findings. Existing agentic systems use tools to check that code runs and reported values match its output, but rely on LLM judgment to decide which results warrant scientific reporting. We show that LLM judges endorse site-confounded findings even when the confound is presented as evidence. We present \textbf{CONFIRM}, a framework that separates running an analysis from deciding which findings to report. CONFIRM encodes each hypothesis as a machine-readable, pre-specified analysis plan that fixes the claim and its pass criteria before computing results. It then filters results through five deterministic gates (search history and multiplicity, confounds, power, analytic stability, and replication) under three configurable reporting standards, from least to most demanding: \textit{Screen}, \textit{Replicate}, and \textit{Full}. Failed claims receive diagnoses that guide follow-up analyses. To evaluate reporting decisions at the claim level, we introduce \textbf{NeuroClaimBench}, comprising 489 executable neuroimaging claims with frozen data, including literature-supported findings and 150 controls designed to violate individual methodological requirements. On NeuroClaimBench, CONFIRM falsely supports at most 3\% of controls, compared with 23--38\% for the baselines, while recovering up to 61\% of literature-supported claims. When auditing an existing agent, CONFIRM reduces false support on controls from 23\% to 0\% while retaining the agent's literature-supported claims. Its diagnostic feedback also produces more supported revisions than Self-Refine with fewer LLM calls. Together, CONFIRM and NeuroClaimBench show that basing reporting decisions on pre-specified analysis plans and deterministic gates is essential for trustworthy autonomous scientific discovery.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以自主运行神经影像分析，从研究问题直至报告结果。现有的智能体系统使用工具来检查代码能否运行以及报告的数值是否与其输出一致，但依赖 LLM 的判断来决定哪些结果值得作为科学发现报告。我们表明，即使混杂因素被作为证据呈现，LLM 评判者仍会认可受站点混杂影响的发现。我们提出 \textbf{CONFIRM}，这是一个将运行分析与决定报告哪些发现相分离的框架。CONFIRM 将每个假设编码为机器可读的、预先设定的分析计划，在计算结果之前固定其论断及通过标准。然后，它通过五个确定性关卡（检索历史与多重性、混杂因素、统计效能、分析稳定性和重复验证）对结果进行过滤，并设有三种可配置的报告标准，要求由低到高依次为：\textit{Screen}、\textit{Replicate} 和 \textit{Full}。未通过的论断会得到指导后续分析的诊断。为在论断层面评估报告决策，我们引入 \textbf{NeuroClaimBench}，其包含 489 条带有冻结数据的可执行神经影像论断，包括有文献支持的发现以及 150 条旨在违反单项方法学要求的对照。在 NeuroClaimBench 上，CONFIRM 对对照的错误支持最多为 3\%，而基线方法为 23--38\%，同时可召回多达 61\% 有文献支持的论断。在审计现有智能体时，CONFIRM 将对照上的错误支持从 23\% 降至 0\%，同时保留该智能体有文献支持的论断。其诊断反馈还以更少的 LLM 调用产生了比 Self-Refine 更多的获得支持的修订。综合来看，CONFIRM 和 NeuroClaimBench 表明，将报告决策建立在预先设定的分析计划和确定性关卡之上，对于可信的自主科学发现至关重要。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Nanomedicine in Precision Oncology: Diagnosis, Targeted Therapy, and Clinical Translation.
zh_title: AI赋能纳米医学在精准肿瘤学中的应用综述
summary: 综述AI与纳米技术在癌症诊断、治疗选择、优化、监测、药物开发及临床转化中的融合，强调材料设计与生物学性能。
key_points: 整合理化、影像、分子与临床数据
支持早期检测、患者分层、疗效与毒性预测
讨论纳米药物设计与临床转化挑战
reason: 综述类，泛泛覆盖，无新数据，属增量档
abstract: [International journal of nanomedicine] Cancer nanomedicine offers programmable platforms for diagnosis, imaging, drug and gene delivery, and theranostics, but its clinical performance is constrained by tumor heterogeneity, complex nano-bio interactions, and interpatient variability. Artificial intelligence (AI) provides a means to integrate physicochemical, biological, imaging, molecular, and clinical data to improve the design and application of nanoscale cancer technologies. This Review examines the convergence of AI and nanotechnology across cancer diagnosis, therapeutic selection, treatment optimization, monitoring, drug development, and clinical translation, with particular emphasis on materials design and biological performance. AI-based approaches can support early detection, patient stratification, response and toxicity prediction, and rational therapeutic development. In parallel, nanoplatforms, including liposomes, polymeric nanoparticles, dendrimers, metallic and inorganic nanoparticles, biomimetic systems, and stimuli-responsive carriers, can improve pharmacokinetics, enhance tumor exposure, reduce systemic toxicity, and enable controlled delivery of diverse payloads. Their integration may advance precision nanomedicine by guiding nanoparticle composition, size, surface properties, targeting ligands, biodistribution, tumor accumulation, cellular uptake, protein-corona formation, release kinetics, toxicity, and therapeutic response. Conversely, nanodiagnostic and nanotheranostic systems can generate imaging, molecular, pharmacokinetic, and response data for AI-assisted patient selection and adaptive treatment monitoring. Translation will require standardized datasets, reproducible nanoparticle characterization, scalable manufacturing, explainable and externally validated models, regulatory clarity, long-term safety assessment, and equitable implementation. Together, AI-guided nanotechnology provides a framework linking materials design, biological interactions, and patient-specific cancer therapy.
zh_abstract: [International journal of nanomedicine] 癌症纳米医学为诊断、成像、药物和基因递送以及诊疗一体化（theranostics）提供了可编程平台，但其临床表现受到肿瘤异质性、复杂的纳米-生物相互作用以及患者间差异的限制。人工智能（AI）为整合理化、生物学、影像、分子和临床数据以改进纳米级癌症技术的设计与应用提供了手段。本综述探讨了AI与纳米技术在癌症诊断、治疗选择、治疗优化、监测、药物研发和临床转化中的融合，并特别强调材料设计和生物学性能。基于AI的方法可支持早期检测、患者分层、疗效与毒性预测以及合理的治疗开发。与此同时，纳米平台，包括脂质体、聚合物纳米颗粒、树枝状大分子、金属和无机纳米颗粒、仿生系统以及刺激响应型载体，可改善药代动力学、增加肿瘤内暴露、降低全身毒性，并实现多种载荷的可控递送。二者的结合可通过指导纳米颗粒的组成、尺寸、表面性质、靶向配体、生物分布、肿瘤蓄积、细胞摄取、蛋白冠形成、释放动力学、毒性和治疗反应，推动精准纳米医学的发展。反过来，纳米诊断和纳米诊疗系统可产生影像、分子、药代动力学和疗效数据，用于AI辅助的患者选择和适应性治疗监测。转化应用需要标准化数据集、可重复的纳米颗粒表征、可规模化的生产、可解释且经外部验证的模型、明确的监管规则、长期安全性评估以及公平的实施。总体而言，AI引导的纳米技术提供了一个将材料设计、生物学相互作用与患者个体化癌症治疗联系起来的框架。

title: Conversational Interaction for LLM-Based Clinical Text-to-SQL: A User Study with Healthcare Professionals
zh_title: 基于LLM的临床Text-to-SQL对话交互：医护用户研究
summary: 14名医生在MIMIC-IV上对比单轮与多轮对话式text-to-SQL界面，对话式界面更受青睐，SUS评分由68.2升至85.9（p<0.001）。
key_points: 14名医生组内设计，另有21人交互日志
对话界面在技术接受度各维度占优
reason: 真实医生用户研究有人机评估，但样本小且为预印本
abstract: Conversational text-to-SQL interfaces could give healthcare professionals natural-language access to electronic health record (EHR) data, but evidence for their real-world usability remains limited: prior evaluations have relied largely on curated benchmarks with fully specified questions or on simulated users. We report a user study in which 14 physicians who regularly work with EHR data used both a single-turn and a conversational multi-turn text-to-SQL interface over the MIMIC-IV database in a within-subjects design; dialogue analyses additionally drew on interaction logs from 21 healthcare professionals across the main study and two pilot studies. The conversational interface was consistently favored: mean System Usability Scale scores rose from 68.2, near the industry average, to 85.9 (p<0.001), with significant advantages across technology-acceptance constructs including performance expectancy, effort expectancy, self-efficacy, and behavioral intention. In post-study forced-choice comparisons, 93% of participants reported greater overall satisfaction with the conversational interface, 86% preferred it for real-world adoption, and 71% trusted its results more; no participant preferred or trusted the single-turn interface more. Turn-level analysis of 425 logged user turns showed that freely composed queries triggered clarification requests in 24.8% of cases versus 1.8% for predefined, fully specified questions, and 64.3% of clarification episodes stemmed from EHR- or clinical-domain knowledge. Conversational interaction is a practical prerequisite, rather than a convenience, for natural-language EHR access. The frequent need for clarification in realistic clinical queries further underscores the importance of conversational interfaces, while benchmark-style evaluation can substantially underrepresent the ambiguity of real clinical use.
zh_abstract: 对话式文本转SQL（text-to-SQL）界面可使医疗专业人员以自然语言访问电子健康记录（EHR）数据，但其真实世界可用性的证据仍有限：既往评估主要依赖问题完整明确的精选基准或模拟用户。我们报告一项用户研究：14名经常使用EHR数据的医生在受试者内设计中，基于MIMIC-IV数据库使用了单轮和对话式多轮两种text-to-SQL界面；对话分析还纳入了主研究及两项预试验中21名医疗专业人员的交互日志。对话式界面始终更受青睐：系统可用性量表（System Usability Scale）平均得分从接近行业平均水平的68.2升至85.9（p<0.001），在绩效期望、努力期望、自我效能和行为意向等技术接受构念上均有显著优势。在研究后的强制选择比较中，93%的参与者表示对对话式界面总体更满意，86%更倾向于将其用于真实世界应用，71%对其结果更信任；没有参与者更偏好或更信任单轮界面。对425个已记录用户轮次的轮次层面分析显示，自由组织的查询触发澄清请求的比例为24.8%，而预先定义、完整明确的问题为1.8%；64.3%的澄清情形源于EHR或临床领域知识。对话式交互是自然语言访问EHR的实际前提，而非便利功能。现实临床查询中频繁的澄清需求进一步凸显了对话式界面的重要性，而基准式评估可能显著低估真实临床使用中的歧义性。

title: ECG2Gene: Deep Learning-Based Germline Tumor Susceptibility Gene Risk Assessment Using Electrocardiograms
zh_title: ECG2Gene：利用心电图评估胚系肿瘤易感基因风险
summary: 两阶段深度学习框架从常规12导联心电图提取与胚系肿瘤易感相关的数字表型，并结合临床变量预测乳腺癌、卵巢癌和前列腺癌风险。
key_points: 多任务模型生成6个ECG衍生基因评分
XGBoost整合评分与临床变量预测癌症
提出ECG全景关联分析EWAS
reason: 预印本，思路新颖的肿瘤风险预测，摘要未见外部验证
abstract: Electrocardiograms (ECGs) may contain physiological information related to hereditary cancer susceptibility, but its relationship with future cancer risk remains unclear. Here, we present ECG2Gene, a two-stage deep-learning framework that derives digital phenotypes related to germline tumor susceptibility from routine 12-lead ECGs and predicts future cancer risk. In Stage 1, carrier status for pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in ATM, BRIP1, CHEK2, PALB2, BRCA1, and BRCA2 supervises a multitask model that generates six continuous ECG-derived gene scores. In Stage 2, XGBoost integrates these scores with clinical variables to predict subsequent breast and ovarian cancer in women and prostate cancer in men. We also introduce ECG-Wide Association Analysis (EWAS) to characterize associations between ECG-derived gene scores and ECG waveforms. Across the clinical feature combinations evaluated in UK Biobank, the best-performing sex-specific models achieve AUROCs of 0.683, 0.633, and 0.660 for breast, ovarian, and prostate cancer, respectively. In external evaluations, models combining ECG-derived gene scores with age achieve prostate cancer AUROCs of 0.709 and 0.579 among men in the overall China Kadoorie Biobank and MIMIC-IV-ECG cohorts, respectively. ECG2Gene links genetically supervised ECG phenotyping and waveform association analysis to future cancer outcomes, demonstrating the potential of routine ECGs combined with clinical information for non-invasive, opportunistic cancer risk assessment.
zh_abstract: 心电图（ECG）可能包含与遗传性癌症易感性相关的生理信息，但其与未来癌症风险的关系仍不明确。在此，我们提出 ECG2Gene，这是一个两阶段深度学习框架，可从常规12导联心电图中提取与种系肿瘤易感性相关的数字表型，并预测未来癌症风险。在第一阶段，以 ATM、BRIP1、CHEK2、PALB2、BRCA1 和 BRCA2 致病或可能致病变异的携带状态作为监督信号，训练一个多任务模型，生成六个连续的心电图衍生基因评分。在第二阶段，XGBoost 将这些评分与临床变量整合，用于预测女性后续发生的乳腺癌和卵巢癌以及男性后续发生的前列腺癌。我们还引入了心电图全景关联分析（ECG-Wide Association Analysis，EWAS），以刻画心电图衍生基因评分与心电图波形之间的关联。在 UK Biobank 中评估的各临床特征组合中，表现最佳的性别特异性模型对乳腺癌、卵巢癌和前列腺癌的 AUROC 分别为 0.683、0.633 和 0.660。在外部评估中，将心电图衍生基因评分与年龄相结合的模型，在中国慢性病前瞻性研究（China Kadoorie Biobank）总体队列和 MIMIC-IV-ECG 队列的男性中，对前列腺癌的 AUROC 分别为 0.709 和 0.579。ECG2Gene 将基于遗传监督的心电图表型分析和波形关联分析与未来癌症结局联系起来，表明常规心电图结合临床信息在无创、机会性癌症风险评估方面具有潜力。

title: Labadain-MedQA: A Tetun Medical QA Dataset for Fine-Tuning and Evaluating Large Language Models
zh_title: Labadain-MedQA：用于大模型微调与评估的德顿语医学问答数据集
summary: 通过Gemini 2.5 Flash将MedAlpaca医学问答集翻译为德顿语，得到39,077条QA对，并以50个样本做了人工与自动翻译质量评估。
key_points: 翻译自MedAlpaca闪卡与WikiDoc患者信息
人工翻译评分高于LLM翻译（4.43 vs 4.02）
面向低资源语言医学问答，预印本
reason: 低资源语言新数据集，质量评估样本小，属值得一看档
abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have created opportunities for cross-lingual transfer of medical knowledge from high-resource to low-resource languages to support access to healthcare information. However, medical question-answering (QA) datasets for fine-tuning and evaluating LLMs remain scarce for Tetun. To address this gap, we translated MedAlpaca's Medical Flashcards and WikiDoc Patient Information collections into Tetun using Gemini 2.5 Flash, producing 39,077 medical QA pairs. Translation quality was assessed on 50 randomly sampled QA pairs (100 documents) using automatic metrics against human reference translations and evaluations by two native Tetun-speaking healthcare professionals, focusing on medical accuracy and Tetun fluency. Human translations achieved higher mean ratings than LLM-generated translations for both criteria (4.43/5 vs. 4.02/5), with statistically significant differences (Wilcoxon signed-rank test, p < 0.001). To assess downstream utility, we fine-tuned Gemma and Llama variants on the translated MedAlpaca dataset using parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) and evaluated them on 325 Tetun-translated United States Medical Licensing Examination multiple-choice questions. Gemma 4 12B fine-tuned using QLoRA achieved relative improvements in mean accuracy of 10.79% with 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) inference and 10.42% after merging the LoRA adapters into the BF16 base model, compared with the corresponding base models. These results highlight the viability of automatic dataset translation for Tetun medical QA and the effectiveness of PEFT in enhancing model performance. The datasets, models, and evaluation resources are accessible at https://github.com/labadain/labadain-medqa to support reproducible research on Tetun medical QA and facilitate machine translation, cross lingual, and multilingual research.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的进步为将医学知识从高资源语言跨语言迁移到低资源语言、以促进医疗信息获取创造了机会。然而，用于微调和评估 LLM 的德顿语（Tetun）医学问答（QA）数据集仍然稀缺。为填补这一空白，我们使用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 将 MedAlpaca 的 Medical Flashcards 和 WikiDoc Patient Information 集合翻译成德顿语，得到 39,077 个医学问答对。我们对随机抽取的 50 个问答对（100 篇文档）评估了翻译质量，方法包括针对人工参考译文的自动指标，以及由两位以德顿语为母语的医疗专业人员进行评估，重点关注医学准确性和德顿语流畅度。在两项标准上，人工翻译的平均评分均高于 LLM 生成的翻译（4.43/5 对 4.02/5），差异具有统计学显著性（Wilcoxon 符号秩检验，p < 0.001）。为评估下游效用，我们使用参数高效微调（PEFT）在翻译后的 MedAlpaca 数据集上微调了 Gemma 和 Llama 变体，并在 325 道翻译成德顿语的美国医师执照考试选择题上进行评估。使用 QLoRA 微调的 Gemma 4 12B，与相应基础模型相比，在 4 位 NormalFloat（NF4）推理下平均准确率相对提高 10.79%，在将 LoRA 适配器合并到 BF16 基础模型后相对提高 10.42%。这些结果凸显了自动翻译数据集用于德顿语医学问答的可行性，以及 PEFT 在提升模型表现方面的有效性。数据集、模型和评估资源可在 https://github.com/labadain/labadain-medqa 获取，以支持德顿语医学问答的可复现研究，并促进机器翻译、跨语言和多语言研究。

title: From Small to Large: Assessing Medical Reasoning, Benchmark Contamination, and Model Size in Language Models
zh_title: 从小到大：评估语言模型的医学推理、基准污染与模型规模
summary: 在四个医学基准的3,076道题上评估14个模型，探讨题型、基准污染与模型规模如何影响医学考试成绩及其对临床能力的反映。
key_points: 覆盖六家厂商的大小模型及两个开源模型
考察选择题与开放题格式差异
关注基准记忆化与本地可部署小模型，预印本
reason: 评测设计较全面的预印本，但无临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now answer medical exam questions at or above expert level, but it is unclear whether such scores reflect clinical competence, or are instead affected by the format of the questions being asked (e.g., multiple-choice versus open-ended), prior exposure to the benchmarks, and the difficulty of the questions. These benchmarks are also public and widely used online, which may be resulting in LLM memorization. Models may perform better on questions that they have seen before. It is also not evident whether smaller models, which are more locally deployable in HIPAA-compliant hospital settings, have achieved human performance. In this study, we evaluate fourteen current models from six leading providers, one smaller and one larger model from each provider with two additional open-weight models, on 3,076 questions from four medical benchmarks (MedQA-USMLE, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, and MedBullets) under standard multiple choice, the same questions with the answer choices withheld, and reconstruction of a hidden question from its choices alone. In the standard multiple-choice setting, the strongest models exceed the human-expert baseline on MedQA-USMLE and PubMedQA, but the smaller models trail their larger models by 8.7 percentage points and only two of the six pass the human-expert bar on the licensing examination. Withholding the answer choices, however, makes every model struggle: mean accuracy falls from 82.3% to 50.9%, and the two largest drops belong to the medically specialised models. On memorization, the strongest models reconstruct one question in four from the answer choices alone, yet accuracy holds on the questions they cannot reconstruct. We further weigh accuracy against inference cost and test whether ensembling several models improves medical question answering.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）如今回答医学考试题的水平已达到或超过专家水平，但尚不清楚这些分数反映的是临床能力，还是受到提问形式（如选择题与开放式问题）、此前接触基准测试的情况以及题目难度的影响。这些基准公开且在网络上被广泛使用，可能导致 LLM 的记忆现象，模型在见过的题目上可能表现更好。此外，更适合在符合 HIPAA 的医院环境中本地部署的较小模型是否已达到人类水平，也尚不明确。在本研究中，我们评估了来自六家主要提供商的十四个当前模型（每家提供商一个较小模型和一个较大模型，另加两个开放权重模型），使用来自四个医学基准（MedQA-USMLE、MedMCQA、PubMedQA 和 MedBullets）的 3,076 道题，在三种条件下进行：标准选择题、隐去答案选项的相同题目，以及仅凭选项重建被隐藏的题干。在标准选择题设置下，最强模型在 MedQA-USMLE 和 PubMedQA 上超过了人类专家基线，但较小模型比其较大模型低 8.7 个百分点，六个中只有两个在执照考试上达到人类专家水平。然而，隐去答案选项后，所有模型都表现吃力：平均准确率从 82.3% 降至 50.9%，降幅最大的两个是医学专用模型。关于记忆现象，最强模型仅凭答案选项即可重建四分之一的题目，但在它们无法重建的题目上准确率保持不变。我们还权衡了准确率与推理成本，并检验了集成多个模型是否能改善医学问答。

title: CheXPoT: Post-Hoc Visual Verification and Correction of VLM-Generated Radiology Reports
zh_title: CheXPoT：对VLM生成放射报告的事后视觉验证与修正
summary: 提出基于程序思维的框架，将报告分解为谓词，与DenseNet-121和Grad-CAM视觉证据比对，删除无依据的发现并重写报告。
key_points: 用RadGraph和LLM分解报告为谓词
对照Grad-CAM证据表执行验证代码
无需高成本强化学习或偏好优化
reason: 预印本，新方法针对幻觉，摘要未见结果与外部验证
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise for chest radiograph report generation, but adoption remains limited because of hallucinated findings that are not grounded in the image. Correcting these hallucinations and improving overall report quality remains a significant challenge. Prior work has addressed this problem by refining models with reinforcement learning, preference optimization, or chain-of-thought supervision, often at substantial compute cost. To address this gap, we introduce CheXPoT, a program-of-thought (PoT) framework that verifies each generated finding against image features and removes those it cannot ground. CheXPoT decomposes generated reports into predicates with RadGraph and an LLM, grounds these predicates against a DenseNet-121 and Grad-CAM visual evidence table, executes PoT verification code, and rewrites reports after removing unsupported predicates. On a 4,145-image held-out split, CheXPoT yields statistically significant precision gains on 8 of 14 CheXpert classes and F1 gains on 5, with no significant decreases in either metric. CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 19.2% (MedGemma-4B) to 46.8% (MedGemma-4B + CheXPoT) and micro-average F1 from 23.0% to 49.4%, absolute gains of 27.6% and 26.4% respectively. We also tested CheXPoT on other VLM report generators. On LLaVA-Med, CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 4.5% to 17.7% and micro-average F1 from 6.3% to 19.4%. On MAIRA-2, CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 15.6% to 42.1% and micro-average F1 from 21.0% to 45.3%. Our results suggest that inexpensive post-hoc visual verification may improve VLM trustworthiness by correcting unsupported findings from generated reports. CheXPoT lays a foundation for tools that help validate VLM-generated radiology reports and reduce unsupported findings. These innovations may subsequently help increase trust and adoption of VLM tools in Medicine.
zh_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在胸部X线片报告生成方面已显示出前景，但由于会产生缺乏图像依据的幻觉性发现，其应用仍然有限。纠正这些幻觉并提升整体报告质量仍是一项重大挑战。既往研究通过强化学习、偏好优化或思维链监督来改进模型，往往需要相当大的计算成本。为填补这一空白，我们提出CheXPoT，这是一种程序思维（PoT）框架，可将每条生成的发现与图像特征进行核验，并删除无法找到依据的发现。CheXPoT利用RadGraph和一个LLM将生成的报告分解为谓词，将这些谓词与基于DenseNet-121和Grad-CAM的视觉证据表进行对照，执行PoT验证代码，并在删除不受支持的谓词后重写报告。在4,145张图像的留出集上，CheXPoT在14个CheXpert类别中的8个类别上取得了具有统计学显著性的精确率提升，在5个类别上取得了F1提升，且两项指标均无显著下降。CheXPoT将微平均精确率从19.2%（MedGemma-4B）提高到46.8%（MedGemma-4B + CheXPoT），将微平均F1从23.0%提高到49.4%，绝对增幅分别为27.6%和26.4%。我们还在其他VLM报告生成器上测试了CheXPoT。在LLaVA-Med上，CheXPoT将微平均精确率从4.5%提高到17.7%，微平均F1从6.3%提高到19.4%。在MAIRA-2上，CheXPoT将微平均精确率从15.6%提高到42.1%，微平均F1从21.0%提高到45.3%。我们的结果提示，低成本的事后视觉验证可通过纠正生成报告中不受支持的发现来提高VLM的可信度。CheXPoT为帮助验证VLM生成的放射学报告并减少无依据发现的工具奠定了基础。这些创新可能进而有助于增强医学领域对VLM工具的信任和采用。

title: HALO: Hierarchical Evidence Selection and Reinforcement Learning for Allocating Budgeted Label Optimization from Longitudinal Clinical Records
zh_title: HALO：面向纵向临床记录的预算化标注分配强化学习
summary: 提出HALO框架，从纵向临床记录中选择证据，并在预算下用强化学习分配免费、银标和金标标签来源。
key_points: 联合学习读取哪些证据与获取哪类标签
预算感知策略分配三种保真度标签
面向纵向电子病历的有限标注场景
reason: 纵向病历方法有新意，但摘要证据有限，预印本
abstract: Learning from extensive longitudinal clinical records--spanning repeated encounters, evolving conditions, and heterogeneous documentation--under a finite labeling budget requires solving two coupled problems: deciding what evidence to keep and deciding which patients deserve higher-fidelity labels. Prior work on active learning and multi-fidelity label acquisition mainly addresses the second problem, while treating the evidence presented to the acquisition policy as fixed. We present HALO, a Hierarchical Evidence Selection and Reinforcement Learning pipeline for Allocating Budgeted Label Optimization from Longitudinal Clinical Records. This framework jointly learns what to read and what label source to acquire under budget. HALO first selects informative evidence from longitudinal records and then uses a budget-aware policy to allocate free-, silver-, and gold-fidelity label sources. For frozen policies, our theory characterizes asymmetric acquired-label channels and gives a budget-constrained finite-sample gold-risk bound for a common downstream logistic model. In a heart-failure case study, HALO attained the highest MedAlign acquired-label F1 at six of eight target budgets. A downstream classifier trained on HALO-acquired labels attained the highest external MGB F1 at budgets 15-60 and remained within 0.01 of the best comparator at budgets 75-120.
zh_abstract: 在有限标注预算下，从跨越多次就诊、病情演变且文档异质的大量纵向临床记录中学习，需要解决两个相互耦合的问题：决定保留哪些证据，以及决定哪些患者值得获得更高保真度的标签。既往关于主动学习和多保真度标签获取的研究主要针对第二个问题，而将呈现给获取策略的证据视为固定不变。我们提出 HALO，即用于从纵向临床记录中分配预算化标签优化的分层证据选择与强化学习流程（Hierarchical Evidence Selection and Reinforcement Learning pipeline for Allocating Budgeted Label Optimization from Longitudinal Clinical Records）。该框架在预算约束下联合学习“读什么”和“获取何种标签来源”。HALO 首先从纵向记录中选择信息量大的证据，然后使用预算感知策略在免费、银级和金级保真度的标签来源之间进行分配。对于冻结策略，我们的理论刻画了非对称的已获取标签通道，并针对常见的下游逻辑回归模型给出了受预算约束的有限样本金标准风险界。在一项心力衰竭案例研究中，HALO 在八个目标预算中的六个上取得了最高的 MedAlign 已获取标签 F1。使用 HALO 所获取标签训练的下游分类器，在预算为 15–60 时取得了最高的外部 MGB F1，在预算为 75–120 时与最佳对照方法的差距保持在 0.01 以内。

title: Density-Aware Calibration for Resource-Efficient Medical Vision-Language Models
zh_title: 面向资源受限医学视觉语言模型的密度感知校准
summary: 提出CoreCalib，无需训练的量化校准集构建方法，在Kvasir-VQA-x1上配合三种量化器评估，METEOR最佳。
key_points: 按临床问题类别分层并用DINOv2特征聚类
固定128对校准预算，兼容多种量化器
在三种量化器下均取得最佳METEOR
reason: 医学VLM压缩新方法，单数据集，证据有限
abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) show promise for clinical image understanding, but their computational and memory requirements hinder deployment on resource-constrained clinical hardware. Post-training quantization (PTQ) offers a practical compression strategy without retraining, yet its effectiveness depends strongly on the calibration data. We propose CoreCalib, a training-free and quantizer-agnostic framework for constructing compact calibration sets that preserve the target medical VQA distribution. CoreCalib stratifies data by clinical question class, identifies representative visual modes using frozen DINOv2 features with UMAP and HDBSCAN, and expands selected images into class-balanced question-answer pairs. On Kvasir-VQA-x1, we evaluate CoreCalib with MASQuant, GPTQ, and QIG using a fixed 128-pair budget. CoreCalib achieves the best METEOR with all three quantizers and the best ROUGE-L with MASQuant and GPTQ. With W4A8 MASQuant, it improves METEOR from 0.5672 with COCO calibration to 0.6234, recovering approximately 41% of the degradation relative to BF16. These results support CoreCalib as a data-centric component for resource-efficient medical VLM deployment. Project page: https://magnusdtd.github.io/CoreCalib/ .
zh_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）在临床图像理解方面展现出前景，但其计算和内存需求阻碍了在资源受限的临床硬件上部署。训练后量化（PTQ）提供了一种无需重新训练的实用压缩策略，但其效果在很大程度上取决于校准数据。我们提出 CoreCalib，这是一个无需训练且与量化器无关的框架，用于构建能够保持目标医学视觉问答（VQA）分布的紧凑校准集。CoreCalib 按临床问题类别对数据进行分层，利用冻结的 DINOv2 特征结合 UMAP 和 HDBSCAN 识别具有代表性的视觉模式，并将选定图像扩展为类别均衡的问答对。在 Kvasir-VQA-x1 上，我们在固定 128 对预算下，将 CoreCalib 与 MASQuant、GPTQ 和 QIG 结合进行评估。CoreCalib 在全部三种量化器上均取得最佳 METEOR，并在 MASQuant 和 GPTQ 上取得最佳 ROUGE-L。在 W4A8 MASQuant 下，其将 METEOR 从 COCO 校准的 0.5672 提高到 0.6234，恢复了相对于 BF16 的约 41% 的性能下降。这些结果支持将 CoreCalib 作为资源高效的医学 VLM 部署中以数据为中心的组件。项目主页：https://magnusdtd.github.io/CoreCalib/ 。

title: Where Does EEG Help Wearable Freezing of Gait Detection?
zh_title: EEG在可穿戴冻结步态检测中的作用何在？
summary: 比较EEG作为推理输入或仅用于预训练对IMU冻结步态检测的影响，构建含184人、94小时的同步EEG-IMU预训练语料。
key_points: 5个数据集、184人、94小时同步EEG与IMU
比较六种仅模态设置不同的方案
BXHC数据集留一患者验证，仅10名FoG患者
reason: 可穿戴预训练设计有新意，但测试样本小
abstract: Freezing of gait (FoG) detectors built on inertial measurement units (IMUs) are accurate while the legs move, but they become unreliable when the legs are nearly still, which is exactly when akinetic freezing, voluntary stopping, and standing must be told apart. Electroencephalography (EEG) captures motor-planning activity that leg sensors cannot, but EEG is impractical for daily use. We ask where EEG helps: as an input at inference time, or only during pretraining, so that the deployed detector still needs only IMUs. We assemble a pretraining corpus of synchronized EEG and IMU recordings (5 datasets, 184 people, 94 hours) and compare six settings that differ only in the modalities used for pretraining and as model input, each with tuned hyperparameters and five independent pretraining runs. On the BXHC FoG dataset (leave-one-patient-out, 10 patients with FoG), adding EEG as input raises FoG F1 from 0.663 to 0.740 (9 of 10 patients improve), and the gain in ranking performance is confined to the quartile of windows with the least leg movement (AUROC +0.063). Pretraining the IMU encoder jointly with EEG improves an IMU-only detector both within the cohort (FoG F1 0.663 to 0.705) and when it is trained on a small cohort and tested on another (FoG F1 +0.083, all 10 test patients improve). Repeating the study with PD-only and healthy-only pretraining corpora, each with its own hyperparameter search, shows that IMU-based detection is robust to the corpus, whereas the benefit of aligning EEG with IMU requires both. Cross-cohort analysis further shows that detectors trained without annotated voluntary stops classify nearly all stops as freezing. Finally, on PD versus non-PD classification in three external datasets, joint EEG+IMU pretraining improves PD detection from walking EEG over EEG-only pretraining (AUROC 0.750 vs. 0.683), while IMU-based detection does not depend on the pretraining.
zh_abstract: 基于惯性测量单元（IMU）的冻结步态（FoG）检测器在腿部运动时较为准确，但当腿部几乎静止时就变得不可靠，而这恰恰是必须区分无运动性冻结、主动停步和站立的时刻。脑电图（EEG）可以捕捉腿部传感器无法获得的运动计划活动，但EEG在日常使用中并不实用。我们探讨EEG在哪里有帮助：是在推理时作为输入，还是仅在预训练阶段使用，从而使部署后的检测器仍只需IMU。我们构建了一个同步EEG与IMU记录的预训练语料库（5个数据集，184人，94小时），并比较了六种设置，这些设置仅在预训练和模型输入所使用的模态上有所不同，每种设置均经过超参数调优并进行了五次独立的预训练。在BXHC FoG数据集上（留一患者交叉验证，10名FoG患者），将EEG作为输入可使FoG F1从0.663提高到0.740（10名患者中有9名改善），且排序性能的提升仅限于腿部运动最少的四分位窗口（AUROC +0.063）。将IMU编码器与EEG联合预训练可改善仅用IMU的检测器，无论是在队列内（FoG F1从0.663提高到0.705），还是在小队列上训练并在另一队列上测试时（FoG F1 +0.083，全部10名测试患者均改善）。使用仅含PD和仅含健康人的预训练语料库重复该研究，且各自进行超参数搜索，结果表明基于IMU的检测对语料库具有稳健性，而EEG与IMU对齐所带来的益处则要求两者兼备。跨队列分析进一步表明，在没有标注主动停步的情况下训练的检测器会将几乎所有停步都分类为冻结。最后，在三个外部数据集中进行PD与非PD分类时，EEG+IMU联合预训练相比仅EEG预训练，可改善基于行走EEG的PD检测（AUROC 0.750 对 0.683），而基于IMU的检测不依赖于预训练。

title: Ensemble Classification and Cancer-Specific Gene Signatures from Quality-Aware Hybrid Gene Selection in TCGA RNA-Seq data
zh_title: 基于TCGA RNA-Seq质量感知基因选择的集成分类与癌种特异基因标志
summary: 用10,469例TCGA肿瘤构建集成分类器，并在SCAN-B独立队列迁移乳腺癌亚型基因panel，另建九种癌症的五基因panel。
key_points: 33种癌型，逻辑回归为最佳单一学习器（平衡准确率0.943）
堆叠集成在100基因时每折优于LR
在3273例SCAN-B独立队列上迁移验证
reason: 有独立队列迁移，但方法为常规，预印本
abstract: Gene-expression classifiers of cancer type are usually developed and validated within one cohort using random splits. Starting from a quality-aware hybrid Boruta selector from earlier work, we developed and evaluated ensemble classifiers and cancer-specific gene signatures. Using 10,469 TCGA tumours of 33 types, we compared five learners and three ensembles under decision rules fixed in advance, reran the selection in site-grouped cross-validation, transferred a breast-cancer subtype panel to 3273 tumours of the independent SCAN-B cohort, and built five-gene stage~I tumour versus adjacent-normal panels for nine cancer types. Logistic regression (LR) was the most accurate and best-calibrated single learner (balanced accuracy 0.943 on the locked test set). Stacking added at most 0.006 with 1000 genes but improved on LR in every fold with a minimal 100-gene panel; a hierarchical model did not reduce within-group confusion. Site-grouped validation lowered balanced accuracy by 0.027, almost entirely in colon and rectal cancer (0.008 without them and the untestable LAML). On SCAN-B, the subtype panel reached 0.855, close to the 50 PAM50 genes (0.876). Stage~I panels reached ROC AUC >= 0.99 in held-out patients and detected most later-stage tumours. Ensembles help most with a minimal panel; with 1000 genes, a calibrated linear model suffices.
zh_abstract: 癌症类型的基因表达分类器通常在单一队列内通过随机划分来开发和验证。我们以先前工作中的质量感知混合Boruta选择器为起点，开发并评估了集成分类器和癌症特异性基因标志。利用33种类型的10,469例TCGA肿瘤，我们在预先确定的决策规则下比较了五种学习器和三种集成方法，在按采样地点分组的交叉验证中重新运行了特征选择，将乳腺癌亚型基因panel迁移到独立的SCAN-B队列的3273例肿瘤上，并为九种癌症构建了五基因的I期肿瘤与癌旁正常组织panel。逻辑回归（LR）是最准确且校准最佳的单一学习器（在锁定测试集上的平衡准确率为0.943）。在1000个基因时，堆叠（stacking）最多仅提高0.006，但在最小的100基因panel下，在每一折中均优于LR；层次模型并未减少组内混淆。按地点分组的验证使平衡准确率下降0.027，几乎全部来自结肠癌和直肠癌（排除二者及无法检验的LAML后为0.008）。在SCAN-B上，亚型panel达到0.855，接近50个PAM50基因（0.876）。I期panel在留出患者中ROC AUC≥0.99，并能检出大多数晚期肿瘤。集成方法在最小panel下获益最大；在1000个基因时，经校准的线性模型即已足够。

title: Does Vendor Image Processing Matter? Learning Echocardiography Display Appearance from Native Beamspace Data
zh_title: 厂商图像处理重要吗？从原生波束空间数据学习超声心动图显示外观
summary: 训练小型CNN从原生波束空间B超复现GE显示外观，使用605例患者8,406段记录，并探讨滤波作为数据增强的价值。
key_points: 测试MAE较最优逐点亮度映射降低43%
可在CPU上实时运行
代码与预训练权重已公开
reason: 超声新视角并开源，但规模和验证有限
abstract: Most echocardiography datasets contain vendor-processed images, but processing is often undocumented and may affect model performance and robustness. To address this, we train a small convolutional neural network to reproduce General Electric display appearance from native beamspace brightness-mode ultrasound, using 8 406 recordings from 605 unique patients. The beamspace CNN reduces test mean absolute error by 43% over the optimal pointwise brightness map, outperforms an equivalent Cartesian CNN and runs in real time on a CPU. Across the EchoXFlow and CAMUS datasets, unfiltered training followed by filtered evaluation yields the lowest mean Dice for every class, suggesting filtering may be useful as augmentation when evaluation data are filtered or their processing is unknown. Code and pretrained weights: https://github.com/Ahus-AIM/EchoAppearance
zh_abstract: 大多数超声心动图数据集包含经厂商处理的图像，但这种处理往往没有文档记录，并可能影响模型的性能和稳健性。为此，我们训练了一个小型卷积神经网络，利用来自605名不同患者的8 406段记录，从原始波束空间亮度模式超声重现通用电气（General Electric）的显示外观。该波束空间CNN使测试平均绝对误差比最优逐点亮度映射降低43%，优于同等的笛卡尔CNN，并可在CPU上实时运行。在EchoXFlow和CAMUS数据集上，先用未滤波数据训练再用滤波数据评估，使每个类别的平均Dice均最低，这表明当评估数据经过滤波或其处理方式未知时，滤波可能可用作数据增强。代码与预训练权重：https://github.com/Ahus-AIM/EchoAppearance

title: Artificial Intelligence in Laryngology: Applications for Voice, Swallowing, and Endoscopic Assessment.
source: PubMed · ORL-head and neck nursing : official journal of the Society of Otorhinolaryngology and Head-Neck Nurses
zh_title: 喉科人工智能：嗓音、吞咽与内镜评估应用
summary: 叙述性综述，梳理AI在喉科嗓音障碍、吞咽困难及内镜评估中的现有与新兴应用，并强调护理、言语治疗和外科团队的实施角色。

abstract: [ORL-head and neck nursing : official journal of the Society of Otorhinolaryngology and Head-Neck Nurses] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into otolaryngology-head and neck care, with rapid growth in laryngology due to its reliance on voice analysis, endoscopic imaging, and swallowing assessment. As AI tools move into routine practice, otolaryngology teams play a key role in ensuring ethical, effective, and patient-centered implementation. To describe current and emerging applications of AI in laryngology with direct relevance to otolaryngology-head and neck care. A narrative review of the peer-reviewed literature was conducted, focusing on clinically relevant and investigational AI applications in laryngology care. Areas of emphasis included voice disorders and dysphagia, with attention to nursing, speech language pathology, and surgical practice. AI applications in laryngology care span multiple domains, including automated voice analysis for screening and monitoring, AI-assisted interpretation of laryngoscopy and swallowing studies, noninvasive dysphagia screening using sound or wearable sensors, and tools to support documentation and clinical triage. Collectively, these technologies can improve diagnostic consistency, support earlier identification of complications, and enhance longitudinal monitoring across care settings. Effective integration of AI into laryngeal care requires coordinated team engagement in data analysis, patient education, and clinical decision support. Understanding AI capabilities and limitations is essential for improving care while mitigating bias and supporting efficient workflows. AI-enabled technologies have expanded data-driven laryngology care across voice, swallowing, and endoscopic evaluation. Successful adoption depends on data quality, performance, and workflow integration. Interdisciplinary collaboration and ongoing evaluation of safety and equity can enhance the quality and consistency of laryngeal care.
zh_abstract: [耳鼻喉头颈护理：耳鼻喉头颈护士学会官方期刊] 人工智能（AI）正日益融入耳鼻喉头颈科诊疗，其中喉科学因依赖嗓音分析、内镜成像和吞咽评估而增长迅速。随着AI工具进入常规实践，耳鼻喉科团队在确保其符合伦理、行之有效且以患者为中心的实施中发挥关键作用。目的：描述AI在喉科学中与耳鼻喉头颈科诊疗直接相关的现有及新兴应用。方法：对同行评议文献进行叙述性综述，重点关注喉科诊疗中具有临床相关性和处于研究阶段的AI应用。重点领域包括嗓音障碍和吞咽困难，并关注护理、言语语言病理学及外科实践。结果：喉科诊疗中的AI应用涉及多个领域，包括用于筛查和监测的自动嗓音分析、AI辅助的喉镜检查和吞咽检查解读、利用声音或可穿戴传感器的无创吞咽困难筛查，以及支持文书记录和临床分诊的工具。总体而言，这些技术可提高诊断一致性，支持更早发现并发症，并增强跨诊疗场景的纵向监测。将AI有效整合到喉科诊疗中，需要团队在数据分析、患者教育和临床决策支持方面协同参与。了解AI的能力与局限，对于改善诊疗、减轻偏倚并支持高效工作流程至关重要。结论：AI赋能的技术已在嗓音、吞咽和内镜评估方面拓展了以数据驱动的喉科诊疗。成功应用取决于数据质量、性能和工作流程整合。跨学科协作以及对安全性和公平性的持续评估可提升喉科诊疗的质量和一致性。

title: Nano-Bioadhesives for Gastrointestinal Hemostasis and Healing: Integrating Artificial Intelligence for Precision Design and Application.
zh_title: 胃肠止血与愈合纳米生物黏合剂：整合AI的精准设计
summary: 讨论将预测性多目标材料设计、分子模拟和高通量实验等AI方法用于胃肠道纳米生物黏合剂的开发。
key_points: 指出多目标材料设计是最关键的AI领域
需同时优化黏附、止血、降解、生物安全与愈合
AI用于加速并降低研发风险
reason: 综述展望类，AI为材料设计辅助，临床证据缺乏
abstract: [ACS nano] Gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and mucosal injury remain clinically challenging because most bioadhesives lose performance under acidic, enzymatic, and peristaltic conditions. Nanotechnology has advanced adhesive design by enhancing mechanical integrity, degradation control, and antimicrobial activity; however, translating these gains into consistently favorable clinical outcomes is still difficult. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers a route to accelerate and derisk development. Here, we identify predictive, multiobjective materials design as the AI domain most critical for GI nanobioadhesives because adhesion, hemostasis, degradation, biosafety, and healing must be optimized simultaneously. Predictive modeling, molecular simulations, and high-throughput experimentation enable rational control of adhesion strength, degradation kinetics, and biocompatibility, while machine-learning models expedite the discovery of optimal polymeric nanoparticle formulations. Emerging strategies such as digital twins and closed-loop optimization further support patient-specific and adaptive adhesive systems. By integrating AI-guided design with nanotechnology platforms, next-generation GI bioadhesives could unify rapid hemostasis, antimicrobial protection, and regenerative functions, thereby improving reliability and clinical translation. This review outlines the synergy between AI and nanotechnology and highlights priorities for advancing GI adhesive therapies from bench to bedside.
zh_abstract: [ACS nano] 胃肠道（GI）出血和黏膜损伤在临床上仍具挑战性，因为大多数生物黏合剂在酸性、酶促和蠕动条件下会丧失性能。纳米技术通过增强机械完整性、降解控制和抗菌活性推动了黏合剂设计的进步；然而，将这些进展转化为始终良好的临床结果仍然困难。人工智能（AI）为加速开发并降低风险提供了途径。在此，我们指出，预测性的多目标材料设计是对胃肠道纳米生物黏合剂最为关键的 AI 领域，因为黏附、止血、降解、生物安全性和愈合必须同时优化。预测建模、分子模拟和高通量实验可实现对黏附强度、降解动力学和生物相容性的合理调控，而机器学习模型则加快了最佳聚合物纳米颗粒配方的发现。数字孪生和闭环优化等新兴策略进一步支持患者特异性和自适应的黏合剂系统。通过将 AI 引导的设计与纳米技术平台相结合，新一代胃肠道生物黏合剂有望统一快速止血、抗菌保护和再生功能，从而提高可靠性和临床转化。本综述概述了 AI 与纳米技术之间的协同作用，并强调了推动胃肠道黏合疗法从实验室走向临床的优先事项。

title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Developing a Future-Ready Nursing Workforce: A Systematic Review.
zh_title: AI在培养面向未来护理人才中的作用：系统综述
summary: 按PRISMA 2020并在PROSPERO注册的系统综述，归纳AI在护理人才培养中的应用、收益、挑战与影响。
key_points: 检索PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science等库
关注AI在教育、劳动力管理与决策中的作用
综合应用、益处、挑战与人才准备度
reason: 泛泛的系统综述，摘要无明确量化结论，增量档
abstract: [Journal of nursing management] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly transforming health care through advanced technologies that support clinical practice, education, workforce management, and decision making. As healthcare systems face growing challenges related to workforce shortages, increasing service demands, and rapid digital transformation, there is a need to understand how AI can contribute to the development of a future-ready nursing workforce equipped with the competencies required for modern healthcare environments. This systematic review aimed to examine the role of AI in developing a future-ready nursing workforce and to synthesize current evidence regarding its applications, benefits, challenges, and implications for workforce preparedness. A systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 and was registered in PROSPERO. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, CINAHL, and IEEE Xplore were searched for studies published between January 2015 and February 2026. Eligible primary studies examined an identifiable AI technology or an AI-specific construct in nursing education, clinical practice, workforce development, competency development, workforce planning, or professional preparedness. Methodological quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool, and findings were synthesized narratively. A total of 38 primary empirical studies satisfied the AI-specific eligibility criteria. The evidence was concentrated in cross-sectional (n = 15) and qualitative (n = 11) designs, with fewer development/prototype (n = 6), mixed methods (n = 3), randomized or quasi-experimental (n = 2), and methodological (n = 1) studies. AI-supported education, clinical decision support, workforce forecasting, and competency development showed promising benefits, but much of the evidence was based on perceptions, simulations, prototypes, or single-site evaluations rather than long-term implementation. Recurrent barriers included limited AI literacy, ethical and privacy concerns, algorithmic bias, infrastructure constraints, workflow integration, and organizational readiness. AI has promising, but still uneven, potential to support a future-ready nursing workforce. Current evidence supports cautious and staged integration rather than uncritical scale-up. Standardized AI and digital competency frameworks, human oversight, governance, infrastructure readiness, and prospective evaluation of effectiveness, equity, and cost are needed before widespread deployment.
