zh_abstract: [护理管理杂志] 人工智能（AI）正通过支持临床实践、教育、劳动力管理和决策的先进技术，日益改变医疗卫生领域。随着医疗系统面临劳动力短缺、服务需求增长和快速数字化转型等日益严峻的挑战，有必要了解AI如何有助于培养具备现代医疗环境所需能力、面向未来的护理队伍。本系统综述旨在考察AI在培养面向未来的护理队伍中的作用，并综合当前关于其应用、益处、挑战及对队伍准备程度影响的证据。本系统综述依据PRISMA 2020开展，并已在PROSPERO注册。检索了PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、CINAHL和IEEE Xplore中2015年1月至2026年2月发表的研究。纳入的原始研究需考察护理教育、临床实践、队伍发展、能力培养、劳动力规划或职业准备中可识别的AI技术或AI特有概念。采用混合方法评价工具（Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool）评估方法学质量，并以叙述性方式综合研究结果。共有38项原始实证研究符合AI特异性纳入标准。证据主要集中于横断面研究（n = 15）和定性研究（n = 11），其余为开发/原型研究（n = 6）、混合方法研究（n = 3）、随机或准实验研究（n = 2）以及方法学研究（n = 1）。AI支持的教育、临床决策支持、劳动力预测和能力培养显示出良好的前景，但许多证据基于认知、模拟、原型或单中心评价，而非长期实施。反复出现的障碍包括AI素养有限、伦理和隐私问题、算法偏倚、基础设施限制、工作流程整合以及组织准备程度。AI在支持面向未来的护理队伍方面具有良好但仍不均衡的潜力。现有证据支持谨慎、分阶段地整合，而非不加批判地大规模推广。在广泛部署之前，需要标准化的AI与数字能力框架、人工监督、治理、基础设施准备，以及对有效性、公平性和成本的前瞻性评价。护理管理者应……

title: Equitable Visibility Optimization: Discovering Credible Health Information in an Era of Artificial Intelligence-Driven Search.
source: PubMed · Health education & behavior : the official publication of the Society for Public Health Education
zh_title: 公平可见性优化：AI搜索时代发现可信健康信息
summary: 观点文章提出EVO公共卫生框架，划分各方职责，以提升可信健康信息在AI系统中的可见性。
key_points: 关注AI聊天机器人作为信息中介的公平问题
建议健康机构开展可见性审计
强调用户AI素养与开发者适配
reason: 观点类框架文章，无实证数据
abstract: [Health education & behavior : the official publication of the Society for Public Health Education] While artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots provide quick answers to health questions, they raise equity concerns about what information is visible, who controls it, and how it is presented. This perspective examines AI as an information intermediary and highlights areas for improvement. We introduce Equitable Visibility Optimization (EVO), a public health framework that organizes the distinct responsibilities of health organizations, AI developers, information consumers, clinicians, and educators to improve the visibility of credible health information in AI systems. We recommend that health organizations conduct visibility audits to ensure their content is discoverable by AI systems; that health information users are trained in AI literacy; that AI developers adapt models to support multilingual users; and that AI developers incorporate fact-checking training loops that systematically weight verified health data to reduce misinformation exposure. Ultimately, EVO promotes shared responsibility across sectors to strengthen accountability, improve discoverability, and center equity as AI technologies evolve.
zh_abstract: [Health education & behavior : the official publication of the Society for Public Health Education] 虽然人工智能（AI）聊天机器人能够快速回答健康问题，但它们在哪些信息可见、由谁控制以及如何呈现方面引发了公平性方面的担忧。本文观点将AI视为一种信息中介，并指出了需要改进的方面。我们提出了“公平可见性优化”（Equitable Visibility Optimization，EVO），这是一个公共卫生框架，用于梳理卫生机构、AI开发者、信息使用者、临床医生和教育者各自不同的职责，以提高可信健康信息在AI系统中的可见性。我们建议：卫生机构开展可见性审计，以确保其内容可被AI系统发现；对健康信息使用者开展AI素养培训；AI开发者调整模型以支持多语言用户；AI开发者纳入事实核查训练循环，系统性地为经过验证的健康数据赋予更高权重，以减少错误信息的暴露。最终，随着AI技术的发展，EVO倡导各部门共同承担责任，以加强问责、提高可发现性，并将公平置于核心位置。

title: Multidimensional Suicide Risk Assessment with Machine Learning using Electronic Health Records
zh_title: 基于电子病历的机器学习多维自杀风险评估
summary: 预印本使用MIMIC-IV电子病历，构建自杀相关复合结局，经年龄匹配重采样后比较逻辑回归、随机森林与XGBoost。
key_points: 复合结局由自杀意念、尝试、既往行为及自伤编码定义
采用年龄匹配重采样应对严重类别不平衡
评估逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost三类分类器
reason: 预印本，单一公开数据集，仅内部评估，无外部验证
abstract: Suicide prevention remains a critical public health challenge, and electronic health records (EHRs) provide an opportunity to characterize suicide-related risk indicators using documented clinical, behavioral, medical, and social-contextual information. This paper presents a multidimensional machine learning framework to model and estimate suicide-related outcomes using MIMIC-IV EHR data. We construct clinically motivated diagnosis categories and define a composite outcome from documented codes corresponding to suicidal ideation, suicide attempt, prior suicidal behavior, and intentional self-harm. To address severe class imbalance and reduce age-related confounding, we apply age-matched resampling that retains all positive patients and samples comparison-cohort patients from the same age group. Logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost classifiers are evaluated before and after resampling with isotonic calibration. The calibrated XGBoost model achieves the strongest matched-cohort performance, outperforming the other evaluated classifiers. SHAP-based interpretation shows that diagnostic burden, depression-related features, age, personality-disorder history, social determinants related to violence, and medical comorbidity contribute to elevated predicted probabilities. Our results demonstrate that combining broad EHR-derived features, age-matched cohort construction, calibration, and feature-level interpretation provides a practical framework for retrospective suicide-related risk modeling.
zh_abstract: 自杀预防仍是一项严峻的公共卫生挑战，而电子健康记录（EHR）为利用已记录的临床、行为、医疗及社会情境信息来刻画自杀相关风险指标提供了契机。本文提出了一个多维机器学习框架，利用 MIMIC-IV EHR 数据对自杀相关结局进行建模和估计。我们构建了具有临床依据的诊断类别，并根据对应于自杀意念、自杀未遂、既往自杀行为和故意自伤的已记录编码定义了一个复合结局。为应对严重的类别不平衡并减少与年龄相关的混杂，我们采用了年龄匹配重采样方法，即保留全部阳性患者，并从相同年龄组中抽取对照队列患者。我们在重采样前后评估了逻辑回归、随机森林和 XGBoost 分类器，并采用等渗校准（isotonic calibration）。经校准的 XGBoost 模型在匹配队列中表现最佳，优于其他被评估的分类器。基于 SHAP 的解释显示，诊断负担、抑郁相关特征、年龄、人格障碍病史、与暴力相关的社会决定因素以及内科合并症均会使预测概率升高。我们的结果表明，将广泛的 EHR 衍生特征、年龄匹配的队列构建、校准和特征层面的解释相结合，可为回顾性自杀相关风险建模提供一个实用的框架。

title: ScienceVision: Can AI Observe and Reason Like a Scientist?
zh_title: ScienceVision：AI能否像科学家一样观察与推理
summary: 提出跨领域科学3D理解与推理的VQA基准，含250道专家级题目，覆盖生物、化学、医学影像、机械CAD和建筑，各50题。
key_points: 面向科学3D数据的专家级VQA基准
五个领域各50题，共250题
结合合成题生成与领域专家审核标注
reason: 预印本基准，规模较小，医学仅占其一
abstract: Scientific discovery builds on accurate observations interpreted through domain knowledge and reasoning. For scientific 3D data, this requires understanding structures and spatial relationships, from protein contacts to anatomical organization. Existing multimodal benchmarks largely evaluate text and 2D images, while scientific 3D evaluations vary in representations and protocols across disciplines, limiting cross-disciplinary comparison. To assess these foundational capabilities, we introduce ScienceVision, a cross-domain benchmark for scientific 3D understanding and reasoning through expert-level visual question answering (VQA). We construct 250 questions, with 50 each from Biology, Chemistry, Medical Imaging, Mechanical CAD, and Architecture, through a pipeline combining synthetic question generation with domain-expert review and annotation. Each task pairs a native 3D artifact with a scientific question, a specified response format, and a task-specific reference answer, requiring domain knowledge to be applied to geometric or topological evidence. We evaluate 12 models on the same questions in three settings: visual question answering with native 3D artifacts accessed through an agent harness's file and code-execution tools; the same workflow augmented with expert-inspired viewer inspection and measurement tools exposed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP); and visual question answering from prescribed rendered 2D images using an agent harness. All settings use the same task-specific deterministic final-answer scoring. The inspection environment supports view changes, target isolation, and slice inspection. In this main comparison, the best mean answer score is 0.53 out of 1. Mean scores in the native-artifact workflow without additional MCP tools exceed those in the rendered-image workflow for every model, by 17.2 percentage points on average.
zh_abstract: 科学发现建立在通过领域知识和推理加以解读的准确观察之上。对于科学三维数据而言，这需要理解结构和空间关系，从蛋白质接触到解剖组织结构皆然。现有的多模态基准主要评估文本和二维图像，而科学三维评估在不同学科间的表示方式和评测协议各不相同，限制了跨学科比较。为评估这些基础能力，我们提出了 ScienceVision，这是一个通过专家级视觉问答（VQA）来评估科学三维理解与推理的跨领域基准。我们通过将合成问题生成与领域专家审核和标注相结合的流程，构建了250个问题，生物学、化学、医学影像、机械CAD和建筑各50个。每项任务将一个原生三维制品与一个科学问题、指定的回答格式以及任务特定的参考答案配对，要求将领域知识应用于几何或拓扑证据。我们在相同的问题上以三种设置评估了12个模型：一是通过智能体框架的文件和代码执行工具访问原生三维制品进行视觉问答；二是在同一工作流基础上，增加通过模型上下文协议（MCP）提供的、受专家启发的查看器检查与测量工具；三是使用智能体框架，基于规定渲染的二维图像进行视觉问答。所有设置均采用相同的、任务特定的确定性最终答案评分。该检查环境支持视角切换、目标隔离和切片检查。在此主要比较中，最佳平均答案得分为0.53（满分1）。对每个模型而言，不使用额外MCP工具的原生制品工作流的平均得分均高于渲染图像工作流，平均高出17.2个百分点。

title: Polyp Matching Using Deep Learning
zh_title: 基于深度学习的结肠胶囊内镜息肉匹配
summary: 采用孪生网络与对比学习判断胶囊内镜图像是否为同一息肉，使用丹麦CareForColon2015试验的10,206对图像训练，比较多种骨干网络。
key_points: 孪生网络加余弦距离对比学习
5,103对相同与5,103对不同息肉图像
比较ResNet、DenseNet、EfficientNet骨干
reason: 单一数据源、方法常规，属增量档
abstract: A key challenge in colon capsule endoscopy (CCE) analysis is accurately identifying whether multiple images depict the same polyp, which is critical to avoid over-counting and unnecessary clinical interventions. Additionally, this prevents prolonged follow-up colonoscopies where endoscopists search for duplicate polyps without precise localization. This study presents a novel contrastive learning-based approach to polyp matching using a Siamese neural network architecture. The model was trained on a dataset from the Danish CareForColon2015 trial. The dataset comprises 5,103 image pairs of confirmed same polyp and 5,103 pairs of different polyps, annotated by experienced clinicians. The proposed model employs ResNet variants (ResNet18, ResNet34, ResNet50), DenseNet121 and EfficientNet B0/B3 as backbones and utilizes contrastive learning with cosine vector distance metric for classification. Experimental results demonstrate high classification accuracies of up to 92% and AUC values close to 0.98. These results suggest that automated polyp matching has the potential to reduce polyp over-counting, improve patient risk stratification, and reduce unnecessary follow-up colonoscopies.

title: Performance, Scalability and Maintenance: An Experimental Study of RPA vs. Autonomous Agents in the Healthcare Domain
zh_title: 医疗领域RPA与自主智能体的性能、可扩展性与维护对比
summary: 预印本对比Playwright RPA与基于LLM的自主智能体，从实验室门户检索乳腺影像报告；RPA准确率更高、更快更便宜。
key_points: RPA准确率98.90%，APA为96.49%
RPA每患者16.07秒，APA为207.21秒
单报告成本RPA 0.030美元，APA 0.187美元
reason: 预印本，单一任务工程对比，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Healthcare information systems are fragmented, and retrieving data from legacy web portals is a recurrent need. Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is deterministic but sensitive to interface changes, whereas autonomous agents based on large language models (Agent Process Automation, APA) promise adaptability at a higher computational cost. Following Design Science Research, we developed and compared an RPA solution (Playwright) and an APA solution (browser-use, LangGraph and Gemini 2.5 Flash-lite) to retrieve mammography and breast ultrasound reports from a laboratory portal, treating reports solely as informational artifacts. Across two rounds (T and T+7), RPA reached 98.90% accuracy and 98.27% F1-score versus 96.49% and 94.48% for APA, was about 13 times faster (16.07 s vs. 207.21 s per patient) and cost about six times less per report (USD 0.030 vs. 0.187). Both reached 100% step success rates; APA varied more over time. For a stable interface, RPA was superior.

title: Sparse-View 3D Coronary Reconstruction from Vessel Segmentations Using a Diffusion Prior
zh_title: 基于扩散先验的稀疏视角冠状动脉三维重建
summary: 预印本结合三维扩散先验、视觉外壳初始化和投影数据一致性，从稀疏造影视角的血管分割重建冠脉三维结构。
key_points: 扩散模型仅用血管掩码训练，无需配对2D-3D数据
同一模型可用于不同视角数而无需重训
在ImageCAS模拟造影上测试2、4、8视角
reason: 方法新颖但仅模拟数据评估，预印本
abstract: Reconstructing three-dimensional (3D) coronary anatomy from sparse angiographic views could support percutaneous coronary intervention, but limited angular coverage and imperfect vessel segmentations introduce substantial geometric ambiguity. We propose a vessel-specific reconstruction framework combining a learned 3D diffusion prior, visual-hull initialization, and projection-based data consistency. The unconditional diffusion model is trained on coronary vessel masks without paired 2D--3D data and reused across different view counts without retraining. During inference, a scaled visual hull initializes reconstruction, while projection-based updates constrain diffusion refinement using patient-specific vessel observations. We evaluated the framework on simulated angiograms derived from ImageCAS computed tomography angiography volumes using two, four, and eight views at two contrast levels. Across 50 evaluation coronary-tree cases, the proposed method achieved higher mean Dice and clDice than visual hull, deep image prior (DIP), and hash-grid implicit neural representation (INR) at all view counts under reduced contrast. With eight views, improvements over DIP, the best-performing baseline at lower contrast, were approximately 0.13 in Dice and 0.22 in clDice. At higher contrast, performance remained competitive with hash-grid INR, the best-performing eight-view baseline. The preferred diffusion starting timestep depended on observation quality and view count, with excessive refinement reducing accuracy at higher contrast. Projection guidance improved both metrics across all conditions. Averaging stochastic reconstructions further improved accuracy, while sample disagreement localized errors with average-precision gains of 0.14--0.21 over error prevalence. These findings support diffusion-prior reconstruction from sparse vessel observations, although clinical validation remains necessary.
zh_abstract: 从稀疏血管造影视角重建三维（3D）冠状动脉解剖结构可为经皮冠状动脉介入治疗提供支持，但有限的角度覆盖和不完美的血管分割会带来显著的几何歧义。我们提出了一种血管特异性重建框架，结合了习得的3D扩散先验、视觉外壳（visual hull）初始化和基于投影的数据一致性。无条件扩散模型在冠状动脉血管掩膜上训练，无需配对的2D–3D数据，并可在不同视角数下复用而无需重新训练。在推理过程中，缩放后的视觉外壳用于初始化重建，而基于投影的更新则利用患者特异性的血管观测来约束扩散细化。我们在由ImageCAS计算机断层血管造影体数据生成的模拟血管造影上评估了该框架，采用两、四、八个视角及两种对比度水平。在50例冠状动脉树评估病例中，在低对比度条件下，所提方法在所有视角数下的平均Dice和clDice均高于视觉外壳、深度图像先验（DIP）和哈希网格隐式神经表示（INR）。在八视角下，相较于低对比度下表现最佳的基线DIP，Dice提高约0.13，clDice提高约0.22。在较高对比度下，其性能与八视角下表现最佳的基线哈希网格INR相当。较优的扩散起始时间步取决于观测质量和视角数，在较高对比度下过度细化会降低准确性。投影引导在所有条件下均改善了两项指标。对随机重建结果取平均可进一步提高准确性，而样本间不一致性可定位误差，其平均精度较误差发生率提高0.14–0.21。这些发现支持基于扩散先验从稀疏血管观测中进行重建，但仍需临床验证。

title: ProGeo-RC: Prototype-guided Semantic Reliability and Geometric Error Calibration for Semi-supervised Cardiac Image Segmentation
zh_title: ProGeo-RC：半监督心脏图像分割的原型语义可靠性与几何误差校准
summary: 预印本提出原型引导的语义可靠性估计与符号距离场几何误差校准，用于半监督心脏图像分割的伪标签优化。
key_points: PSRE用概率类原型估计伪标签语义可靠性
S-SGEC引入符号距离场校准几何误差
针对仅靠置信度判断伪标签的不足
reason: 半监督分割方法改进，摘要未见外部验证，预印本
abstract: Semi-supervised medical image segmentation aims to train reliable segmentation models using limited labeled data and abundant unlabeled data. However, existing methods typically rely on prediction confidence or model consistency to estimate pseudo-label reliability, but these criteria are insufficient to characterize both semantic reliability and geometric plausibility. To address this issue, we propose ProGeo-RC, a prototype-guided semantic reliability and geometric error calibration framework for semi-supervised medical image segmentation. ProGeo-RC consists of two key modules: Prototype-guided Semantic Reliability Estimation (PSRE) and Structured Semantic-Geometric Error Calibration (S-SGEC). PSRE uses probabilistic class prototypes to estimate the semantic reliability of unlabeled predictions and calibrate pixel-wise teacher pseudo labels, while S-SGEC introduces signed-distance-field-based geometric constraints to refine ambiguous boundaries and suppress spurious foreground responses outside target structures. Experiments on the ACDC and MVAA-CT datasets show that ProGeo-RC achieves better performance compared with representative semi-supervised segmentation methods. Under the 10\% labeled setting on ACDC, ProGeo-RC improves DSC and Jaccard by 0.37\% and 0.49\% over the corresponding second-best results, while reducing 95HD and ASD by 0.61 and 0.21, respectively. These results indicate that joint semantic reliability estimation and geometric error calibration can provide more reliable pseudo supervision for semi-supervised medical image segmentation.
zh_abstract: 半监督医学图像分割旨在利用有限的标注数据和大量未标注数据训练可靠的分割模型。然而，现有方法通常依赖预测置信度或模型一致性来估计伪标签的可靠性，但这些标准不足以同时刻画语义可靠性和几何合理性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ProGeo-RC，一种用于半监督医学图像分割的原型引导语义可靠性与几何误差校准框架。ProGeo-RC包含两个关键模块：原型引导语义可靠性估计（PSRE）和结构化语义-几何误差校准（S-SGEC）。PSRE利用概率类别原型估计未标注预测的语义可靠性，并校准教师模型逐像素的伪标签；S-SGEC则引入基于有符号距离场的几何约束，以细化模糊边界并抑制目标结构之外的虚假前景响应。在ACDC和MVAA-CT数据集上的实验表明，ProGeo-RC相比代表性的半监督分割方法取得了更好的性能。在ACDC的10%标注设置下，ProGeo-RC的DSC和Jaccard分别比相应的次优结果提高0.37%和0.49%，同时95HD和ASD分别降低0.61和0.21。这些结果表明，联合进行语义可靠性估计和几何误差校准可为半监督医学图像分割提供更可靠的伪监督。

title: Artificial intelligence in healthcare: clinical applications, evidence maturity, risks, and life-cycle governance.
source: PubMed · International journal of medical informatics
zh_title: 医疗AI：临床应用、证据成熟度、风险与全生命周期治理
summary: 一篇批判性叙述综述，基于人工筛选的28篇文献，梳理医疗AI应用、证据特征、机遇与风险，并提出治理要求。
key_points: 指出仅有技术性能不足以证明临床效用、安全与公平
语料为28篇可核查文献，经判断性筛选而非系统检索
归纳安全、公平、可持续落地所需的治理要求
reason: 叙述性综述，语料小且为判断性选取，综述上限内偏低档
abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used across clinical, administrative, and public health settings, but technical performance alone does not establish clinical utility, safety, equity, or sustainability. To critically analyze contemporary healthcare AI applications, characterize source types and non-ordinal evidence profiles in the supporting literature, synthesize key opportunities and risks, and identify governance requirements for clinically useful, safe, equitable, and responsible implementation. We conducted a critical narrative synthesis using PubMed, the Virtual Health Library, Web of Science, and Scopus as source-discovery tools on July 16, 2026. A curated corpus of 28 bibliographically verifiable publications was assembled judgmentally to provide complementary coverage of clinical applications, evidence characteristics, implementation, risk, and life-cycle governance. Sources were classified by primary design and non-mutually exclusive evidentiary domains, and the evidence described within them was characterized using non-ordinal profile categories. Findings were synthesized qualitatively because of substantial heterogeneity across technologies, settings, and source designs. The curated corpus addressed diagnosis and imaging, prediction and monitoring, clinical documentation, conversational systems, public health, hospital operations, and specialty applications. Within this assembled corpus, technical-performance/validation and process-utility/workflow domains were represented more often than clinical or patient-safety outcomes, economic outcomes, or post-deployment surveillance; these document-level counts are descriptive and have no inferential weight beyond the selected sources. Reported or proposed benefits included diagnostic support, personalization, documentation, surveillance, and workflow efficiency. Recurrent risks included poor generalizability, bias, miscalibration, hallucinations, opacity, privacy concerns, interoperability problems, inappropriate automation, unclear accountability, and hidden costs. Within this non-exhaustive corpus, the evidence more consistently supported assistive, context-specific uses than generalized autonomous replacement. Responsible implementation requires a clearly defined intended use, governed data, contextual validation, risk-proportionate human oversight, traceability, equity and safety assessment, continuous monitoring, and procedures to restrict, suspend, or withdraw systems when performanc
zh_abstract: [国际医学信息学杂志] 人工智能（AI）越来越多地用于临床、管理和公共卫生场景，但仅凭技术性能并不能确立其临床效用、安全性、公平性或可持续性。本研究旨在批判性分析当代医疗人工智能应用，刻画支持性文献中的来源类型和非序数证据特征，综合主要机遇与风险，并确定实现临床有用、安全、公平且负责任的实施所需的治理要求。我们开展了一项批判性叙述性综合，于2026年7月16日使用 PubMed、虚拟健康图书馆（Virtual Health Library）、Web of Science 和 Scopus 作为来源发现工具。通过判断性方式汇集了28篇可进行文献核实的出版物作为精选语料库，以便在临床应用、证据特征、实施、风险和生命周期治理方面提供互补的覆盖。来源按主要设计和非互斥的证据领域分类，其中所述证据采用非序数的特征类别加以刻画。由于技术、场景和来源设计之间存在显著异质性，研究结果以定性方式综合。该精选语料库涉及诊断与影像、预测与监测、临床文书、对话系统、公共卫生、医院运营和专科应用。在该语料库内，技术性能/验证以及流程效用/工作流领域比临床或患者安全结局、经济结局或部署后监测出现得更为频繁；这些文献层面的计数仅为描述性，除所选来源外不具有推断意义。已报告或提出的获益包括诊断支持、个性化、文书记录、监测和工作流效率。反复出现的风险包括泛化性差、偏倚、校准不良、幻觉、不透明、隐私问题、互操作性问题、不当自动化、责任不明确以及隐性成本。在这一非穷尽的语料库中，证据更一致地支持辅助性、特定情境的用途，而非通用的自主替代。负责任的实施需要明确界定的预期用途、受治理的数据、情境化验证、与风险相称的人类监督、可追溯性、公平性和安全性评估、持续监测，以及在性能下降时限制、暂停或撤回系统的程序。

title: Artificial intelligence assisted genomic profiling of ovarian cancer liver metastases.
zh_title: AI辅助卵巢癌肝转移基因组分析（迷你综述）
summary: 迷你综述探讨如何结合胚系易感性、体细胞变异、空间生物学与AI，解析高级别浆液性卵巢癌肝转移的病灶特异性分子特征。
key_points: 区分肝表面种植与实质沉积的分子差异
核心任务是区分胚系与肿瘤获得性变异
目前直接的分子证据有限
reason: 转移相关但为迷你综述，无新数据，上限偏低
abstract: [Frontiers in genetics] Liver involvement in ovarian cancer is often treated as a single clinical entity, although liver-surface implants and parenchymal deposits occupy different anatomical settings and may not share the same molecular history. Primary-tumor profiling is informative, but can miss lesion-specific evolution, treatment-associated cell states, and microenvironmental structure. This Mini Review examines how germline susceptibility, somatic change, spatial biology, and artificial intelligence might be combined in high-grade serous ovarian cancer. The central task is not simply outcome prediction. It is to distinguish constitutional from tumor-acquired variation, retain lesion identity and treatment timing, and relate molecular programs to defined spatial compartments. Current data support marked clonal and microenvironmental heterogeneity in ovarian cancer, but direct molecular evidence from hepatic lesions remains sparse. AI-based integration is therefore best viewed as a way to formulate and test reproducible hypotheses, rather than as a validated route to select liver-directed therapy. Paired sampling, orthogonal assays, patient-level validation, and decision-specific clinical endpoints will be needed before these models can influence management.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in genetics] 卵巢癌肝脏受累常被视为单一的临床实体，尽管肝表面种植灶和实质内转移灶处于不同的解剖环境，可能并不具有相同的分子演化历史。原发肿瘤的分析虽有参考价值，但可能遗漏病灶特异性的演化、与治疗相关的细胞状态以及微环境结构。本迷你综述探讨了在高级别浆液性卵巢癌中如何将种系易感性、体细胞改变、空间生物学和人工智能相结合。核心任务不仅仅是预测结局，而是区分体质性变异与肿瘤获得性变异，保留病灶身份和治疗时间信息，并将分子程序与明确的空间区室相关联。现有数据支持卵巢癌存在显著的克隆和微环境异质性，但来自肝脏病灶的直接分子证据仍然稀少。因此，基于AI的整合最好被视为提出并检验可重复假设的一种方式，而不是经过验证的选择肝脏定向治疗的途径。在这些模型能够影响临床管理之前，需要配对采样、正交检测、患者水平验证以及针对具体决策的临床终点。

title: Artificial intelligence for ophthalmic vessel segmentation: from multimodal imaging to clinical translation.
zh_title: 眼科血管分割AI：从多模态影像到临床转化
summary: 结构化叙述性综述，比较眼底、SLO、OCTA、OCT等多种影像上的血管分割任务及部署中的误差来源。
key_points: 涵盖视网膜、脉络膜、角膜与结膜血管
分析类别不平衡、尺度变化等挑战
指出数据集内高性能未必转化为可靠临床测量
reason: 叙述性综述，眼科方向，综述类封顶，信息有限
abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Artificial intelligence (AI)-based vessel segmentation converts color fundus photographs, scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO), optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA), structural OCT, and anterior-segment images into quantitative vascular biomarkers. Strong performance within individual datasets has not consistently yielded reliable clinical measurements because errors can arise during acquisition, anatomical preprocessing, vessel extraction, biomarker calculation, and deployment. This structured narrative review compares segmentation tasks involving retinal vascular trees, OCTA capillary plexuses, the structural choroid and choriocapillaris, macular neovascularization, corneal neovascularization, and conjunctival microvasculature. We assess modern architectures in relation to vessel geometry, severe foreground-background imbalance, scale variation, crossings, and susceptibility to artifacts. The methods considered include multiscale feature pyramids, deformable and directional operators, Transformers, state-space models, diffusion approaches, and foundation models. We organize the synthesis around five evaluation levels: pixel overlap, centerline recovery, vascular topology, biomarker agreement, and clinical actionability. Public fundus and OCTA datasets are catalogued with their acquisition and annotation characteristics, and gaps in public anterior-segment vessel benchmarks are discussed. Because devices, data splits, labels, and post-processing differ substantially, reported metrics are summarized without ranking studies against one another. The review distinguishes structural OCT choroidal vascularity index from OCTA choriocapillaris flow-deficit mapping, as well as true vessel segmentation from global hyperemia grading. Clinical translation will require ocular-magnification correction, quality control of retinal layers and projection artifacts, external testing across devices and populations, out-of-distribution rejection, DICOM/PACS interoperability, prospective impact studies, and regulation as software as a medical device. We conclude that clinical utility depends on an auditable pipeline that measures structural error, biomarker uncertainty, and failure states throughout the workflow.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] 基于人工智能（AI）的血管分割可将彩色眼底照片、扫描激光检眼镜（SLO）、光学相干断层扫描血管成像（OCTA）、结构OCT和眼前节图像转化为定量血管生物标志物。由于误差可能出现在采集、解剖学预处理、血管提取、生物标志物计算和部署等环节，单个数据集内的优异表现并不总能带来可靠的临床测量结果。本结构化叙述性综述比较了涉及视网膜血管树、OCTA毛细血管丛、结构性脉络膜和脉络膜毛细血管层、黄斑新生血管、角膜新生血管以及结膜微血管的分割任务。我们结合血管几何形态、严重的前景-背景不平衡、尺度变化、血管交叉以及对伪影的敏感性，评估了现代架构。所考察的方法包括多尺度特征金字塔、可变形和方向性算子、Transformer、状态空间模型、扩散方法和基础模型。我们围绕五个评价层级组织综合分析：像素重叠、中心线恢复、血管拓扑、生物标志物一致性和临床可操作性。文中梳理了公开的眼底和OCTA数据集及其采集与标注特征，并讨论了公开眼前节血管基准数据的缺口。由于设备、数据划分、标签和后处理差异很大，所报告的指标仅作汇总，不对各研究进行相互排名。本综述区分了结构OCT脉络膜血管指数与OCTA脉络膜毛细血管血流缺损图，也区分了真正的血管分割与整体充血分级。临床转化需要进行眼球放大率校正、视网膜分层和投影伪影的质量控制、跨设备和跨人群的外部测试、分布外样本拒识、DICOM/PACS互操作性、前瞻性影响研究，以及按医疗器械软件进行监管。我们的结论是，临床实用性取决于一条可审计的流程，该流程应在整个工作流中衡量结构误差、生物标志物不确定性和失效状态。

title: Artificial intelligence-based decision support for axial spondyloarthritis integrating inflammatory and structural MRI information.
zh_title: 整合炎症与结构MRI信息的轴性脊柱关节炎AI决策支持
summary: 回顾性研究开发仅基于图像的两阶段深度学习框架，融合骶髂关节MRI的FS T1与STIR序列，以近似风湿科医生对axSpA的临床判断。
key_points: 两阶段框架融合FS T1与STIR序列
第一阶段预测骨髓水肿，再生成axSpA概率
回顾性设计，以临床诊断为参考标准
reason: 回顾性、单一来源信息，未见外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in immunology] Axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) assessment on MRI is complicated by interpretation difficulty and by clinical variables that may be incomplete at the time of imaging. We aimed to develop an image-only deep learning framework to approximate the clinical assessment of axSpA from sacroiliac joint (SIJ) MRI, integrating fat-suppressed T1-weighted (FS T1) and short tau inversion recovery (STIR) sequences to capture structural and inflammatory information without clinical variables. This retrospective study included patients with chronic back pain who underwent SIJ MRI from January 2010 to December 2021. The treating rheumatologist's clinical diagnosis served as the reference standard. A two-stage framework integrated FS T1 and STIR features with Stage 1-derived binary bone marrow edema (BME) predictions to generate an axSpA probability. Performance in a test set was compared with the Assessment of SpondyloArthritis International Society (ASAS) definition of a "positive MRI" and the ASAS classification criteria using exact McNemar tests; discordant cases were analyzed separately. Among 291 patients (163 axSpA, 128 non-axSpA), the model achieved an AUROC of 0.9412, accuracy of 86.0%, sensitivity of 87.5%, and specificity of 84.0% in the test set (n=57). No significant paired differences in accuracy, sensitivity, or specificity were detected between the model and either ASAS comparator. In an exploratory analysis of 10 cases discordant between ASAS "positive MRI" assessment and clinical diagnosis, the model correctly classified 7 (70.0%). The model showed similar performance to the ASAS-based comparators in the test set without clinical variables, suggesting potential value as an image-based decision-support tool. External multicenter validation is needed to confirm generalizability.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in immunology] 轴性脊柱关节炎（axSpA）的 MRI 评估因解读困难，以及成像时临床变量可能不完整而变得复杂。我们旨在开发一种仅基于图像的深度学习框架，通过骶髂关节（SIJ）MRI 近似临床 axSpA 评估，整合脂肪抑制 T1 加权（FS T1）和短 tau 反转恢复（STIR）序列，以在不使用临床变量的情况下获取结构和炎症信息。这项回顾性研究纳入了 2010 年 1 月至 2021 年 12 月期间接受 SIJ MRI 检查的慢性背痛患者。以主治风湿科医师的临床诊断作为参考标准。一个两阶段框架将 FS T1 和 STIR 特征与第 1 阶段得出的二分类骨髓水肿（BME）预测相整合，以生成 axSpA 概率。在测试集中，将模型表现与国际脊柱关节炎评估协会（ASAS）对“MRI 阳性”的定义及 ASAS 分类标准进行比较，采用精确 McNemar 检验；不一致病例另行分析。在 291 例患者（163 例 axSpA，128 例非 axSpA）中，模型在测试集（n=57）中的 AUROC 为 0.9412，准确率为 86.0%，敏感性为 87.5%，特异性为 84.0%。模型与任一 ASAS 对照相比，在准确率、敏感性或特异性方面均未检测到显著的配对差异。在对 ASAS“MRI 阳性”评估与临床诊断不一致的 10 例病例的探索性分析中，模型正确分类了 7 例（70.0%）。在不使用临床变量的情况下，该模型在测试集中表现出与基于 ASAS 的对照相似的性能，提示其作为基于图像的决策支持工具具有潜在价值。仍需进行外部多中心验证以确认其泛化性。

title: Outcomes of informal and formal care models at the end of life: An AI-supported systematic review.
zh_title: 临终期非正式与正式照护模式结局：AI辅助系统综述
summary: 一项AI辅助筛选的系统综述，评估非正式、正式及联合照护对老年人临终期健康结局、医疗利用和费用的影响。
key_points: 已在PROSPERO注册，叙述性综合
用ASReview筛选，LLM TXYZ.AI辅助质量评估
检索PubMed、Embase、CINAHL至2025年6月
reason: AI仅作文献筛选工具，主题为照护模式，属增量档
abstract: [Geriatric nursing (New York, N.Y.)] Multimorbidity and functional decline become increasingly prevalent with age, particularly in those near the end of life. This poses critical challenges for both families and society in providing adequate care. However, it remains unclear which type of care yields better outcomes. To systematically assess the impact of informal care, formal care, and a combination of both on health outcomes, healthcare utilization, and costs of care for older adults near the end of life. A systematic review with narrative synthesis was registered on PROSPERO (CRD42024512003). Screening was assisted by machine learning tool ASReview, and study quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool, with support from large language model TXYZ.AI. Articles published between database inception and June 4th, 2025 were identified in PubMed, Embase, and CINAHL. Thirty-six studies, including 20 observational and 16 interventional were included. Most observational studies examined place of death, with some associations involving informal care pointing towards lower home death or greater hospital death. In contrast, physician and nurse home visits were associated with a greater likelihood of home death. Specialized formal care interventions generally reported improvements in quality of life and reductions in healthcare use. Quality assessment showed 85.2% AI-human agreement, with 44.4% of studies meeting all seven quality criteria. Informal care did not necessarily facilitate home death, whereas formal home-based care was linked to a greater likelihood of home death. Interventional evidence also suggests broader benefits of specialized formal care, although certainty was limited by methodological concerns.
zh_abstract: [老年护理（纽约）] 多重疾病和功能下降随年龄增长日益普遍，在临终期人群中尤为突出，这给家庭和社会提供充分照护带来严峻挑战。然而，何种照护方式能带来更好的结局仍不明确。目的：系统评估非正式照护、正式照护及二者结合对临终期老年人健康结局、医疗服务利用和照护成本的影响。【方法】本系统综述采用叙述性综合，已在PROSPERO注册（CRD42024512003）。筛选借助机器学习工具ASReview辅助，研究质量采用混合方法评价工具（Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool）评估，并借助大语言模型TXYZ.AI支持。检索了PubMed、Embase和CINAHL自建库至2025年6月4日发表的文献。【结果】共纳入36项研究，其中20项观察性研究、16项干预性研究。多数观察性研究考察了死亡地点，其中一些涉及非正式照护的关联提示居家死亡较少或医院死亡较多；相反，医生和护士上门访视与居家死亡的可能性更高相关。专业化正式照护干预总体上报告生活质量改善和医疗服务使用减少。质量评估显示AI与人工一致性为85.2%，44.4%的研究满足全部七项质量标准。【结论】非正式照护不一定促进居家死亡，而正式的居家照护与更高的居家死亡可能性相关。干预性证据还提示专业化正式照护具有更广泛的获益，但由于方法学问题，证据确定性有限。

title: Attention Residual U-Net for Enhanced Cross-Dataset Polyp Localization in Endoscopy
zh_title: 用于跨数据集息肉定位的注意力残差U-Net
summary: 提出基于注意力残差U-Net的息肉检测框架，学习病灶空间表征并转换为边界框，以提升跨数据集鲁棒性。
key_points: 不直接回归边界框，而是学习病灶聚焦表征
针对设备差异、数据集偏倚、小病灶
面向内镜跨数据集定位
reason: 常规检测方法改进，摘要未见充分证据
abstract: Precise localization of pathologies in endoscopy is a critical task in medical imaging, with deep learning (DL) frameworks now serving as the primary methodology for automated lesion detection. Today, generic object detection methods, such as YOLO, provide state-of-the-art performance in this context. However, their robustness often decreases under real-world clinical conditions due to variations across endoscopic devices, intestinal content, dataset bias, and the presence of small or low-contrast lesions. Motivated by these challenges, we propose a novel polyp detection framework based on a Attention Residual U-Net offering enhanced polyp localization. Instead of directly regressing bounding boxes from global feature representations, the proposed method learns lesion-focused spatial representations and converts them into bounding-box predictions during inference. Unlike conventional encoder-decoder localization frameworks that directly propagate all encoder activations into the decoding pathway, the proposed method selectively suppresses irrelevant background responses before feature reconstruction. This encourages the network to focus on lesion-relevant spatial evidence under heterogeneous imaging conditions. To achieve this, the framework integrates residual feature propagation, attention-guided encoder filtering, and multi-scale contextual learning. The proposed framework was evaluated on multiple public endoscopic datasets acquired using different devices. The comparative experimental results validate its effectiveness over the relevant state-of-the-art methods, with an improvement up to 22.0% in terms of the area under the receiving operating characteristic (AUC).
zh_abstract: 内镜中病变的精确定位是医学影像中的一项关键任务，深度学习（DL）框架目前已成为自动病变检测的主要方法。如今，YOLO 等通用目标检测方法在此背景下可提供最先进的性能。然而，由于内镜设备差异、肠道内容物、数据集偏倚以及小病灶或低对比度病灶的存在，它们在真实临床条件下的鲁棒性往往下降。针对这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于注意力残差 U-Net（Attention Residual U-Net）的新型息肉检测框架，可增强息肉定位能力。该方法不是直接从全局特征表示回归边界框，而是学习聚焦于病变的空间表示，并在推理时将其转换为边界框预测。与将编码器所有激活直接传递到解码路径的传统编码器-解码器定位框架不同，所提方法在特征重建之前选择性地抑制无关的背景响应，从而促使网络在异质成像条件下聚焦于与病变相关的空间证据。为此，该框架整合了残差特征传播、注意力引导的编码器过滤以及多尺度上下文学习。我们在使用不同设备采集的多个公开内镜数据集上对该框架进行了评估。对比实验结果验证了其相对于相关最先进方法的有效性，受试者操作特征曲线下面积（AUC）最高提升 22.0%。

title: A conditional generative model for T2-weighted prostate MRI with downstream evaluation in clinically significant cancer classificatio
zh_title: 面向前列腺癌分类的T2加权MRI条件生成模型
summary: 在MAISI-v2基础上加入癌症类别、分区和病灶掩膜条件，用1,303例患者微调，并评估合成数据对csPCa分类器的增益。
key_points: 单中心回顾性研究，1,654个病灶
FID由13.28降至内部2.04
在五种训练数据情景下评估下游分类
reason: 单中心回顾性，生成模型方法有新意但证据有限
abstract: Scarce and unrepresentative training data limit the performance of prostate MRI prediction models. Synthetic T2-weighted (T2W) MRI may augment training data containing clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) and transition zone (TZ) lesions. In this retrospective, single-center, ethics-committee-approved study, we developed a conditional generative model for T2W prostate MRI extending MAISI-v2 with csPCa class, zonal, and lesion-mask-guided conditioning, incorporating a relative advantage weighted loss fine-tuned on 1,303 patients (1,654 lesions). Fidelity was assessed by incremental ablation, and downstream utility was evaluated with T2W-based csPCa classifiers across five simulated training-data scenarios, each testing 18 synthetic-data configurations. The proposed model reduced Fréchet inception distance (FID) from 13.28 (pretrained MAISI-v2) to $2.04 \pm 0.06$ internally (PI-CAI: $3.83 \pm 0.51$). Synthetic augmentation significantly increased AUC in all five scenarios (+0.027 to +0.088; adjusted $p = 0.016$--$0.043$), though cross-institutional augmentation of PI-CAI yielded a non-significant gain (+0.013; $p = 0.397$). Overall, our model improved T2W MRI fidelity, and synthetic images improved csPCa classification under simulated data constraints, although benefit did not transfer significantly across institutions.
zh_abstract: 训练数据稀缺且缺乏代表性，限制了前列腺 MRI 预测模型的性能。合成的 T2 加权（T2W）MRI 可能用于扩充包含临床显著性前列腺癌（csPCa）和移行带（TZ）病灶的训练数据。在这项经伦理委员会批准的回顾性单中心研究中，我们开发了一种用于 T2W 前列腺 MRI 的条件生成模型，在 MAISI-v2 基础上扩展了 csPCa 类别、分区以及病灶掩膜引导的条件控制，并引入相对优势加权损失，在 1,303 例患者（1,654 个病灶）上进行了微调。通过逐步消融评估保真度，并在五种模拟训练数据情景下，用基于 T2W 的 csPCa 分类器评估下游效用，每种情景测试 18 种合成数据配置。所提出的模型将 Fréchet inception distance（FID）从 13.28（预训练 MAISI-v2）降低至内部数据上的 $2.04 \pm 0.06$（PI-CAI：$3.83 \pm 0.51$）。合成数据扩充在全部五种情景中均显著提高了 AUC（+0.027 至 +0.088；校正后 $p = 0.016$--$0.043$），但对 PI-CAI 的跨机构扩充带来的提升不显著（+0.013；$p = 0.397$）。总体而言，我们的模型提高了 T2W MRI 的保真度，合成图像在模拟的数据受限条件下改善了 csPCa 分类，尽管其获益未能在机构间显著迁移。

title: Poisson Super Learning For Survival And Competing Risks On A Discretized Time Scale
zh_title: 泊松超级学习器：离散时间生存与竞争风险预测
summary: 提出基于泊松似然的集成方法，用于右删失数据的生存与竞争风险预测，可整合多种风险函数学习器。
key_points: 利用分段常数风险与泊松似然的对应
交叉验证对数风险经泊松元学习器组合
可估计生存概率与特定病因绝对风险
reason: 预印本，方法学贡献，摘要未见临床验证
abstract: We introduce the Poisson Super Learner, a scalable ensemble method for survival and competing risks prediction with right-censored data. The approach exploits the correspondence between the likelihood of piecewise-constant hazard models and the Poisson likelihood. After expanding the data over a chosen time partition, candidate hazard learners are trained under a common Poisson loss, and cross-validated log-hazard predictions are combined by a Poisson meta learner. The resulting ensemble is a geometric combination of candidate hazards, and can be used to estimate survival probabilities and cause-specific absolute risks. The Poisson Super Learner framework is modular and can in principle incorporate any learner that can estimate interval-specific hazards, including parametric, penalised, additive, and other machine-learning hazard models. Training targets the cause-specific hazard directly and does not require explicit modelling of the censoring distribution. For competing risks, separate cause-specific ensembles are fitted and subsequently combined to obtain individualised cumulative incidence predictions. We illustrate the approach using data from the Steno Diabetes Center collected between 2005 and 2022 to predict cardiovascular disease risk in patients with type 1 diabetes from detailed covariate information. The applied analysis is complemented by simulation studies designed to reflect key features of the data and to examine the behaviour of the method under controlled settings. All analyses were implemented using the freely available R software package poissonsuperlearner.
zh_abstract: 我们提出了Poisson Super Learner，这是一种用于右删失数据的生存和竞争风险预测的可扩展集成方法。该方法利用了分段常数风险模型的似然与Poisson似然之间的对应关系。在选定的时间划分上对数据进行扩展后，候选风险学习器在共同的Poisson损失下进行训练，并由一个Poisson元学习器组合经交叉验证的对数风险预测。所得集成是各候选风险的几何组合，可用于估计生存概率和特定原因的绝对风险。Poisson Super Learner框架是模块化的，原则上可纳入任何能够估计区间特异性风险的学习器，包括参数模型、惩罚模型、可加模型及其他机器学习风险模型。训练直接以特定原因的风险为目标，无需对删失分布进行显式建模。对于竞争风险，分别拟合特定原因的集成模型，随后将其组合以获得个体化的累积发病率预测。我们使用Steno糖尿病中心2005年至2022年收集的数据，根据详细的协变量信息预测1型糖尿病患者的心血管疾病风险，以说明该方法。应用分析辅以模拟研究，这些模拟旨在反映数据的关键特征，并在受控条件下考察该方法的表现。所有分析均使用免费的R软件包poissonsuperlearner实现。

title: Tug of Watts: A study on the Energy - Accuracy Trade-off of Large Language Models on Medical Question Answering Tasks
zh_title: 医学问答中大语言模型的能耗与准确率权衡研究
summary: 在OpenMedical-LLM榜单任务上评估13个（270M–14B参数）LLM的能耗与碳排放，讨论能耗与准确率的联合权衡。
key_points: 覆盖3个模型家族共13个LLM
估算医学问答任务的能耗与碳足迹
主张联合报告能耗与准确率
reason: 预印本，视角新但证据有限，属增量档
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in medical question answering (QA) systems. While recent works aim at incrementally improving the downstream task accuracy, an empirical estimation of the models' energy consumption and the associated carbon footprints is often overlooked. In this study, we demonstrate how practitioners can estimate energy consumption and arrive at reliable emission estimates for medical QA tasks available in the OpenMedical-LLM leaderboard by investigating 13 LLMs from 3 model families ranging from 270M to 14B parameters. We discuss how one can critically interpret energy versus accuracy trade-offs for a set of models for a given task. With this work, we underline that reporting disjoint energy and accuracy metrics alone does not suffice for careful trade-off assessments, but it also demands systematic construction and interpretation of joint trade-off metrics. We envisage such studies aiding practitioners in adopting better and more efficient models for their task and helping them become active participants in building sustainable LLM pipelines.

title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks vs. Multi-Layer Perceptrons: A Rigorous Statistical Benchmark on Clinical Tabular Data
zh_title: KAN与MLP在临床表格数据上的严格统计基准
summary: 在七个医学表格数据集上比较九种KAN变体、调参MLP与随机森林，采用重复分层交叉验证与嵌套贝叶斯调参。
key_points: 11种架构、7个跨专科数据集
3x5重复分层K折与嵌套调参
指出AUROC在不平衡队列中可能过于乐观
reason: 规范基准但仅内部验证的预印本，增量档
abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) have recently been proposed as a promising alternative to Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs). However, empirical evaluations on structured medical datasets remain scarce, and commonly reported metrics like AUROC can yield overly optimistic performance estimates on imbalanced clinical cohorts. In this study, we present a standardized benchmark comparing eleven architectures - nine KAN variants (FastKAN, WavKAN, ReLUKAN, ChebyKAN, TaylorKAN, GramKAN, JacobiKAN, LegendreKAN, and TabKAN), a tuned StandardMLP, and a Random Forest baseline - across seven heterogeneous medical tabular datasets spanning oncology, cardiology, nephrology, neurology, endocrinology, and obstetrics. Our experimental protocol employs a 3x5 Repeated Stratified K-Fold cross-validation scheme with nested Bayesian hyperparameter optimization and evaluates discrimination via Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC), calibration through the Brier Score, and computational efficiency. Formal equivalence testing is conducted using the Bayesian Correlated t-Test with a Region of Practical Equivalence (ROPE) at +/- 0.01. The results indicate that on datasets with severe class imbalance, dedicated KAN architectures (particularly TabKAN and ReLUKAN) can improve minority-class detection and achieve higher AUPRC than standard MLPs. Nevertheless, across pooled datasets, KAN variants demonstrate comparable overall predictive discrimination rather than a systematic advantage, while requiring 1.20x to 1.48x longer inference latency per sample and up to 12.5x more trainable parameters. Consequently, StandardMLP remains a strong baseline on the efficiency Pareto frontier, while KAN variants provide a viable alternative when precision on rare positive cases is the primary clinical objective. The code for reproducing the results is available at https://github.com/rafalwodzinski/kan_mlp_comparison.

title: TME-ContextNet: Class-Conditioned Spatial Supervision and Grouped Decoding for Joint Nuclei Instance Segmentation and Classification
zh_title: TME-ContextNet：细胞核实例分割与分类的类条件空间监督
summary: 提出多任务框架，利用距离变换从现有核标注生成类条件空间监督，并用分组解码器；在PanMix、CoNSeP等数据集上实验。
key_points: 无需额外组织区域标注
局部-全局上下文模块结合扩张卷积与自注意力
空间头仅训练使用，推理时省略
reason: 病理分割方法预印本，公开数据集内验证，增量
abstract: Joint nuclei instance segmentation and classification requires precise boundaries and neighborhood information that helps distinguish morphologically similar cell types. We present TME-ContextNet, a multi-task framework that learns class-conditioned spatial context from existing nuclear annotations and organizes decoding into geometry-related and semantic task groups. Class-conditioned spatial supervision extends nuclear labels into a dense target using Euclidean distance transforms, requiring no additional tissue-region annotation. We derive its nearest-region interpretation and characterize its stability to small annotation perturbations. A local--global context module combines dilated convolution and self-attention, while a grouped task decoder reduces redundant computation. The spatial head supplies training supervision and is omitted during inference. Experiments on PanMix, CoNSeP, and PanNuke yield Dice scores of 80.23%, 65.32%, and 79.13%, and mean multi-class panoptic quality (mPQ+) scores of 67.62%, 35.50%, and 43.74%, respectively. PanNuke results are averaged across three test folds. Target and decoder controls support the combination of distance-based supervision and grouped decoding while identifying their dependence on task configuration. The framework uses 36.40 million parameters, compared with 54.74 million for HoVer-Net. These findings support a compact, context-aware formulation for joint nuclei analysis in computational pathology.
zh_abstract: 细胞核实例分割与分类联合任务需要精确的边界以及有助于区分形态相似细胞类型的邻域信息。我们提出了TME-ContextNet，这是一种多任务框架，可从现有的细胞核标注中学习类别条件化的空间上下文，并将解码过程组织为几何相关任务组和语义任务组。类别条件化空间监督利用欧氏距离变换将细胞核标签扩展为密集目标，无需额外的组织区域标注。我们推导了其最近区域解释，并刻画了其对微小标注扰动的稳定性。局部—全局上下文模块结合了空洞卷积与自注意力，而分组任务解码器减少了冗余计算。空间头提供训练监督，在推理时被省略。在PanMix、CoNSeP和PanNuke上的实验分别取得了80.23%、65.32%和79.13%的Dice分数，以及67.62%、35.50%和43.74%的平均多类全景质量（mPQ+）分数。PanNuke结果为三个测试折的平均值。目标与解码器的对照实验支持基于距离的监督与分组解码相结合的做法，同时也表明它们依赖于任务配置。该框架使用3640万个参数，而HoVer-Net为5474万个。这些发现支持在计算病理学中采用一种紧凑的、具备上下文感知能力的细胞核联合分析方案。

title: Peripheral prototypical contrastive loss for supervised medical image segmentation
zh_title: 面向监督式医学图像分割的外周原型对比损失
summary: 提出PPC损失，利用边界附近局部区域的原型特征做对比学习，以改善边界识别并在噪声标注下稳定训练。
key_points: 聚焦边界模糊区域的原型对比学习
多数据集实验显示含噪标签下分割性能提升
摘要未提供具体数值与外部验证
reason: 预印本，损失函数小改进，证据有限
abstract: Robust segmentation of biomedical images remains challenging primarily due to ill-defined object boundaries. Although several loss functions have recently been proposed to enhance object boundary recognition, concerns remain about the susceptibility to unstable annotations resulting from boundary ambiguities. Here, we introduce the Peripheral Prototypical Contrastive (PPC) loss, which leverages prototypical contrastive learning to improve boundary recognition and enable stable training even under noisy annotation conditions. The PPC loss utilizes prototype features obtained from local regions near object boundaries, focusing specifically on ambiguous areas that have been challenging for existing approaches. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrated that the PPC loss consistently improve segmentation performance even under conditions with noisy labels. A newly proposed strategy, which adaptively determines the local region for prototype calculation, enhanced robustness and outperformed existing methods. Our findings indicate the potential of the PPC loss in facilitating scalable and reliable medical image segmentation, including the development of foundation models with imperfect annotations.
zh_abstract: 生物医学图像的稳健分割仍然具有挑战性，主要原因在于目标边界定义不清。尽管近来已提出多种损失函数以增强对目标边界的识别，但人们仍然担心其易受边界模糊所导致的不稳定标注的影响。在此，我们提出外周原型对比（Peripheral Prototypical Contrastive，PPC）损失，该损失利用原型对比学习来改善边界识别，并使模型即使在含噪声标注的条件下也能稳定训练。PPC 损失利用从目标边界附近局部区域获得的原型特征，特别关注现有方法难以处理的模糊区域。在多个数据集上开展的大量实验表明，即使在标签含噪声的条件下，PPC 损失也能持续提升分割性能。我们新提出的一种自适应确定原型计算所用局部区域的策略，进一步增强了鲁棒性，并优于现有方法。我们的研究结果表明，PPC 损失在促进可扩展且可靠的医学图像分割方面具有潜力，包括在使用不完美标注开发基础模型方面。

title: Resampling-based batch reweighting for ComBat harmonization of MRI radiomic features in a multi-scanner glioma cohort
zh_title: 基于重采样批次重加权的胶质瘤多扫描仪MRI影像组学ComBat校正
summary: 在733例单中心胶质瘤回顾性队列中，研究在ComBat估计前对欠代表扫描仪批次重加权能否改善影像组学特征协调并保留分级信息。
key_points: Erasmus胶质瘤数据库733例，九种设备配置
分析四种结构MRI序列、428个特征
目标是降低扫描仪残留关联并保留分级信息
reason: 单中心回顾性预印本，方法为增量改进
abstract: Radiomic features derived from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are sensitive to scanners; therefore, they require harmonization across scanners. In a radiomic feature dataset, some batches may be severely underrepresented compared to the others e.g., the Erasmus Glioma Database, which may provide harmonized features biased towards the larger batches in the dataset. We investigated whether reweighting underrepresented scanner batches before empirical-Bayes ComBat estimation improves feature harmonization and reduces residual scanner association while retaining grade-related information. In this retrospective, the Erasmus Glioma Database included 733 eligible patients acquired at a single center across nine vendor-by-field-strength configurations. Structural MRI acquired at 1 T, 1.5 T, and 3 T; four structural MRI sequences were analyzed. From four structural MRI sequences, 428 features were computed using an IBSI-compliant PyRadiomics implementation. The sample sizes of some scanner batches were very small compared to others, which may produce unequal precision and shrinkage of batch-effect estimates. We proposed a data augmentation approach to overcome the limitation of ComBat. We provided exploratory evidence, along with confirmatory Kruskal-Wallis tests with a Benjamini-Hochberg correction to assess the proposed method. Before harmonization, 392/428 features (91.6%) differed significantly across scanner batches (median eta-squared=0.463). Standard ComBat reduced this to 13/428 (3.0%), whereas batch-augmented ComBat reduced it to 8/428 (1.9%); the median residual effect size was <0.001 for both harmonized conditions. Batch augmentation appeared to be a useful strategy to improve the performance of ComBat for feature harmonization under severe batch-size imbalance.

title: Metadata-Conditioned Audio Transformers for Adaptive Respiratory Sound Classification
zh_title: 面向呼吸音分类的元数据条件音频Transformer
summary: 为音频频谱Transformer设计多种元数据条件机制（含TAFiLM、SoftFiLM），以应对设备、听诊部位等采集差异对呼吸音分类的干扰。
key_points: 从门控残差融合到适配Transformer的FiLM
提出TAFiLM与SoftFiLM两种新变体
针对设备、部位和患者特征带来的系统性变异
reason: 新方法但摘要无结果与外部验证，属增量档；预印本
abstract: Respiratory sound classification from auscultation recordings is confounded by heterogeneous acquisition conditions, including recording device, auscultation site, and patient characteristics, that introduce systematic variability unrelated to the underlying pathology. Although such metadata is often available, existing approaches either ignore it or rely on naïve fusion strategies that do not model how distinct metadata sources influence different components of the acoustic representation. We propose a family of metadata-conditioning mechanisms for the Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST), progressing from gated residual fusion to Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) adapted to the Transformer architecture. We further introduce two novel variants: Token-Aware FiLM (TAFiLM), which applies distinct modulation to classification and patch tokens, and Soft-Factorized FiLM (SoftFiLM), which learns soft masks to align metadata factors with disentangled feature subspaces. Experiments on the ICBHI benchmark demonstrate consistent gains across all conditioning strategies. SoftFiLM achieves 64.11% on the official 4-class task (+3.94% over the baseline) and 72.40% on the 2-class task, establishing a new state-of-the-art on the 2-class task and competitive performance on the 4-class benchmark.

title: PhenoMe: An interactive AI framework for interpretable, microscopy-driven phenotyping
zh_title: PhenoMe：交互式可解释显微图像表型分析框架
summary: PhenoMe 是开源、模型无关的框架，利用基础模型嵌入结合图像属性与实验元数据，进行嵌入可视化、聚类与相似性检索。
key_points: 处理预训练基础模型的图像表示
整合定量图像属性与实验元数据
支持嵌入可视化、聚类和相似性检索
reason: 开源工具型预印本，摘要未见对比与验证
abstract: Extracting meaningful biological patterns from microscopy image datasets requires tools that quantitatively connect visual similarities and experimental context. Deep learning models, and in particular novel foundation models, have the capacity to translate images into high-dimensional embeddings that can better represent complex visual patterns. Using these complex representations analytically and linking them to experimental information, it is possible to build advanced exploratory and phenotyping capabilities. Here, we present PhenoMe, an open-source, model-agnostic framework to handle pretrained foundation model-derived image representations alongside quantitative image properties and experimental metadata. PhenoMe integrates multiple scriptable and interactive workflows for embedding space visualisation, dimensionality reduction and clustering, similarity-based comparison and retrieval of representative images for each phenotype, among others. It also supports correlation analyses that link the embedding structure to interpretable image properties. We demonstrate PhenoMe's capabilities on seven public microscopy datasets, ranging from cell painting assays, nanoscale synaptic images, drug-response analyses and dynamic cell-phenotyping. These case studies show how readily available image representations can support data contextualisation, curation and analysis. Through guided notebooks, reproducible configurations, extensible model wrappers and a napari plugin, PhenoMe makes representation-based microscopy exploration accessible to researchers without dedicated technical expertise. PhenoMe lays the groundwork for applying foundation models and representation learning to microscopy data analysis.
zh_abstract: 要从显微镜图像数据集中提取有意义的生物学模式，需要能够以定量方式将视觉相似性与实验背景联系起来的工具。深度学习模型，尤其是新型基础模型，能够将图像转换为高维嵌入，从而更好地表示复杂的视觉模式。利用这些复杂的表示并将其与实验信息相关联，可以构建先进的探索与表型分析能力。在此，我们提出 PhenoMe，这是一个开源、与模型无关的框架，用于处理由预训练基础模型得到的图像表示，以及定量图像属性和实验元数据。PhenoMe 整合了多种可脚本化和交互式的工作流程，用于嵌入空间可视化、降维与聚类、基于相似性的比较，以及为每种表型检索代表性图像等。它还支持将嵌入结构与可解释的图像属性联系起来的相关性分析。我们在七个公开的显微镜数据集上展示了 PhenoMe 的能力，涵盖细胞染色（cell painting）实验、纳米尺度突触图像、药物反应分析和动态细胞表型分析。这些案例研究表明，现成的图像表示如何能够支持数据情境化、数据整理和分析。通过引导式笔记本、可复现的配置、可扩展的模型封装器和 napari 插件，PhenoMe 使没有专门技术背景的研究人员也能进行基于表示的显微镜探索。PhenoMe 为将基础模型和表示学习应用于显微镜数据分析奠定了基础。

title: FedEpitope: Parameter-Efficient Federated Protein Language Models for Linear B-Cell Epitope Prediction
zh_title: FedEpitope：参数高效的联邦蛋白语言模型预测线性B细胞表位
summary: 用LoRA适配ESM-2，在联邦框架下预测线性B细胞表位，通信的可训练参数约1.11 MB，在五个按生物体划分的客户端上用FedAvg与FedProx做模拟基准。
key_points: ESM-2结合LoRA，通信状态约1.11 MB
FedAvg/FedProx，同源性感知数据划分
五个异质客户端的模拟基准
reason: 预印本，仅模拟联邦基准，无真实多机构验证
abstract: Linear B-cell epitopes are antigenic regions recognised by antibodies that play crucial roles in vaccine development, antibody production, and other therapeutic applications.Their prediction can support peptide-based vaccine candidate screening and diagnostic assay development, but the experimental data required for model development may be distributed across institutions that cannot freely pool their records. We present FedEpitope, a federated framework that adapts the ESM-2 protein language model for peptide-level linear B-cell epitope prediction using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), keeping client-partitioned data local and restricting the communicated trainable model state to approximately 1.11 MB. Simulated benchmarks of FedAvg and FedProx algorithms, evaluated using homology-aware data splits of five biologically heterogeneous, organism-partitioned clients, achieve promising global test performance without centralising training data, with FedAvg outperforming all single-client models in mean AP, F1, and MCC. Additional experiments characterise post-federation personalisation, record-level differential privacy, sensitivity to controlled client heterogeneity, LoRA rank, and generalisation to the independent BCPreds and NetBCE benchmarks, demonstrating the feasibility of parameter-efficient federated protein language model adaptation for data-localised B-cell epitope prediction and the associated trade-offs among predictive performance, personalisation, privacy, communication efficiency, and distribution shift.
zh_abstract: 线性B细胞表位是抗体识别的抗原区域，在疫苗开发、抗体生产及其他治疗应用中发挥关键作用。对其进行预测可支持基于肽的候选疫苗筛选和诊断检测方法开发，但模型开发所需的实验数据可能分散于无法自由汇集记录的各机构。我们提出FedEpitope，一种联邦框架，利用低秩适配（LoRA）改造ESM-2蛋白质语言模型，用于肽水平的线性B细胞表位预测，客户端划分的数据保留在本地，所传输的可训练模型状态限制在约1.11 MB。对FedAvg和FedProx算法进行模拟基准测试，采用基于同源性感知的数据划分，评估五个生物学异质、按物种划分的客户端，在不集中训练数据的情况下取得了良好的全局测试性能，其中FedAvg在平均AP、F1和MCC上均优于所有单客户端模型。其他实验刻画了联邦后个性化、记录级差分隐私、对受控客户端异质性的敏感性、LoRA秩，以及在独立的BCPreds和NetBCE基准上的泛化，证明了参数高效的联邦蛋白质语言模型适配用于数据本地化B细胞表位预测的可行性，以及预测性能、个性化、隐私、通信效率和分布偏移之间的相关权衡。

title: Unsupervised prioritization of gene-regulatory variants with isolation forests
zh_title: 基于孤立森林的基因调控变异无监督优先排序
summary: 提出基于孤立森林的无监督方法，用于优先排序非编码区基因调控变异，以应对LD导致的因果变异难以识别问题。
key_points: 针对GWAS位点与eQTL共定位后的因果变异识别
区别于有监督组合及深度学习多分数工具
采用无监督孤立森林方法
reason: 预印本新方法，摘要信息有限，缺少对比细节
abstract: Most common variants occur in non-coding genomic regions. Numerous expression quantitative trait loci (eQTLs) can influence nearby gene expression. Across diverse traits and diseases, many genome-wide association study (GWAS) loci have been shown to colocalize with eQTLs, supporting gene-regulatory causal mechanisms. However, linkage disequilibrium (LD) obscures the identification of the causal variant(s), necessitating prioritization by functional annotations. Previously published variant prioritization tools relied on the machine-learning-based combination of diverse feature types like evolutionary conservation and chromatin information, whereas more recent deep learning tools learn and describe gene-regulatory DNA sequence grammar. However, the latter approaches often generate a large number of scores per variant. We designed a novel unsupervised machine-learning approach based on isolation forests to integrate the predictions from the broadly used Enformer deep learning model into a single gene-regulatory predictive score for each common variant. Our novel approach eQTL prediction with isolation forests (eQIF) demonstrates strong performance in predicting eQTLs and gene-regulatory GWAS variants. We show that top eQIF variants are located in evolutionarily conserved transcription factor binding site (TFBS) footprints, and that the frequency of top eQIF variants within overrepresented TFBS motifs recapitulates the motif information content. eQIF predictions are precomputed for 9,431,969 common variants and publicly available.
zh_abstract: 大多数常见变异位于非编码基因组区域。大量表达数量性状位点（eQTL）可影响邻近基因的表达。在多种性状和疾病中，许多全基因组关联研究（GWAS）位点已被证明与 eQTL 共定位，支持基因调控的因果机制。然而，连锁不平衡（LD）使因果变异的识别变得模糊，因此需要通过功能注释进行优先排序。此前发表的变异优先排序工具依赖基于机器学习的方法，结合进化保守性和染色质信息等多种特征类型；而较新的深度学习工具则学习并描述基因调控 DNA 序列语法。然而，后一类方法通常为每个变异生成大量评分。我们设计了一种基于孤立森林（isolation forest）的新型无监督机器学习方法，将广泛使用的 Enformer 深度学习模型的预测整合为每个常见变异的单一基因调控预测评分。我们的新方法——基于孤立森林的 eQTL 预测（eQTL prediction with isolation forests，eQIF）——在预测 eQTL 和具有基因调控作用的 GWAS 变异方面表现出色。我们表明，eQIF 排名靠前的变异位于进化上保守的转录因子结合位点（TFBS）足迹中，并且排名靠前的 eQIF 变异在过表达的 TFBS 基序中的频率再现了基序信息含量。eQIF 的预测结果已针对 9,431,969 个常见变异预先计算并公开提供。

title: scSTEC: Annotating Chromatin Subcompartments from Individual Single-Cell Hi-C Data via Direct Two-Dimensional Embedding and Chromosome-wise Consensus
zh_title: scSTEC：基于单细胞Hi-C的染色质亚区室注释
summary: 提出scSTEC方法，直接从单个细胞自身接触矩阵经二维嵌入与染色体层面共识来注释染色质亚区室，旨在摆脱scGHOST对多步上游流程和跨细胞信息的依赖。
key_points: 针对稀疏scHi-C的亚区室注释难题
仅用单个细胞自身接触矩阵，不依赖其他细胞
相比scGHOST简化流程、提升可解释性
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要未见充分对比与验证，属增量档
abstract: textbf{Motivation: }Single-cell Hi-C (scHi-C) technologies enable the study of three-dimensional (3D) genome organization at individual-cell resolution. Many computational methods have been developed to infer hierarchical structures from scHi-C data. However, annotating chromatin subcompartments from sparse scHi-C data remains a challenge. The recently developed scGHOST provides a framework for single-cell subcompartment annotation, but relies on a deep learning-based architecture, a multi-step upstream pipeline involving cell embedding and matrix imputation, and cross-cell information sharing. These features complicate algorithmic interpretation and make the annotation of an individual cell dependent on information from other cells in the dataset. Hence, methods are needed that annotate subcompartments directly from an individual cell's own contact matrix, without complex upstream processing or cross-cell information sharing. textbf{Results: }We developed scSTEC, a computational framework that annotates subcompartments directly from an individual scHi-C matrix without data imputation, complex upstream processing, or cross-cell data sharing. We show that the estimated inter-chromosomal matrix constructed by scGHOST is intrinsically of rank 2, revealing that the geometry relevant to clustering can be represented in two dimensions. Leveraging this low-dimensional structure, scSTEC performs direct subcompartment annotation through 2D genomic embedding and chromosome-wise consensus. Across bulk Hi-C, downsampled simulations, and real scHi-C datasets (four human cell lines, adult mouse cortex, developing mouse embryos, and developing olfactory sensory neurons), scSTEC achieves subcompartment annotations comparable to scGHOST despite operating on each cell independently, while providing greater algorithmic interpretability. Furthermore, subcompartments identified by scSTEC effectively resolve cell types, capture developmental dynamics, and show consistent associations with gene expression and epigenetic profiles. \textbf{Availability: }scSTEC is freely available at url{https://github.com/Ge-lab-pku/scSTEC}.
zh_abstract:
【动机】单细胞 Hi-C（scHi-C）技术使得在单细胞分辨率下研究三维（3D）基因组组织成为可能。目前已开发出许多从 scHi-C 数据推断层级结构的计算方法。然而，从稀疏的 scHi-C 数据中注释染色质亚区室仍然是一项挑战。最近开发的 scGHOST 为单细胞亚区室注释提供了一个框架，但它依赖基于深度学习的架构、涉及细胞嵌入和矩阵插补的多步骤上游流程，以及跨细胞的信息共享。这些特点使算法的解释变得复杂，并使单个细胞的注释依赖于数据集中其他细胞的信息。因此，需要能够直接利用单个细胞自身的接触矩阵来注释亚区室、且无需复杂上游处理或跨细胞信息共享的方法。
【结果】我们开发了 scSTEC，这是一个可直接从单个 scHi-C 矩阵注释亚区室的计算框架，无需数据插补、复杂的上游处理或跨细胞数据共享。我们证明，scGHOST 构建的估计染色体间矩阵本质上是秩为 2 的，这表明与聚类相关的几何结构可以用二维来表示。利用这一低维结构，scSTEC 通过二维基因组嵌入和染色体层面的共识来直接进行亚区室注释。在bulk Hi-C、降采样模拟以及真实 scHi-C 数据集（四种人类细胞系、成年小鼠皮层、发育中的小鼠胚胎和发育中的嗅觉感觉神经元）中，scSTEC 尽管对每个细胞独立运行，仍取得了与 scGHOST 相当的亚区室注释结果，同时具有更好的算法可解释性。此外，scSTEC 识别的亚区室能够有效区分细胞类型、捕捉发育动态，并与基因表达和表观遗传谱显示出一致的关联。
【可用性】scSTEC 可在 https://github.com/Ge-lab-pku/scSTEC 免费获取。

title: Vision-language classification of Torsades de Pointes risk from pseudo-coloured ECG images: do T-wave morphology and colour context help or hinder?
zh_title: 伪彩色心电图图像的尖端扭转型室速风险视觉语言分类
summary: 用BiomedCLIP检验上下文提示与T波形态标签对伪彩色ECG图像分类的作用，在9,789张图像上五折交叉验证。
key_points: 零样本推理不可用
训练后彩色图像优于无色图像
交叉比较四种上下文策略与标签集
reason: 设计清晰但仅内部交叉验证，结论偏方法学
abstract: Contextual prompting is widely presented as a cheap route to better performance from vision models, but the evidence comes largely from benchmarks in which an attribute named in a prompt is also present in the image, confounding the two channels. We investigate the significance of context for a semantically complex biomedical signal classification task using a domain-adapted vision-language model, BiomedCLIP. Building on our previous work that renders electrocardiogram (ECG) signals as colour-enhanced images to flag Torsades de Pointes risk using the QT-nomogram and pseudo-colouring technique, we cross four context strategies with four T-wave morphology label sets, evaluated zero-shot and with a class-balanced linear probe, under five-fold stratified cross-validation on 9,789 images. Zero-shot inference is unusable. Once trained, the colour-enhanced images outperform the colourless ones on every metric: balanced accuracy 0.903 versus 0.825, sensitivity 0.914 versus 0.827, specificity 0.892 versus 0.823, ROC-AUC 0.955 versus 0.888 and Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) 0.437 versus 0.311. Crossing colour-in-image with colour-in-prompt separates the confounded channels: the image contributes +0.126 MCC (+0.078 balanced accuracy, +0.067 ROC-AUC) whether or not the prompt names colour, whereas naming it changes nothing under any metric. Context is two-sided: the best prompt set gains 0.008 MCC where colour is present and 0.016 where it is not, while the worst loses 0.017 and 0.013. For a signal rendered as an image, the leverage lies in how the signal is drawn rather than in how it is described - and where the endpoint is an interval measurement, prompts naming T-wave morphology describe the wrong quantity.
zh_abstract: 上下文提示被广泛认为是提升视觉模型性能的廉价途径，但相关证据主要来自这样的基准：提示中提到的属性同时也存在于图像中，从而使两个通道相互混淆。我们使用领域适配的视觉-语言模型BiomedCLIP，针对一项语义复杂的生物医学信号分类任务，研究上下文的重要性。基于我们此前的工作——利用QT列线图和伪彩色技术，将心电图（ECG）信号渲染为彩色增强图像以标示尖端扭转型室速（Torsades de Pointes）风险——我们将四种上下文策略与四种T波形态标签集交叉组合，在9,789幅图像上采用五折分层交叉验证，分别以零样本和类别平衡线性探针方式进行评估。零样本推理不可用。一旦经过训练，彩色增强图像在所有指标上均优于无色图像：平衡准确率0.903对0.825，敏感性0.914对0.827，特异性0.892对0.823，ROC-AUC 0.955对0.888，马修斯相关系数（MCC）0.437对0.311。将图像中的颜色与提示中的颜色交叉，可分离这两个相互混淆的通道：无论提示是否提到颜色，图像均贡献+0.126 MCC（+0.078平衡准确率，+0.067 ROC-AUC），而提到颜色在任何指标下均无变化。上下文具有双面性：最佳提示集在存在颜色时提升0.008 MCC，在无颜色时提升0.016，而最差提示集则分别降低0.017和0.013。对于以图像形式呈现的信号，关键在于信号如何绘制，而非如何描述；且当终点是区间测量时，提及T波形态的提示描述的是错误的量。

title: Privacy-Preserving ECG-HRV Emotion Classification for Mood Swing Detection using Federated Learning on Constrained Edge Devices
zh_title: 边缘设备联邦学习的ECG-HRV情绪分类用于情绪波动检测
summary: 基于HRV特征的隐私保护情绪监测框架，在三个公开数据集74名参与者上评估，并用Polar H10做小规模试点验证。
key_points: 留一参与者交叉验证评估泛化
逻辑回归优于五种其他分类器
Polar H10试点二分类效价准确率75%
reason: 样本小、试点验证，准确率中等
abstract: This paper presents a privacy-preserving mood monitoring framework that classifies emotional states from ECG-derived heart rate variability (HRV) features. The framework is evaluated on three public datasets comprising 74 participants and further validated using a wearable device in a pilot study. Leave-One-Participant-Out cross-validation (LOPO-CV) is used to assess generalization to unseen individuals. A series of experiments investigates the impact of temporal windowing, HRV feature selection, and class balancing on both four-class valence-arousal and binary valence classification. Results show that class balancing substantially improves minority-class recall, while Logistic Regression consistently outperforms five alternative classifiers and achieves competitive performance against HRV-based baselines. Pilot validation using a Polar H10 wearable achieves 75% binary valence accuracy on an unseen individual without calibration, demonstrating the feasibility of real-world deployment. To preserve privacy, the framework is also implemented using federated learning on a six-node Raspberry Pi cluster. Federated Logistic Regression achieves performance comparable to centralized training without sharing raw physiological data. These results demonstrate the potential of interpretable and privacy-preserving mood monitoring for continuous mental health assessment in clinical and community settings.
zh_abstract: 本文提出了一种保护隐私的情绪监测框架，可根据源自心电图的心率变异性（HRV）特征对情绪状态进行分类。该框架在包含74名参与者的三个公开数据集上进行了评估，并在一项试点研究中使用可穿戴设备进一步验证。采用留一参与者交叉验证（LOPO-CV）评估对未见个体的泛化能力。一系列实验研究了时间窗口、HRV特征选择和类别平衡对四类效价-唤醒度分类及二分类效价分类的影响。结果表明，类别平衡显著提高了少数类的召回率，而逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）始终优于其他五种分类器，并与基于HRV的基线方法相比具有竞争力。使用Polar H10可穿戴设备进行的试点验证在未经校准的情况下，对一名未见个体取得了75%的二分类效价准确率，表明其在真实场景部署中的可行性。为保护隐私，该框架还在由六个节点组成的Raspberry Pi集群上采用联邦学习实现。联邦逻辑回归在无需共享原始生理数据的情况下，取得了与集中式训练相当的性能。这些结果表明，可解释且保护隐私的情绪监测在临床和社区环境中用于持续心理健康评估具有潜力。

title: Capacity Planning for Resource-Constrained Clinical LLM Serving
zh_title: 资源受限下临床LLM服务的容量规划
summary: 在四GPU环境中用异构临床NLP负载评估24种配置，发现机群组成比路由策略解释了更多性能差异。
key_points: 负载含事实核验、语义匹配、长文摘要
共测试24种配置
机群组成的方差占比高于路由策略
reason: 预印本，受控环境部署工程研究，增量档
abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) under a fixed accelerator budget requires jointly deciding how computational capacity is allocated across model sizes and how incoming requests are routed across that capacity. Although prior work has extensively studied LLM routing and serving efficiency, the relative importance of fleet composition and routing under resource constraints remains less understood. We investigate this question using a controlled four-GPU serving environment with heterogeneous clinical NLP workloads spanning short factual verification, biomedical semantic matching, and long-context clinical summarization. We systematically vary fleet composition, routing policy, and offered load while holding the workload trace and hardware budget fixed. Across 24 configurations, descriptive main-effect shares attribute more variation to fleet composition than to the evaluated routing policies in time to first token, latency, and long-context coverage. All-small fleets provide the best responsiveness and throughput but substantially lower long-context coverage, whereas larger-model capacity improves coverage at the cost of serving efficiency. Heterogeneous fleets provide intermediate operating points but can introduce strong-model bottlenecks when large-model capacity is scarce. In a focused evaluation of this bottleneck, capacity-aware routing reduces mean latency and increases throughput while incurring a small reduction in long-context coverage. Within this measured regime, the results support prioritizing capacity allocation, with routing managing demand within the provisioned capacity.
zh_abstract: 在固定加速器预算下部署大语言模型（LLM），需要联合决定如何在不同模型规模之间分配计算能力，以及如何将到达的请求路由到这些计算能力上。尽管已有研究对LLM路由和服务效率进行了广泛探讨，但在资源受限条件下，集群构成与路由各自的相对重要性仍不够清楚。我们在一个受控的四GPU服务环境中研究这一问题，工作负载为异构的临床自然语言处理任务，涵盖简短事实核查、生物医学语义匹配和长上下文临床摘要。我们在保持工作负载轨迹和硬件预算不变的前提下，系统地改变集群构成、路由策略和负载强度。在24种配置中，描述性的主效应占比显示，就首个词元时间、延迟和长上下文覆盖率而言，集群构成所解释的变异多于所评估的路由策略。全小模型集群具有最佳的响应性和吞吐量，但长上下文覆盖率明显较低；而更大模型的算力可提高覆盖率，代价是服务效率下降。异构集群可提供介于两者之间的运行点，但在大模型容量稀缺时可能出现强模型瓶颈。在针对该瓶颈的专项评估中，容量感知路由降低了平均延迟并提高了吞吐量，同时仅使长上下文覆盖率小幅下降。在所测量的这一范围内，结果支持优先考虑容量分配，由路由在已配置的容量范围内管理需求。

title: Are Fake Citations a Form of Reward Hacking? A Pre-Registered Study of Post-Training and Citation Cues
zh_title: 伪造引用是奖励黑客吗？后训练与引用提示的预注册研究
summary: 预注册研究在900个问题（含法律、科学与医学文献）和多个开源权重检查点上发现，后训练模型在被要求给出引用时伪造引用显著增加，基座模型则不然。
key_points: 12个检查点上交互效应为47.8个百分点
长度匹配对照排除了冗长回答的影响
覆盖法律、科学与医学文献三个领域
reason: 预印本，预注册设计较严谨，但医疗相关性仅为部分领域，增量档
abstract: Post-trained language models fabricate citations at high rates. We ask whether that is reward hacking: scoring well on a proxy for scholarship while doing worse on what it stands for. We ran four pre-registered experiments on 900 frozen questions (US federal case law, computationally adjacent scientific literature, and medical literature) across twelve open-weights checkpoints covering four post-training stages of three model families, then refit on fifteen. The clearest result holds the weights fixed and changes only the prompt. Asking for citations raises fabrication sharply in post-trained checkpoints and not in base ones: a 47.8-point interaction on twelve checkpoints (Holm-adjusted p = 2e-34) and 41.5 points on fifteen, in all three domains. A length-matched control separates the citation cue from a demand for a longer answer, so the effect is specific to citations, not verbosity. Post-training also raises fabrication overall, from 4.8% to 56.7%, but our registered prediction that it would rise most where fabrication is most tempting did not hold. A preference model trained only on surface citation features prefers post-trained output 86% of the time, and holding citation count fixed shows it rewards quantity. Our answer: possibly, but not proven. Post-trained models produce fabricated citations at far higher rates when asked for sources, and a naive evaluator that counts sources without checking them would prefer their output for citing more. But the targeted pattern we registered did not appear, and plain instruction-following could explain the same results. Proving that the reward causes fabrication needs an experiment that changes the reward during training, which this study does not do. Pre-registration: doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/S53HY. Code and data: https://github.com/zainnab-sparq/citation-reward-hacking
zh_abstract: 经后训练（post-trained）的语言模型会以很高的比例编造引文。我们探究这是否属于奖励欺骗（reward hacking）：即在学术性的代理指标上得分良好，而在该指标所代表的实际目标上表现更差。我们在900个冻结问题（美国联邦判例法、计算上相邻的科学文献以及医学文献）上开展了四项预注册实验，涉及三个模型家族、涵盖四个后训练阶段的十二个开放权重检查点，随后又扩展到十五个检查点重新拟合。最明确的结果来自固定权重、仅改变提示词的实验。要求提供引文会使后训练检查点的编造率大幅上升，而基础模型检查点则不会：在十二个检查点上交互效应为47.8个百分点（Holm校正后 p = 2e-34），在十五个检查点上为41.5个百分点，且在三个领域均成立。长度匹配的对照将引文提示与要求更长回答区分开来，因此该效应特定于引文，而非由冗长所致。后训练也使总体编造率从4.8%升至56.7%，但我们预先注册的预测——即编造率会在最容易诱发编造的情形中上升最多——并未成立。仅基于表面引文特征训练的偏好模型在86%的情况下偏好后训练模型的输出，而固定引文数量后的分析显示该模型奖励的是数量。我们的回答是：可能，但未被证实。被要求提供来源时，后训练模型编造引文的比例远高于基础模型；而只统计来源数量、不核查其真实性的朴素评估器会因其引用更多而偏好其输出。但我们所注册的针对性模式并未出现，单纯的指令遵循也可以解释相同的结果。要证明奖励导致了编造，需要在训练期间改变奖励的实验，而本研究并未进行此类实验。预注册：doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/S53HY。代码与数据：https://github.com/zainnab-sparq/citation-reward-hacking

title: Directional Dual-Head Supervision for Real-Time Source-Free Polyp Segmentation
zh_title: 面向实时无源息肉分割的方向性双头监督
summary: 提出MedRT-SFSeg，基于YOLO双头结构的无源域适应框架，缓解息肉分割中的确认偏差。
key_points: Mask-DHF融合精度与召回导向预测
DURR利用双头分歧方向修正掩码
Seg-MARD进行掩码引导的区域分层采样
reason: 预印本，有新方法但证据有限，属增量改进
abstract: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) is critical for medical image segmentation as it adapts a model to an unlabeled target domain without accessing source data, thereby preserving data privacy. However, its effectiveness is often limited by confirmation bias: self-training models tend to miss small polyps, hallucinate foreground, and produce imprecise contours. We propose MedRT-SFSeg, a real-time SFDA framework built on a dual-head one-to-one/one-to-many YOLO segmentation architecture. Mask-DHF fuses precision- and recall-oriented predictions into stable pseudo-instances, while DURR uses the sign of pixel-level dual-head disagreement as a directional cue to expand or shrink masks, and additionally recovers missed instances and suppresses hallucinations. Seg-MARD further regularizes feature representations through mask-guided, region-stratified sampling. Experiments on bidirectional adaptation between Kvasir-SEG and CVC-ClinicDB show that MedRT-SFSeg achieves 80.43%/80.77% Dice and 5.53/8.44 mm ASD, improving the non-adapted baseline by 7.7 and 9.8 Dice points while running at more than 62 FPS end-to-end. These results suggest that segmentation-aware dual-head supervision can improve pseudo-label quality without sacrificing real-time inference. Project page: https://danielnguyen-05.github.io/MedRT-SFSeg
zh_abstract: 无源域自适应（source-free domain adaptation，SFDA）对医学图像分割至关重要，因为它可在不访问源数据的情况下使模型适应无标注的目标域，从而保护数据隐私。然而，其效果常受确认偏差限制：自训练模型倾向于漏检小息肉、虚构前景并产生不精确的轮廓。我们提出 MedRT-SFSeg，这是一个基于双头一对一/一对多 YOLO 分割架构的实时 SFDA 框架。Mask-DHF 将侧重精确率与侧重召回率的预测融合为稳定的伪实例；DURR 以像素级双头分歧的符号作为方向性线索来扩张或收缩掩膜，并额外找回漏检实例、抑制虚构前景。Seg-MARD 则通过掩膜引导的、分区域分层采样进一步正则化特征表示。在 Kvasir-SEG 与 CVC-ClinicDB 之间的双向适应实验中，MedRT-SFSeg 取得 80.43%/80.77% 的 Dice 和 5.53/8.44 mm 的 ASD，相较未适应的基线分别提高 7.7 和 9.8 个 Dice 点，同时端到端运行速度超过 62 FPS。这些结果表明，面向分割的双头监督可以在不牺牲实时推理的前提下提升伪标签质量。项目页面：https://danielnguyen-05.github.io/MedRT-SFSeg

title: Evolving Scientific Intelligence: From Fragmented Evidence to Distributed Experimental Loops
zh_title: 演进式科学智能：从碎片化证据到分布式实验闭环
summary: 提出“演进式科学智能”（ESI）架构蓝图，通过共享、可计算的科学记忆连接智能实验室网络，使实验证据形成链式反应。预印本，未经同行评审。
key_points: 指出论文式交流造成“科学记忆墙”
设想智能实验室间失败实验可触发新假设
提出以共享可计算记忆保存实验记录的架构
reason: 愿景/观点类预印本，无实证验证，属增量档；AI科学发现方向略加分
abstract: Scientific discovery advances when evidence from different investigations is brought into contact. Yet paper-centric communication leaves experimental results fragmented, delayed, or unreported, creating a "scientific memory wall" between growing computational capabilities and the evidence accessible to AI systems. We envision a different dynamic: in a network of intelligent laboratories, a failed or overlooked experiment in one domain could trigger a hypothesis in another, whose testing generates evidence that stimulates further investigations. Such chains of information collision and empirical validation could transform isolated discovery loops into a cumulative scientific process. We propose Evolving Scientific Intelligence (ESI), an architectural blueprint for enabling these evidence-driven chain reactions. ESI preserves experimental records in shared, computable scientific memory, where evidence from different domains can be recombined into testable hypotheses. It jointly selects candidates and evaluation methods according to scientific value, reliability, and cost, then coordinates physical tests across distributed experimental nodes. Their feedback revises hypotheses and evaluators, while slower meta-control reassesses research objectives and decision criteria to guard against self-reinforcing errors and misguided optimization. We call for an Information Manhattan Project to build the infrastructure for scientific intelligence that evolves through experimentally grounded chains of discovery.

title: Transformer-Based Reinforcement Learning for Phase I Dose Allocation
zh_title: 基于Transformer强化学习的I期试验剂量分配
summary: 提出单一强化学习策略，用Transformer编码各剂量水平的毒性观察，选择降级、维持或升级；最终MTD由等渗回归和安全上限确定。仅有模拟结果，预印本。
key_points: 各剂量编码为含位置、人数、DLT的token
策略可适应不同剂量水平数量的试验
MTD决策置于学习策略之外，用加权等渗回归
reason: 仅模拟验证的预印本方法，与试验设计相关但无真实试验数据，属增量档
abstract: Phase I dose-finding trials must learn from sparse toxicity observations while limiting exposure to overly toxic doses. We develop a single reinforcement-learning policy for trials with different numbers of ordered dose levels. Each dose is represented as a token containing its normalized position, accumulated patient count, observed dose-limiting toxicities (DLTs), and current-dose indicator. A Transformer encoder summarizes the dose tokens, trial-conditioned cross-attention produces a fixed-dimensional trial representation, and a three-action policy chooses de-escalation, staying, or escalation. The final maximum tolerated dose (MTD) decision is deliberately kept outside the learned policy: after the planned sample size, weighted isotonic regression and a prespecified safety cap select the dose closest to the target toxicity probability. In the simulations, toxicity-penalized policies reduce DLT burden while unpenalized policies improve selection accuracy at the cost of greater toxicity. These results demonstrate a controllable safety--accuracy trade-off but do not establish superiority over conventional dose-finding designs.
