title: DR-LiteNet: A Lightweight Explainable Hybrid CNN Framework for Imbalanced Diabetic Retinopathy Grading via Adaptive SMOTE Fusion
zh_title: DR-LiteNet：轻量可解释混合CNN用于不平衡糖网分级
summary: 预印本提出结合EfficientNetB0深度特征与手工病灶特征的双分支网络，并用ADASYN缓解糖尿病视网膜病变分级的类别不平衡。
key_points: EfficientNetB0提取1280维深度特征
51维手工病灶描述符与之拼接为1331维
在特征空间应用ADASYN合成少数类
reason: 常规眼底分级改进，摘要未见外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Automated diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading from colour fundus photographs is held back by two compounding challenges: severe class imbalance across five severity grades and the heavy computational cost of large scale architectures in resource constrained clinical settings. We introduce DR-LiteNet, a dual branch hybrid convolutional neural network that tackles both problems at once. The CNN branch extracts 1,280 dimensional deep features through EfficientNetB0, while the handcrafted (HC) branch produces a compact 51 dimensional lesion descriptor capturing vessel density, exudate intensity, texture entropy, and HSV colour histograms. Concatenating both branches yields a 1,331-d hybrid embedding, on which Adaptive SMOTE (ADASYN) is applied during training to synthesise minority class feature vectors, correcting distributional skew without touching the image space. A two phase training protocol first warms up the classification head on balanced features, then fine tunes the full network end to end. Grad CAM saliency maps deliver post-hoc clinical explainability. Tested on APTOS 2019 under five fold stratified cross validation, DR-LiteNet reaches 88.77% +/- 0.61 accuracy, a quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) of 0.884 +/- 0.010, and a macro F1 of 0.792 +/- 0.008 with only 4.69 M parameters beating ResNet50 (23.5 M) by DeltaQWK = 0.022 while staying practical on a single Google Colab T4 GPU. The source code of this project is available at: https://github.com/Nishi-Kanta-Paul/DR-LiteNet.
zh_abstract: 基于彩色眼底照片的糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）自动分级受到两方面叠加挑战的制约：五个严重程度等级之间严重的类别不平衡，以及大规模架构在资源受限的临床环境中高昂的计算成本。我们提出了DR-LiteNet，一种双分支混合卷积神经网络，可同时应对这两个问题。CNN分支通过EfficientNetB0提取1,280维深度特征，而手工特征（HC）分支生成紧凑的51维病灶描述符，涵盖血管密度、渗出物强度、纹理熵和HSV颜色直方图。将两个分支拼接得到1,331维混合嵌入，训练期间在其上应用自适应SMOTE（ADASYN）合成少数类特征向量，在不触及图像空间的情况下纠正分布偏斜。两阶段训练方案首先在平衡特征上预热分类头，然后对整个网络进行端到端微调。Grad-CAM显著性图提供事后的临床可解释性。在APTOS 2019数据集上采用五折分层交叉验证，DR-LiteNet取得88.77% ± 0.61的准确率、0.884 ± 0.010的二次加权kappa（QWK）以及0.792 ± 0.008的宏平均F1，仅有469万参数，QWK较ResNet50（2350万参数）高出0.022，同时在单块Google Colab T4 GPU上仍具实用性。本项目源代码见：https://github.com/Nishi-Kanta-Paul/DR-LiteNet。

title: Structured Clinical Memory as Context for Probabilistic Decision Models: A Synthetic Evaluation with Jev
zh_title: 结构化临床记忆作为概率决策模型上下文：合成评估
summary: 在30例完全合成病例、120个问题上，加入结构化记忆使准确率由90.0%升至93.3%，差异无统计学显著性（McNemar p=0.219）。
key_points: 仅用合成病例，共120个类型化问题
每次调用增加约310输入token，延迟基本不变
reason: 小样本合成数据、差异不显著，属增量档；预印本
abstract: Longitudinal clinical context is often distributed across noisy, repetitive forms and narrative records. We study whether a compact structured memory can improve a probabilistic decision model's answers when the underlying patient vignette is already available. We created 30 fully synthetic cases spanning twelve clinical domains, paired each with synthetically generated structured memory, and evaluated 120 typed questions with Jev. The raw-vignette arm achieved 90.0% accuracy (95% normal-approximation confidence interval: 84.6%-95.4%); adding memory achieved 93.3% (88.9%-97.8%). Five questions changed from incorrect to correct and one changed in the opposite direction (exact McNemar $p=0.219$). Choice log loss decreased from 0.258 to 0.175 and binary Brier score from 0.054 to 0.022. Memory added 310 input tokens per call on average, while observed mean latency was unchanged at approximately 0.5 seconds. These results are directionally positive rather than clinically validating: the cases are synthetic, the labels are single-author judgments, and the memory is an oracle upper bound rather than extracted production output. The pilot supports evaluating structured clinical memory as a reusable state interface for decision models.
zh_abstract: 纵向临床背景信息通常分散在嘈杂、重复的表单和叙述性记录中。我们研究在已有患者病例描述（vignette）的情况下，紧凑的结构化记忆能否改善概率性决策模型的回答。我们创建了 30 个完全合成的病例，涵盖十二个临床领域，每个病例配以合成生成的结构化记忆，并使用 Jev 评估 120 道分类型问题。仅使用原始病例描述组的准确率为 90.0%（95% 正态近似置信区间：84.6%–95.4%）；加入记忆后为 93.3%（88.9%–97.8%）。有五道题由错误变为正确，一道题发生相反变化（精确 McNemar 检验 $p=0.219$）。选项对数损失（choice log loss）由 0.258 降至 0.175，二分类 Brier 评分由 0.054 降至 0.022。记忆平均每次调用增加 310 个输入 token，而观察到的平均延迟不变，约为 0.5 秒。这些结果在方向上是积极的，但不构成临床验证：病例为合成数据，标签为单一作者的判断，且记忆是理想（oracle）上限，而非从实际生产环境中提取的输出。该初步研究支持将结构化临床记忆作为决策模型可复用的状态接口加以评估。

title: From FAIR to AI-FAIR Metadata-First Infrastructure for AI-Enabled Science
zh_title: 从FAIR到AI-FAIR：面向AI科学的元数据优先基础设施
summary: 提出面向生态与生物多样性科学的AI-FAIR元数据准则，强调问题-数据-模型间的双向价值回流。
key_points: 指出AI工作流数据基础设施分散
价值单向流动，修正与标注很少回流
提出扩展FAIR的AI-FAIR准则
reason: 观点类预印本，侧重生态学，与医疗关联较弱
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and their capabilities have advanced rapidly over the past few years, leading to widespread interest and adoption in the biological and ecological sciences. However, the data infrastructure and computational resources that provide the foundation for AI workflows in ecology and biodiversity science remain fragmented. Moreover, the flow of value remains largely unidirectional: data move from collectors, through repositories and aggregators into models, and finally to research products or management actions. The derived value, such as corrected taxonomies, annotations, quality flags, and insights, rarely returns to source communities. We propose an extension of the original FAIR principles to address the needs of AI-ready infrastructure: the AI-FAIR metadata criteria, which place AI-enabled science in the context of a bidirectional Question-Data-Model triangle. This framework is designed to facilitate large-scale content-based analysis across diverse collections and ensure that the scientists generating the data benefit from the AI-enabled advances built on their data. Alongside these criteria, we introduce an agentic evaluation workflow that both rates existing datasets on the AI-FAIR and traditional FAIR criteria and provides actionable feedback where critical metadata is missing or incomplete. This modular dataset evaluation tool, paired with a domain-appropriate checklist, translates these principles into a reusable assessment of machine-learning readiness, AI-readiness for specified tasks, traceability, and ethical and CARE-aligned stewardship. Through this approach we aim to create a community-informed system to close the model data loop, so that AI also enriches data to further enable scientific discovery.
zh_abstract: 人工智能（AI）技术及其能力在过去几年中迅速发展，引起了生物和生态科学领域的广泛关注和采用。然而，为生态学和生物多样性科学中AI工作流程提供基础的数据基础设施和计算资源仍然分散。此外，价值的流动在很大程度上仍是单向的：数据从采集者出发，经由存储库和聚合平台进入模型，最终形成研究成果或管理行动。由此产生的价值，如修正后的分类体系、注释、质量标记和见解，很少回流到数据来源的社区。我们提出对原有FAIR原则的扩展，以满足AI就绪基础设施的需求：AI-FAIR元数据标准，它将AI赋能的科学置于“问题-数据-模型”双向三角关系的背景之中。该框架旨在促进跨不同馆藏的大规模基于内容的分析，并确保产生数据的科学家能从基于其数据所取得的AI进展中获益。除这些标准外，我们还引入了一种智能体式评估工作流程，既依据AI-FAIR和传统FAIR标准对现有数据集进行评级，又在关键元数据缺失或不完整时提供可操作的反馈。这一模块化的数据集评估工具与适合特定领域的检查清单相配合，将这些原则转化为可重复使用的评估，涵盖机器学习就绪度、特定任务的AI就绪度、可追溯性，以及符合伦理和CARE原则的管理。通过这一方法，我们旨在建立一个由社区参与的体系，以闭合模型—数据环路，使AI也能丰富数据，从而进一步促进科学发现。

title: Multimodal BVP and Respiration for Automated Pain Recognition with Hankel-FCN
zh_title: 基于BVP与呼吸多模态信号和Hankel-FCN的自动疼痛识别
summary: 利用Hankel矩阵嵌入将BVP与呼吸信号转为轨迹表示，经模态专用全卷积网络与后期融合，在AI4Pain数据集上进行三分类疼痛识别。
key_points: 使用AI4Pain数据集的BVP与呼吸信号
Hankel嵌入刻画时间动态
模态专用FCN加后期融合
reason: 预印本，单数据集方法，无外部验证
abstract: Automated pain recognition is a fundamental challenge for the advancement of clinical care and empathetic human-computer interaction, due to the subjective and dynamic nature of pain. In this study, we propose a deep learning framework for objective pain assessment based on multimodal physiological signals from the AI4Pain dataset. The approach focuses on Blood Volume Pulse (BVP) and Respiration (RESP), capturing complementary aspects of autonomic responses to nociceptive stimulation. To explicitly model their temporal dynamics, the signals are transformed into structured trajectory representations using Hankel matrix embeddings, enabling the learning of dynamical patterns beyond conventional time-series representations. These embeddings are processed by modality-specific Fully Convolutional Networks, and their outputs are integrated through a late fusion strategy for three-class classification (No Pain, Low Pain, High Pain). Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves an accuracy of 67.09% and an F1-score of 66.41%, providing competitive performance compared to existing approaches, while relying on no handcrafted feature engineering. Multimodal fusion significantly outperformed either modality alone, and the Hankel embedding showed a trend towards further improvement. Further validation is required to establish generalisability to broader populations and clinical settings.

title: Inferring missing locations in human mobility data using memory effects
zh_title: 利用记忆效应推断人类移动数据中的缺失位置
summary: 提出每人单参数的时间衰减插补方法，在合成及Twitter数据上宏AUROC超0.9。
key_points: 观测信息量随双向时间距离按幂律衰减
经贝叶斯模型比较选择衰减形式
对中等噪声稳健，对高移动用户优于CTMC
reason: 计算社会科学方法，预印本，增量性质
abstract: Empirical datasets used to characterize human mobility are sparse in space and time, owing to technological factors such as coverage and battery, or to the erratic nature of online interactions. Missing data can bias the conclusions drawn from them, so filling the gaps in incomplete timelines is a key challenge in computational social science. Here, we propose a simple imputation method in which the informativeness of an observation decays with its bidirectional temporal distance from the missing entry, at a rate set by a single parameter per individual. On synthetic and real Twitter data, a power-law decay, selected by Bayesian model comparison, yields accurate imputations (macro-AUROC above 0.9 overall, and above 0.8 for the most mobile users) and matches a gap-aware continuous-time Markov chain, outperforming it among the most mobile users. The method is robust to moderate noise and generalizes across countries and European administrative regions.
zh_abstract: 用于刻画人类移动性的实证数据集在空间和时间上都较为稀疏，原因包括覆盖范围和电池等技术因素，或在线互动的不规律性。缺失数据可能使由其得出的结论产生偏倚，因此填补不完整时间线中的空缺是计算社会科学的一项关键挑战。在此，我们提出一种简单的插补方法：观测值的信息量随其与缺失条目的双向时间距离而衰减，衰减速率由每个个体的单个参数决定。在合成数据和真实 Twitter 数据上，经贝叶斯模型比较选出的幂律衰减可产生准确的插补（总体宏平均 AUROC 高于 0.9，移动性最强的用户高于 0.8），并与考虑空缺的连续时间马尔可夫链相当，在移动性最强的用户中优于后者。该方法对中等程度的噪声具有稳健性，并可推广到不同国家和欧洲行政区域。

title: Fuzzy-Enhanced Machine Learning Approach for Type 2 Diabetes Diagnosis
zh_title: 用于2型糖尿病诊断的模糊增强机器学习方法
summary: 结合模糊化、SMOTE-ENN平衡和蝙蝠算法特征选择的随机森林框架，在Pima数据集上报告96.11%准确率。
key_points: 选择性模糊化加进化特征选择
仅用Pima小型公开数据集
reason: 小型老数据集、无外部验证，方法增量
abstract: Accurate diabetes prediction is critical for early clinical intervention, yet existing machine-learning pipelines often fail due to class imbalance, noisy physiological measurements, and redundant or weakly informative features. To address these unresolved limitations, this study establishes a unified fuzzy-evolutionary-ensemble framework designed to uncover a more discriminative feature space for type 2 diabetes prediction. The workflow integrates selective fuzzification of nonlinear clinical variables, SMOTE-ENN-based balancing and noise filtering, and Bat-Algorithm-driven evolutionary feature selection prior to training a Random Forest classifier. Applied to the Pima Indians Diabetes Dataset, the framework compresses the expanded fuzzy-numerical space into an optimized 10-feature subset and yields substantial performance gains: 96.11% accuracy, 95.14% precision, 98.00% recall, and a 98.23% F1-score. Relative to a baseline Random Forest using all 16 features (74.45% accuracy; 59.86% F1), the system achieves more than a 1.6-fold improvement in F1-score while preserving over 99% stability in majority-class detection and surpassing earlier published 16-feature models impacted by imbalance and weak feature relevance. Collectively, these results demonstrate that the integrated pipeline produces an enhanced fuzzy-numerical representation space that improves diabetes risk stratification and provides a scalable, uncertainty-aware foundation for diagnostic modeling across broader clinical datasets.
zh_abstract: 准确的糖尿病预测对早期临床干预至关重要，但现有机器学习流程常因类别不平衡、生理测量噪声以及冗余或信息量弱的特征而失效。为解决这些尚未解决的局限，本研究建立了一个统一的模糊-进化-集成框架，旨在为 2 型糖尿病预测发掘更具区分力的特征空间。该工作流程整合了对非线性临床变量的选择性模糊化、基于 SMOTE-ENN 的平衡与噪声过滤，以及在训练随机森林（Random Forest）分类器之前由蝙蝠算法（Bat Algorithm）驱动的进化特征选择。应用于 Pima Indians 糖尿病数据集时，该框架将扩展后的模糊-数值空间压缩为优化的 10 个特征子集，并带来显著的性能提升：准确率 96.11%，精确率 95.14%，召回率 98.00%，F1 分数 98.23%。相较于使用全部 16 个特征的基线随机森林（准确率 74.45%；F1 59.86%），该系统的 F1 分数提高了 1.6 倍以上，同时在多数类检测上保持了超过 99% 的稳定性，并且超越了此前发表的、受不平衡和特征相关性弱影响的 16 特征模型。总之，这些结果表明，该整合流程产生了增强的模糊-数值表征空间，改善了糖尿病风险分层，并为更广泛临床数据集上的诊断建模提供了可扩展、考虑不确定性的基础。
